title: Temporary Drive Up and Go Supervisor
description:
Why choose us?

Are you ready to take the next step in your leadership career? Join us for an exciting opportunity as a Home Shopping Department Manager, where digital fulfillment, customer service, and operational excellence come together.

At Albertsons Companies, we are looking for team-focused managers who are passionate about people, performance, and deliver a seamless shopping experience. As a Home Shopping Department Manager, you will lead daily fulfillment operations, ensure accurate and timely order completion, and support strong customer satisfaction while driving digital sales growth. This role offers a fast‑paced, hands‑on environment where your work directly impacts customers and overall store success.

Bring your flavor

Building the future of food and well‑being starts with a seamless digital shopping experience. Bring your passion for customer service, organization, and operational excellence to a role where you manage high‑volume fulfillment operations, support your team, and ensure every customer order is accurate, on time, and handled with care.

Main responsibilities:

  • Oversee all daily operations of the Home Shopping Department, ensuring timely, accurate, and customer‑focused order fulfillment

  • Deliver an exceptional pick‑up and delivery experience while resolving customer concerns, substitutions, and refunds professionally

  • Coordinate end‑to‑end fulfillment processes including picking, staging, dispensing, and delivery coordination (where applicable)

  • Ensure proper use of Home Shopping technology, handheld devices, and fulfillment systems

  • Monitor key performance metrics such as order accuracy, pick rates, on‑time completion, labor efficiency, and customer satisfaction

  • Create and manage schedules aligned with order volume, peak demand, and productivity expectations

  • Partner with department leaders to address inventory availability and out‑of‑stocks impacting orders

  • Hire, train, coach, and develop Home Shopping associates while fostering a positive, accountable team culture

  • Ensure compliance with food safety, sanitation, quality, and company operational standards

We are looking for candidates who possess the following:

Soft skills:

  • Strong customer‑service focus with excellent communication skills

  • Effective people management, coaching, and team‑building abilities

  • Strong organization, time management, and problem‑solving skills

  • Ability to manage work in a fast‑paced, high‑volume environment

Competencies:

  • Digital order fulfillment and pickup/delivery operations

  • Labor planning, scheduling, and productivity management

  • Performance metric tracking and continuous improvement

  • Operational standards, food safety, and compliance execution

Knowledge:

  • Retail, e‑commerce, or Home Shopping operations

  • Store systems, handheld technology, and fulfillment platforms

Abilities:

  • Ability to review performance data and take corrective action

  • Ability to train, coach, and develop associates

  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. and work in varying temperature environments

  • Travel requirements: None

  • Other requirements: Flexible availability including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays; reliable attendance; compliance with company safety policies and Code of Business Conduct

We also provide a variety of benefits including:

  • Competitive wages paid weekly

  • Associate discounts

  • Health and financial well-being benefits for eligible associates (Medical, Dental, 401k and more!)

  • Time off (vacation, holidays, sick pay). For eligibility requirements please visit myACI Benefits

  • Leaders invested in your training, career growth and development

  • An inclusive work environment with talented colleagues who reflect the communities we serve

Our Values – Click below to view video: ACI Values

A copy of the full job description can be made available to you.

title: Head of Compliance - Guernsey
description:
Background:
Strategic Risk Solutions (SRS) is an independent, privately owned global insurance management and consulting firm specialising in captives, alternative risk financing, insurance and reinsurance program management, and related advisory services.

Job Summary:
This role is responsible for leading the delivery of compliance services to SRS and its clients, ensuring the risk management framework and control environment is maintained to the highest standard.

Key Accountabilities:
  • Act as Compliance Officer, MLCO, and MLRO for SRS in Guernsey.
  • Member of the Risk & Compliance Committee.
  • Acting as the MLCO and MLRO for a small number of life insurance client companies which are business to business entities.
  • Design and monitoring the implementation of the annual Compliance Monitoring Program and report quarterly on the progress.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of compliance systems and oversee the conduct of periodic checks and audits.
  • Report to the Board on compliance with GFSC regulatory requirements.
  • Review new policies and procedures.
  • Acts as the primary contact for the GFSC coordinating communications and requirements.
  • Maintaining an open and cooperative relationship with regulatory authorities on GFSC risk assessments and compliance monitoring actions, scopes and reports.
  • Stay informed about changes in laws and regulations that impact compliance obligations and provide advice to the firm and to the Board on compliance/regulatory matters.
  • Coordinate the Risk & Compliance Committee meetings.
  • Engage in ongoing learning about industry standards, guidelines, best practices, and methodologies.
  • Co-ordinate action plans related to GFSC risk assessment, compliance execution, and risk and compliance reporting.

Skills, Experience and Attributes:
  • Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks, particularly GFSC requirements, with the ability to interpret and apply them effectively.
  • Excellent organisational and analytical skills, with the ability to design and monitor compliance programs and conduct audits.
  • Effective communicator with strong verbal and written skills.
  • Proactive and detail-oriented, with the ability to identify compliance risks and implement appropriate controls and action plans.
  • Skilled in policy review and development, ensuring internal procedures remain aligned with evolving regulatory standards.
  • Strong leadership and coordination skills, with experience managing committees and cross-functional compliance initiatives.
  • Ability to stay current with changes in laws, regulations, and industry best practices, and translate these into practical guidance.
  • High level of integrity and discretion, with a commitment to maintaining confidentiality.

title: B Lineman - Transmission (APC)
description:
Position Summary

The Class B Lineman is a safety focused professional with the ability to construct and repair electrical transmission systems. You will work on energized and de‑energized powerlines and may be required to travel to different job sites, including out‑of‑state locations, as operational and customer needs dictate. You will report to the Foreman.

Essential Functions

  • Perform new construction, maintain and repair energized and de‑energized transmission systems while putting safety first.

  • Install and repair overhead transmission lines, poles, insulators, conductors and related hardware.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of switching and tagging procedures, EPZ -grounding and understanding induced voltage on de-energized lines using the proper tools and test equipment.

  • Climb different structures (wood, steel, concrete) using approved climbing methods and equipment.

  • Work at heights and in proximity to energized equipment.

  • Proficient in all aspects of heavy lifting and rigging.

  • Operate and maintain bucket trucks, digger derricks, tensioners and pullers and other pieces of transmission line equipment.

  • Work outdoors in varying environmental conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, wind, and inclement weather.

  • Available to work outages, storms, emergencies including on call rotation.

  • Follow all safety protocols including PPE use and possess a comprehensive understanding of insulated protective cover to isolate differences of potential on energized lines.

Minimum Requirements

  • Three (3) years of recent transmission line experience.

  • Valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL).

  • Willing to travel long distances on short notice.

  • Lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

  • Work for extended periods at different job locations, including out‑of‑state assignments.

  • Willing to work outside of normal business hours, including weekends, holidays, emergency callouts, and overtime.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you will be required to talk, listen and use hand signals to communicate. The job frequently requires you to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle objects, operate tools or controls; reach with hands and arms.

Work Environment

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you are frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. You are occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at construction job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. You will perform job responsibilities in extreme heat, cold, wet, windy, and storm conditions.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

  • HSA, dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability

  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and family and medical leave

If this sounds like you, come join the PIKE family.

About Us

Founded in 1945, Pike is a leading provider of construction, repair and engineering services for electric and gas utilities, as well as telecommunications companies with a growing portfolio of turnkey renewable projects. We work with hundreds of utility clients across the country, and we continuously expand our offerings to supply our customers with the ideas, technology, experience, workforce and equipment to perform any job.

"Essential" is the one word that sums up who we are, the work we do and what our people mean to us. Each of our employees plays a critical role in ensuring that infrastructure systems are up and running when people and businesses need them.

Pike is a family-oriented workplace with a strong culture of safety, collaboration, innovation and exceptional customer service.

Pike Electric LLC, is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Aircraft Component Technician
description:
TEL Staffing is hiring an Aircraft Component Tech to join our team in Fairhope, AL.

*One (1) year of mechanical experience including troubleshooting aircraft, automotive and/or industrial engines/equipment or completion of Aviation School required.


Purpose of Position: To assist in the performance of various aircraft component maintenance/inspection related tasks and duties as delegated by the shop leadership team.


Essential Functions: (must be able to perform these functions, with or without a reasonable accommodation).

  • Perform aircraft component maintenance, inspection, testing, troubleshooting and repair activities as assigned by shop leadership in accordance with approved technical data, company procedure and FAA requirements.

  • Acquires information from production boards, reports and any other additional information given by supervisor and/or lead for daily/weekly production goals

  • Locates the accessory work order from the assigned production rack

  • Properly logs into ETS using the correct operation code

  • Reviews the work scope as directed by Sales upon induction

  • Locates the correct manual and tooling equipment to complete evaluation

  • Reviews and interprets the overhaul manual (OHM) to accurately diagnose the defect listed identified by Sales or adhere to the correct engine work scope and/or customer SOP

  • Completes preliminary inspection: Inspect unit for any incoming damages or numerical errors (part/serial numbers, descriptions, status etc.) as well as missing or incorrect parts received. Inform lead of any discrepancies found.

  • Bench test unit as applicable to confirm report from Sales/Customer.

  • Properly disassembles the until according to the overhaul manual; using the correct tooling equipment required and following any standard aviation procedures/practices

  • Visually inspects piece parts for any defects listed by the overhaul manual and/or any aviation standard practice

  • Measures any item indicated by the inspection section using micrometers, calipers and/or any other approved measuring equipment

  • Assigns the correct routing for any rework item by completing the required IW in accordance with the company standards

  • Accurately logs inspection report into company specific software and completes the unit’s evaluation

  • Completes any final calibrations/testing required per the overhaul manual with the Accessory Shop Quality Inspector, as required.

  • Ensures that all piece parts, tags and paperwork are properly identified and completed for Final Inspection

  • Properly preserves the unit in accordance with the overhaul manual or standard aviation practices as required.

  • Ensures units are properly mounted on shipping boards if required

  • Ensures caps, plugs, covers, and tags (e.g. WARNING and CAUTION tags) are properly installed before shipping

  • Maintains a clean workstation free from Foreign Object and/or Debris (FOD), ensures tooling is properly stored

  • Maintains a clean/safe workspace free from spills or obstruction which may lead to harm

  • Confers with lead/supervisor to recommend changes such as: equipment utilization, production methods and procedures to increase efficiency of department and promote improvement

  • Attends all safety and health training, as required, in a timely manner

  • Works when scheduled and complies with company attendance policy

  • Works overtime as needed

  • Other duties as required

  • Observes and practices all safety procedures and personal policies (e.g. Safety-glasses, ear plugs, face shields etc.)

Skills, Knowledge and Abilities: (these are required to enable job holder to perform the essential functions of the job)

  • Must provide and maintain toolbox in accordance with Fairhope Aero guidelines.

  • Must be proficient in using a variety of hand tools, special tools, and GSE required to perform assigned maintenance tasks

  • Must be able to maintain an effective working relationship with, and among co-workers and supervisors

  • Must be able to work with little or no supervision and to take initiative

  • Must be able to use applied knowledge to formulate positive solutions to problem situations

  • Must be able to apply common sense

  • Must be able to effectively read, write and communicate in English

  • Must be proficient in company specific software

  • Must be able to add, subtract, multiply and divide, using fractions and decimals; compute percentages, ratios, rates and interpret graphs

  • Must be able to comply with OSHA requirements and standards to properly wear all applicable PPE

  • Must have knowledge of precision measuring tools/equipment (dimensional and electrical)

  • Must be able to lift and carry up to 50 lbs. regularly and more, with assistance occasionally

  • Must regularly be able to reach overhead

  • Must regularly be able to squat, bend, twist, stoop, kneel, and stand

  • Must be able to walk around regularly using steps occasionally

  • Must be able to see within normal range of vision with or without corrective lenses

  • Must be able to hear running machinery

  • Must be able to use hands, wrists, and fingers repetitively

  • Must have exceptional hand-eye coordination

  • Ability to provide verifications of US citizenship or permanent residency to satisfy ITAR/EAR restrictions

Marginal Functions: (Duties that are likely to be assigned to this person, unless he/she proves unable to perform them after receiving training and/or accommodations that the company judges appropriate)

  • Other duties as assigned

Experience and Education Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or GED required.

  • One (1) year of mechanical experience including troubleshooting aircraft, automotive and/or industrial engines/equipment or completion of Aviation School required.

  • One (1) year of experience in disassembly, assembly, maintenance, repair or overhaul of various components in an MRO environment preferred.

  • A&P license or FAA Power Plant Rating preferred.

  • Must pass a criminal background check.

  • Must pass a DOT FAA pre-employment drug screen and comply with all FAA regulations.

  • Position is considered safety-sensitive in accordance with DOT and FAA regulations and as such, subject to drug and alcohol testing per FAA's regulations.

  • Ability to provide verifications of US citizenship or permanent residency to satisfy ITAR/EAR restrictions.


TEL Staffing is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status.

title: In-Store Shopper-Vegas Talent Hub
description:
Click here to see - A Day in the Life - In Store Shopper


A Day in the Life:

As an In Store Shopper (Drive Up & Go Clerk as we call it), your day is focused on selecting high-quality products for customers who shop online. You move throughout the store picking items, checking quality, and making selections that match what you’d choose yourself. Each order is an opportunity to get it just right, ensuring customers receive accurate and fresh groceries.

Another part of the role is keeping orders organized and ready for pick up. You’ll bag items carefully, manage substitutions when needed, and coordinate orders for timely handoff to customers. Between shopping, packing, and preparing orders for delivery or pickup, the work stays steady making it a good fit for someone who enjoys moving throughout the store and working in a fast‑paced environment.

What you bring to the table:

  • Customer Interaction Skills: Clear and professional communication when assisting with pickup orders
  • Product Selection Skills: Choosing high-quality items across perishable and non-perishable departments
  • Attention to Detail: Accuracy in order fulfillment, substitutions, and product quality checks
  • Organization & Time Management: Managing multiple orders while maintaining speed and accuracy
  • Technology Use: Comfortable using handheld devices and systems for order picking and tracking
  • Problem Awareness: Identifying out-of-stock items and selecting appropriate substitutions
  • Operational Awareness: Following order fulfillment processes and company standards
  • Team Awareness: Coordinating order needs with team members and department processes
  • Adaptability: Comfort with changing order volume and priorities throughout the shift
  • Physical Capability: Comfort with continuous movement, lifting up to 50 lbs., and working in different store areas

Requirements:

  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • Prior retail, customer service, or fulfillment experience preferred
  • Ability to use handheld devices and follow digital order systems
  • Strong attention to detail required for product quality and order accuracy
  • Availability to work early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays
  • Compliance with company policies including safety, sanitation, and dress standards

Why you will choose us:

Albertsons Companies Inc. has always been a people-oriented business, and thoughtful people practices remain a core element of our company’s philosophy. Our goal is to continue to bring people together around the joys of food and to inspire well-being and that starts with people like you bringing your unique self to our company and making it one person stronger and better!

We also provide a variety of benefits including:

  • Inclusive work culture built on belonging
  • Competitive Wages paid weekly
  • Flexible work schedules
  • Associate discounts
  • Leaders invested in your training, career growth & development.
  • Health and welfare benefits for eligible employees (Medical, Dental, 401k and more!)
  • Vacation / Paid Time Off

Our Values

  • We put people first.
  • We are customer driven.
  • We value different perspectives.
  • We raise the bar.
  • We act as owners.
  • We are one team.
  • We build belonging.
  • We are committed to a healthy future.

title: Erfaren Data Engineer til Azure Databricks-platform
description:
Vil du udvikle dataløsninger, der gør en mærkbar forskel i dansk landbrug, og arbejde med platform, data og AI? I SEGES Digital søger vi en Data Engineer med mindst 3 års erfaring til vores DataEstate-platform, som er baseret på Databricks og Azure. Vi leder efter dig, der kan bygge solide dataløsninger og har lyst til at være med til at skabe mere værdi med data i tæt samarbejde med resten af organisationen.

SEGES Digital er SEGES Innovations digitale forretningsenhed. Vi udvikler data- og AI-baserede løsninger til landbrugs- og fødevareområdet med udgangspunkt i vores DataEstate-platform. Her mødes faglig indsigt, moderne cloudteknologi og praktisk anvendelse af data i løsninger, der skal fungere i virkeligheden.

SEGES Digital består af ca. 200 medarbejdere, der sammen med resten af SEGES Innovation arbejder for at sikre fremtidens bæredygtige fødevarer. Det gør vi gennem forskning, innovation og digitale værktøjer, der understøtter den grønne omstilling af landbrugs- og fødevaresektoren. Vi lægger vægt på et inkluderende fagligt miljø, hvor forskellige perspektiver og erfaringer skaber bedre løsninger. I SEGES Innovation er kønsfordelingen tæt på 50/50.

Om stillingen

I Data & Analytics har vi ansvaret for at udvikle, vedligeholde og drifte dataløsninger på vores DataEstate-platform. Vi leverer datagrundlag, pipelines og platformskomponenter til interne produktteams, rådgivere og faglige eksperter og arbejder tæt sammen med Data Science om at omsætte data og AI til løsninger i praksis.

Som Data Engineer får du en central rolle i at videreudvikle en moderne dataplatform, hvor vi samler, beriger og gør data tilgængelige på tværs af organisationen. Du udvikler nye løsninger i tæt samarbejde med kolleger i Innovation og Digital samt eksterne kunder som de danske landbrugsrådgivninger.

Rollen passer til dig, der har flere års praktisk erfaring og nu ønsker mere ansvar for kvalitet, drift, arkitekturvalg og gode udviklingsprocesser. Du skal ikke kunne det hele fra starten. Det vigtigste er et godt teknisk fundament, lyst til at lære og evnen til at udvikle løsninger sammen med andre.

Som Data Engineer får du et bredt ansvarsområde med fokus på udvikling, drift og support af DataEstate-platformen. Du kommer især til at arbejde med:

  • Afklaring, refinement og design af udviklingsopgaver og projekter
  • Udvikling og vedligeholdelse af eksisterende løsninger
  • Udvikling af nye features og opgradering af platformen
  • Udvikling af datapipelines, datamodeller og platformskomponenter i Databricks og Azure
  • Samarbejde med Product Owner, data scientists og faglige eksperter om at omsætte behov til konkrete dataleverancer
  • Være med til at skabe indsigt og adgang til data på tværs af organisationen
  • Anvendelse af AI-værktøjer til at effektivisere udvikling, dokumentation, test og fejlsøgning

Det ser vi gerne, at du kommer med

Du har mindst 3 års erfaring med Data Engineering, gerne med Databricks, data lake eller lakehouse, og du har arbejdet med løsninger, hvor datakvalitet, drift og skalerbarhed er vigtige. Du behøver ikke kunne alt fra dag ét, men vi forventer, at du har et solidt teknisk fundament, tager ansvar og har lyst til at lære nyt.

Du har gerne praktisk erfaring med at bruge AI som en aktiv del af udviklingsarbejdet på Databricks-platformen, for eksempel til kodegenerering, dokumentation, test, fejlretning eller optimering af notebooks.

Du lærer hurtigt nyt, både om domænet, teknologierne og de processer, vi arbejder efter. Du er nysgerrig og følger med i udviklingen inden for moderne datateknologi. Du trives i et agilt team, hvor samarbejde, faglig sparring og fælles ansvar er afgørende for succes.

Du har måske erfaring med flere dele af udviklingslivscyklussen og kan kommunikere tekniske løsninger til både tekniske og ikke-tekniske interessenter.

Du har arbejdet med teknologier som SQL, Python, Databricks, Azure, ETL/ELT, CI/CD, dimensionel modellering eller automatisering.

Du har måske også kendskab til Azure-komponenter som Storage, service principals, managed identities, sikkerhedsgrupper, Key Vault, Data Factory eller Functions.

Derudover er det en fordel, hvis du har interesse for datastruktur, datamodellering og arkitekturdesign.

Hvad vi tilbyder

Hos SEGES Innovation får du et job, hvor data, teknologi og faglig viden bliver brugt til at skabe konkrete løsninger for dansk landbrug og fødevareproduktion. Du kommer tæt på både forretningen, de faglige eksperter og de digitale produkter, som vores dataplatform understøtter.

Du bliver en del af Data & Analytics og et team med 7 Data Engineers, hvor vi udvikler løsninger i fællesskab gennem faglig sparring, code review og fælles ansvar for drift. Vi arbejder med moderne data- og AI-platformsløsninger og har fokus på kvalitet, skalerbarhed og løsninger, der kan bruges i praksis.

Du får mulighed for at sætte dit aftryk på, hvordan vi videreudvikler DataEstate-platformen og skaber bedre sammenhæng mellem forretning, data, teknologi og drift på tværs af SEGES Innovation.

Vi prioriterer en bæredygtig arbejdsrytme med fleksibilitet, mulighed for hjemmearbejdsdage og plads til både fordybelse, faglig udvikling og familieliv.

Ansøg nu

Lyder det interessant, og kan du se dig selv i rollen, så send din ansøgning og dit CV.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og tager opslaget ned, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Du kan læse mere om SEGES Digital her: https://segesinnovation.dk/landing-pages/et-it-job-med-mening/

Du kan se en tv-serie om, hvordan det er at arbejde i SEGES Digital, her: https://segesinnovation.dk/landing-pages/kodernes-kamp/

Ved rekruttering hos SEGES Innovation prioriterer vi primært din faglige ekspertise og personlighed. Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke, derfor opfordres alle med de rette kompetencer til at søge - uanset etnisk tilhørsforhold, religion, kønsidentitet og alder.

SEGES Innovation er en uafhængig forsknings- og innovationsvirksomhed, der arbejder for en bæredygtig og konkurrencedygtig landbrugs- og fødevareproduktion. Vi kobler faglige indsigter med digitale teknologier, så ny viden kommer ud at virke i stalden, på marken og i hele værdikæden fra jord til bord.

Vores mange forskellige eksperter udgør et unikt fagmiljø i international topklasse med ca. 500 dedikerede kolleger, der arbejder ud fra værdierne Mod, Hjerte og Dybde og i tæt samspil med Danmarks mere end 30.000 landbrug, universiteter og uddannelsesinstitutioner, landbrugsrådgivere, fødevareproducenter, energiselskaber og myndigheder.

description:

title: Hardware System Integration Electrical Engineer - Mac
description:
Apple is seeking a System EE for Mac Development platform electrical & system design integration. The candidate will design, implement, test, and debug the electrical subsystem of the world’s best all-in-one computers within a collaborative cross-functional team, working with mechanical engineering, software, silicon engineering, and other module teams such as wireless, camera, sensing, and display. Our engineers rely on skills in computer system architecture, schematic design, digital and analog circuits, power and voltage regulator integration, high speed signal integrity concepts, PCB design, bring up and system level troubleshooting to surprise and delight millions of customers!

Day to day tasks involve electrical design (both schematic capture and PCB layout), simulation, bringup, debug, and validation for Apple Silicon as it pertains to product implementation. EE’s are responsible for both schematic capture and coordinating layout of highly constrained multilayer PCBs including HDI and fine pitch BGAs. Routine responsibilities also include bring-up, validation, cross functional team support, and multi-disciplinary cross-functional collaboration and negotiation. We are looking for well-rounded candidates with a broad set of skill and interests, and the curiosity to dig deep wherever necessary to solve challenging problems. Opportunities exist to sample a variety of technology areas, and to remain general or specialize over time, developing domain expertise.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelors in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field of study with industry level practical work experience.
  • Strong EE fundamentals, grounded in a solid understanding of E&M physics and first principles with an understanding of computer / system architecture and the associated design tradeoffs.
  • Working knowledge of design and validation requirements for common low-speed and high-speed digital interfaces: I2C/SMBus, SPMI, SPI, I2S/TDM, USB, MIPI, PCIe, DisplayPort, Thunderbolt.
  • Experience using lab tools such as 25 GHz oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and instrumentation amplifiers to judge the quality and robustness of electrical designs. Experience with protocol decode.
  • Experience in circuit design for a variety of domains including power, digital, analog, high-speed communications, programmable logic, and/or wireless. Experience working closely with software and firmware teams on design bring-up, validation and test of electrical circuits and communication interfaces.
  • Work with constrained multilayer PCBs including HDI and fine pitch BGAs. Requires familiarity with Allegro or other PCB design tool. Experience designing for high-speed and high power system based cables and flex boards, Multi layer flexible PCBs and the ability to perform component data-sheet analysis and selection for schematic capture. Inclusive of both digital and analog design (power sensing, filtering, etc).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Schematic capture and constraint-driven PCB layout using Cadence tools or similar.
  • Experience with PCB bringup and debug, including new or custom silicon, using standard EE lab equipment: Soldering, DMM, Oscilloscope, Logic Analyzer.
  • Experience with complex data analysis, data visualization and script development.
  • Beyond technical aptitude, we prize curiosity, creativity, integrity, leadership, teamwork, and a passion for learning.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.

description:
Bring your Expertise to JPMorgan Chase. As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks, and using your expert judgement to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo and striving to be best-in-class.

As an Associate in Wholesale Credit Risk Loss Forecasting, you help influence loan loss estimation by supporting forecasting and stress analytics for credit hedges and held-for-sale loans. You partner with us across Business, Finance, Quantitative Research, and Technology to strengthen forecasting assumptions, improve analytics, and deliver timely stress testing outputs. You communicate results and key drivers in a clear, well-structured way to support decision-making across the first and second lines of defense.

Job Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain deep product knowledge of loan underwriting and syndication activities (with focus on Corporate and Infrastructure credit) as well as wholesale credit hedging strategies and instruments (e.g., CDS, indices, SRTs).
  • Conduct portfolio deep dive and risk analytics; Stay current on credit market conditions, macro themes, and relevant event-driven trends impacting the portfolio.
  • Review and challenge stress forecasts for hedge P&L and loss-mitigation benefit under internal and regulatory scenarios; support end-to-end stress testing production cycles for QST and CCAR.
  • Develop clear, well-structured management presentations summarizing stress results, key drivers, and walk/explain narratives for business and risk stakeholders.
  • Partner with Quantitative Research to refine modeling treatments and assumptions; become a subject matter resource on credit loss forecast parameters including Probability of Default, Loss Given Default, Rating Migration, and Mark-to-Market loss.
  • Lead UAT and implementation support for model enhancements, system migrations, and new functionality releases, including requirement definition, test design, execution, and issue triage.
  • Conduct ad hoc, transaction-level risk and stress estimates, and perform ongoing portfolio monitoring to identify emerging risks and forecast sensitivities.
  • Drive process efficiency through automation initiatives (including responsible use of LLMs/AI, where appropriate) to streamline forecasting, reporting, and controls.
  • Provide analytical support for risk review and challenge of new products, business initiatives, and stress methodology changes impacting the respective portfolios
  • Build and sustain strong stakeholder relationships across Business, Risk, Finance, Quantitative Research, and Technology, ensuring alignment on assumptions, timelines, and deliverables.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in credit risk, stress testing, risk analytics, model development, or similar roles.
  • Strong knowledge of loan and derivative products; familiarity with leveraged finance and credit hedging instruments strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to build effective working relationships across First Line and Second Line stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision; sound judgment on when to escalate; ability to perform under pressure and deliver under tight deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience preparing materials for senior management.
  • Strong technical skills, especially Excel, Tableau, and experience applying LLMs/AI to improve workflow efficiency; Python and automation experience is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to manipulate and analyze large datasets and translate results into clear messaging.

title: Scale Officer
description:
As a Scale Officer, you will enforce transportation legislation, policies and agreements for commercial vehicles travelling on Saskatchewan’s provincial highway system. You will be responsible for conducting inspections, laying charges, appearing in court, conducting investigations, and preparing reports. Your exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, promotion of a cooperative work environment and innovative approach will be required in order to interact with team members, other enforcement and government agencies, as well as the commercial transportation industry.

  • You will be required to successfully complete all training related to commercial vehicle enforcement, including the CVSA North American Standard Inspectors' course and complete use of force training to the standard of the Saskatchewan Police College.

As a public servant, we are seeking someone who:

  • Is innovative and seeks out ways for improvement by thinking creatively, identifying new ideas and taking responsible risks.

  • Is inclusive, identifies and is aware of personal bias, and readily seeks out and appreciates diverse perspectives.
  • Is adaptable, continuously learns from experience and applies those learnings to new situations.
  • Focuses on achieving public service excellence.

To qualify for this position, you will:

  • Be required to complete physical/medical assessments, which include passing the Sheriff Officers’ Physical Abilities Test (SOPAT)(Will accept POPAT/PARE times);
  • Possess a valid Canadian driver's license (Required to provide a copy of driver's license with application), and if selected for medical/physical testing, you will be required to provide a copy of a Certified Driver's Abstract on your scheduled testing date;
  • Possess a valid First Aid Certificate including AED that must be valid to May 2027 or beyond;
  • (Required to provide a valid certificate with the application); and,
  • Be required to pass a psychological personality assessment (MMPI) to determine suitability for law enforcement.

SOPAT Testing will be completed at the University of Saskatchewan on September 15, 2026 and September 29, 2026. Applicants MUST book their SOPAT if they do not have a valid, successful SOPAT/PARE/POPAT within the last 6 months.

You can register at: SOPAT/PARE/POPAT Testing - College of Kinesiology - University of Saskatchewan

Failing to attach a successful SOPAT/PARE/POPAT to your application will result in not advancing to the next stage in the application process.

title: School Health Aide
company: Health Care District of Palm Beach County
location: West Palm Beach, Palm Beach, United States
description:
This position, under the supervision and direction of a Registered Nurse, provides delegated student health care services within the School Health Program as Unlicensed Assistive Personnel. The primary function is to provide care during the school day to students for illness, injury, and medication administration.The duties include, but are not limited to first aid, medication administration, asthma, allergy, diabetes, seizure management, covid-19, and flu screening and testing. Employees in this position are responsible for performing non-licensed, competency-tested, delegated activities in compliance with procedures, protocols, and documented care plans.


Essential Functions:

  • Perform non-licensed and delegated Registered Nurse (RN) functions upon completion of training and competency testing.
  • Consult with the Registered Nurse for direction on non-delegated tasks.
  • Administer medications to students prescribed by a licensed health care provider with parental consent, following established protocols and care plans.
  • Properly receive, handle, and store medications; maintain temperature logs; manage medication expiration.
  • Provide first aid and injury care to students with urgent health needs according to procedures and protocols upon completion of training and competency testing.
  • Assist students with diabetes management upon completion of training and competency testing.
  • Assist students with allergy, asthma, and seizure management upon completion of training and competency testing.
  • Demonstrate skills and knowledge of infection control measures; maintain infection control and use of PPE as directed per School Health guidelines.
  • Administer COVID-19 and FLU tests with Parent/Guardian documented consent, upon completion of training and competency testing.
  • Float to other school locations to supplement and assist Registered Nurses or perform duties at another school location as required.
  • Document in student electronic health files care, treatments, and observations as directed.
  • Maintain proper filing of documentation.
  • Review and update student electronic health files, forwarding them to appropriate destinations when students transfer to another school within the District.
  • Navigate the electronic student health system, being proficient with a standard computer and keyboard, including but not limited to software programs.
  • Measure/take vital signs, blood pressure, and related data as defined in the physician's order and document.
  • Report all problems when observed to the Registered Nurse. Complete additional duties as assigned.


Additional Duties:
Emergency duties may be required that includes assisting community or hospital-based organizations or staffing emergency community shelters. Staff may be directed to perform other emergency duties based on clinical experience including, but not limited to, responses to threats or disasters, man-made or natural.

Access to reliable transportation required.

This job description reflects the general duties considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job as identified and shall not be considered as a complete description of all the work requirements and expectations that may be inherent in the position. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position. Management of the Health Care District of Palm Beach County reserves the right to assign duties not listed herein as necessary to accomplish the goals of the organization.

Education:

High school diploma or GED required. Either certificate or diploma from an accredited Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) program, Medical Assistant (MA) program, or Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) program required. Other clinical experience will be considered on a case-by-case basis in lieu of CNA, MA or EMT education requirements.

Experience:

Health care related experience preferred.

Certification:

Basic Life Support (BLS) certification from the American Heart Association required. First Aid Certification from either American Red Cross or the American Heart Association is required within 30 days of hire and will be offered on-site.

Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) or Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) in the State of Florida required. For Medical Assistants (MA), certification from AAMA, AMT, NHA, or NCCT preferred. In lieu of CNA, MA or EMT qualifications, other clinical experience will be considered on a case-by-case basis.

description:
The Senior Document Management Associate (SDMA) will provide support for Trial Master File (TMF) activities to the clinical teams for all assigned projects. This role will be responsible for working with study teams, both internal and external, to manage both paper and electronic Trial Master Files (TMF), according to project requirements, ICH GCP guidelines, local/global regulatory requirements and Novotech/Client SOPs. The SDMA will also be responsible for performing comprehensive QC reviews.

Responsibilities
1. Senior DMA will have a dual responsibility of working on document upload and document QC processes.
2. Senior DMA will also play an important role in mentoring and training the new DMA team.

SDMA as a document uploader
1. Will receive all study documentation for assigned projects; DMA will set up, receive, track and maintain electronic or paper TMFs according the requirements of ICH GCP and Novotech (or client) SOPs.
2. DMA will use all required study systems to ensure all study documents are filed appropriately throughout the entire study; including SharePoint and paper and electronic TMFs; all documents are to be scanned, uploaded, tracked and filed according to Novotech (or Clients) SOPs.
3. DMA will review each document as received for completeness and quality to ensure the document meets Novotech essential document requirements; will work with the project team to ensure study documents are of high quality.
4. DMA will provide reports on study document quality and collection practices of the team and provide updates to the study team to ensure all documents are collected in a timely manner.
5. Performs interim eTMF exports/uploads for the sponsor or 3rd party, if applicable to the assigned project.
6. Ensure the TMF is ‘inspection ready’ at all times and trial master file documents are filed contemporaneously in a timely manner, in accordance with project timelines.
7. Adheres to TMF SOPs, KPIs and relevant TMF process-supporting guidance.
8. Prepares monthly reports to ensure accuracy of the files and provides to the project teams.
9. Prepares the TMF for delivery at study closeout.
10. Reviews and prepares the TMF for audits and TMF reviews; Provide support to
the project team during audits and/or regulatory inspections.
11. Resolves any internal quality control findings and audit findings.
12. Runs and maintains department reports.
13. Creates checklists and daily quality control schedules.
14. Performs other special projects or tasks related to the TMF, which may include, but are not limited to, paper file location organization and archived study maintenance.
15. Be aware of and adhere to company processes in areas relevant to a DMA. Be quality minded in performance of duties. Adhere to Novotech policies and be mindful of the role of Novotech ambassador when carrying out DMA role.

17. Understand the responsibilities of Novotech as a service provider in the pharmaceutical industry and ensure all communications with external parties present a positive professional image of the company.

timeline.

title: Sr. Product Manager, Software
description:
We are seeking a Sr. Software Product Manager to lead our software-enabled hardware journey. Our devices have long earned customers' trust; we are building the software layer that extends that value across the workflow.

In this role, you will lead the way in defining and delivering software products our customers love. You will act as a bridge between our established hardware product organization and the software capabilities we are building around it. You will help define where software workflow solutions belong on the overall product roadmap, balance investment between bold feature innovations and the steady improvement of the core platform. You will establish software product management best practices needed to succeed— from product definition to sales enablement to customer implementations. This role is based in the U.S. and works closely with product, engineering, sales, and customer success teams around the world.

Who You Are

  • Experienced software product leader with a strong history of building workflow software that interacts with hardware devices.
  • Pragmatic bridge builder who can translate between hardware engineering culture and software product thinking
  • Strategic thinker who can balance bold new software initiatives against the discipline required to sustain a core platform.
  • Structured operator who can stand up new best practices — for product definition, sales, and implementation
  • Effective global collaborator, comfortable working across time zones, functions, and cultures

Key Responsibilities Software Roadmap Strategy & Integration

  • Partner with hardware product management, engineering, and executive leadership to integrate software workflow solutions into the company-wide product roadmap.
  • Assess where software creates the most customer and business value and translate that into a prioritized software roadmap.
  • Define and defend prioritization tradeoffs between strategic feature innovations and ongoing core platform improvements.
  • Build the business case for software investment, including ROI, adoption, and consideration of business models influenced by hardware.
  • Work with Product Planning team to explore bold innovative solutions and markets.
  • Work closely with hardware Product Managers where software creates value alongside devices in customer workflows.

Product Definition & Best Practices

  • Establish repeatable best practices for defining successful software workflow products and success metrics suited to hardware-adjacent software.
  • Create and maintain process and templates for defining and delivering value in each release.
  • Work very closely with Product Owners align on customer value, definition, scoping, and prioritization of feature backlog.
  • Champion a consistent software product release cycle that complements existing hardware NPI release plans.
  • Lead prioritization cadence to communicate software roadmap priorities, needs, and tradeoffs to leadership.

Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement

  • Partner with sales and commercial teams to define and refine ideal customer profiles and the sales process for hardware/software combined solutions.
  • Develop sales enablement materials, pricing frameworks, and tiered offerings that reflect customer needs.
  • Coach and enable the sales organization to position and sell workflow software alongside hardware.

Customer Implementation & Success

  • Work closely with and coach customer success and sales engineering teams on pre-sale nurturing and post-sale implementations, ensuring customer satisfaction.
  • Identify and resolve common points of friction in onboarding, adoption, and change management.
  • Gather customer feedback and usage data to continuously improve product definition and implementation practices.

Qualifications Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field
  • 7+ years of software product management experience, including direct experience managing workflow software products.
  • Demonstrated experience leading software products through transformational growth cycles.
  • Strong understanding of B2B sales processes, particularly for combined hardware/software solutions
  • Experience building or scaling software product management best practices.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with experience working across global teams and time zones.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%, domestically and internationally.

Preferred

  • MBA or equivalent strategic experience
  • Experience in a medical device, industrial, or other hardware-first industry undergoing digital product transformation.
  • Familiarity with IoT, connected devices, or embedded systems.

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers use and love our software products. Adoption and business outcomes are accelerating due to your leadership.
  • Bold software workflow solutions are integrated into the company's core product roadmap and portfolio prioritization process.
  • A clear, well-understood framework exists for balancing strategic innovation with core platform investments.
  • Sales and customer implementation teams have documented, repeatable best practices for hardware/software solutions.
  • The organization has a strong, reusable foundation for future software product development.

title: Water Sampling Technician
description:
Position Summary

I-2-I Solutions, Inc. is seeking a dependable and detail-oriented Water Quality Sampling Technician to support water quality monitoring activities at the VA Puget Sound Health Care System in Seattle and Tacoma, Washington.

The technician will perform field sampling associated with Legionella validation testing, dental waterline Heterotrophic Plate Count (HPC) testing, and Sterile Processing Services critical and utility water testing. The position requires accurate sample collection, field documentation, chain-of-custody control, coordination of sample shipment, and professional conduct within an active healthcare environment.

Sampling will be performed at:

  • Seattle Division: 1660 South Columbian Way, Seattle, WA 98108
  • American Lake Division: 9600 Veterans Drive SW, Tacoma, WA 98493

The work includes recurring monthly and quarterly sampling events, as well as follow-up or additional sampling when required by the project.

Primary Responsibilities

The Water Quality Sampling Technician will:

  • Perform quarterly Legionella environmental validation sampling from potable hot- and cold-water systems at locations designated by the VA.
  • Collect samples from assigned faucets, showers, ice machines, pure-cold-water sources, pure-hot-water sources, and other VA-designated locations.
  • Measure and accurately document applicable field parameters during Legionella sampling, including:
    • Water temperature
    • Residual disinfectant
    • pH
  • Perform quarterly dental unit waterline sampling for Heterotrophic Plate Count testing.
  • Perform water sample collection supporting Sterile Processing Services (SPS) testing, including:
    • Monthly critical-water sampling
    • Quarterly utility-water sampling
  • Collect samples supporting SPS analytical panels that include, as applicable, HPC, conductivity, hardness, alkalinity, pH, and endotoxin testing.
  • Accurately label all sample containers and record the exact sample collection location, date, time, and other required information.
  • Complete and maintain required chain-of-custody documentation.
  • Maintain sample integrity from collection through transfer or shipment to the laboratory.
  • Prepare and package samples for shipment in accordance with project and laboratory instructions and required processing timeframes.
  • Maintain accurate location information needed to support floor-plan or sampling-location documentation.
  • Coordinate with project management and VA personnel regarding access to sampling locations.
  • Perform sampling activities in a manner that minimizes disruption to hospital, clinical, dental, and Sterile Processing operations.
  • Support scheduled follow-up sampling, retesting, or supplementary validation sampling when assigned.
  • Promptly report sampling problems, access issues, sample integrity concerns, or other conditions that could affect successful testing.
  • Follow applicable VA infection-control and facility-access requirements.
  • Protect project and facility information and use only authorized access while working within VA facilities.

These responsibilities are derived from Tasks 3, 4, and 5 of the SOW, which establish quarterly Legionella sampling, monthly and quarterly SPS testing, and quarterly dental waterline HPC testing.

Required Qualifications

Candidates should have the ability to:

  • Accurately collect water samples using established sampling instructions and procedures.
  • Accurately complete sample labels, field records, and chain-of-custody documentation.
  • Use field measurement equipment for parameters such as temperature, pH, and disinfectant residual.
  • Maintain careful attention to sample identification and sampling locations.
  • Follow laboratory packaging, preservation, and shipping instructions.
  • Work independently while following an established sampling schedule and project instructions.
  • Communicate promptly with project management regarding sampling issues or deviations.
  • Travel reliably between work locations in Seattle and Tacoma when scheduled.
  • Work professionally within active healthcare and patient-care environments.
  • Successfully meet VA facility-access requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

The following experience is preferred but is not identified by the RFQ as a mandatory sampler qualification:

  • Previous environmental or water-quality sampling experience.
  • Experience collecting Legionella samples.
  • Experience with HPC or microbiological water samples.
  • Experience collecting water samples in hospitals, healthcare facilities, dental clinics, or Sterile Processing environments.
  • Familiarity with chain-of-custody procedures.
  • Familiarity with ISO 11731, Standard Methods 9215C, or ANSI/AAMI ST108 sampling programs.
  • Previous experience working at VA or other federal healthcare facilities.

Federal Facility Access Requirements

This position involves work inside Department of Veterans Affairs facilities. The successful candidate must be able to comply with applicable VA security and access requirements, including:

  • Fingerprinting
  • Background investigation
  • Favorable adjudication
  • VA-issued identification/badge requirements
  • Authorized-access requirements
  • Applicable infection-control risk-mitigation measures

These requirements are expressly included in Section 7 of the SOW.

Expected Sampling Schedule

This position supports recurring sampling activities under the project, including:

Sampling ActivityFrequency
Legionella Validation SamplingQuarterly
SPS Critical Water SamplingMonthly
SPS Utility Water SamplingQuarterly
Dental Waterline HPC SamplingQuarterly
Corrective/Follow-Up SamplingAs required

Exact sampling dates and work hours will be coordinated based on the approved project schedule and VA facility access.

title: Learning Experience Lead
description:
About the team

Our Learning team shape how colleagues build the functional, technical and management capabilities needed across Argos. Together, the team turns business priorities and colleague insight into practical, inclusive learning experiences that make a measurable difference.

More about the role

As Learning Experience Lead, you will translate commercial and organisational objectives into high-level learning experiences and pathways. You will define clear learning and performance outcomes, recommend the right blend of formal, social, informal and on-the-job learning, and apply the 70/20/10 model alongside adult learning, cognitive and behavioural design principles.

Day to day, you’ll consult with senior stakeholders and external partners, lead colleague listening and analyse internal and external evidence to form impact-led hypotheses. You’ll shape proof-of-concept pilots, define evaluation measures, and use feedback and performance data to refine solutions.

More about you

You are an experienced learning design specialist who can connect business context, learner needs and delivery constraints. You use evidence to make sound design decisions, can explain the rationale behind your recommendations, and are confident influencing stakeholders in a complex, matrixed organisation. You are comfortable briefing and guiding cross-functional teams, mentoring learning designers and solving complex learning challenges

You take ownership, challenge constructively and use business context to make decisions. You stay curious, test new approaches and simplify where possible. You listen carefully, seek feedback and build trusted relationships by showing care and respect for different perspectives. title: Head of Engineering
description:
Why join us


As the Head of Engineering for ML and AI, you'll be a trusted voice for technology and innovation within our business community. With over 2000 locations, and 100,000 + colleagues, you will engage and manage stakeholders, teams, and suppliers to deliver exceptional experiences for our customers and colleagues. As a trusted leader of leaders, you will foster a high-performance, inclusive culture, ensuring your teams operate in an empowered and professional environment. With a focus on people leadership, engagement, and communication, you will lead the evolution of our teams towards agile ways of working, drive delivery excellence, and champion technical excellence.

About the Team

The ML & AI family is expected to grow considerably over Beyond Next Level, spanning both the expansion of core platform capabilities and the delivery of production machine learning and AI solutions into the business. The remit encompasses ML Platforms, AI Gateways, Responsible AI controls, model lifecycle management, reusable AI services in data space and the engineering delivery of machine learning models that support strategic business outcomes including our Boulders, Big Rocks and Big Bets. As adoption accelerates, the technical complexity, operational accountability and scale of delivery will increase significantly, requiring dedicated senior engineering leadership to own architecture, engineering standards, platform reliability and delivery execution. The Head of Engineering role provides the leadership required to scale both the platforms and the engineering delivery capability in a controlled and sustainable manner, ensuring Sainsbury's can rapidly industrialise AI whilst maintaining resilience and engineering excellence.

What you'll do

  • Building strong relationships with business and tech leaders, you will be the trusted voice for technology, innovation, and modern agile ways of working within your respective business community.
  • Working with Data Scientists community to build reusable ML capabilities on the platform
  • Working with wider Tech to put models on Production for large scale of users
  • You'll lead and mentor teams of engineers to deliver unique and differentiating products, fostering a culture of innovation and high technical standards.
  • You will be accountable for the processes and path to production and deployment of change, ensuring that all new and enhanced products and platforms are released seamlessly and in line with business change plans.
  • As a leader, you will build strong relationships, drive continuous improvement, and champion the concept of expert, stable, and integrated teams.
  • Your success will be measured by the quality of relationships established, successful alignment of product priorities and outcomes, technical excellence demonstrated, and the delivery of customer value and business outcomes at pace.

Who you are

  • You're a strategic leader who knows how to build great relationships across a business.
  • With your deep understanding of both the technology landscape and retail/ logistics operations, you play a pivotal role in ensuring the delivery of unique and differentiating products to millions of customers.
  • Leading and mentoring teams of engineers, you champion agile ways of working, foster a culture of innovation, and continuously strive for improved outcomes and value.
  • Your ability to make sound judgments, manage budgets, and make data-driven decisions allows you to drive maximum efficiency and effectiveness within your teams and deliver customer value at pace.
  • With your passion for technology, and results-oriented mindset, you empower your teams to perform at their best and deliver high-quality solutions that align with the overall business strategy.
  • You are a visionary leader who continuously stays relevant in the ever-changing technology landscape, and you make decisive decisions to drive success.

Essential Criteria

  • 10+ years in software/data engineering, with 4+ years in senior engineering leadership
  • Proven experience building and scaling ML platforms (training, serving, feature stores, experimentation/model monitoring)
  • Hands-on depth in distributed data systems
  • Working knowledge of modern AI infrastructure – LLM gateways, vector/semantic search, RAG pipelines, or agentic frameworks
  • Track record of setting technical strategy and driving architectural decisions across multiple teams
  • Strong stakeholder management – able to translate between data science, product, executive stakeholders

Desirable

We’d all like amazing work to do, and real work-life balance. That’s waiting for you at Sainsbury’s. Think about the scale it takes to feed the nation. We’ve made significant investment in the standards and principles that shape how we work. We iterate, learn, experiment and champion ways of working such as Agile, Scrum and XP. So you can look forward to exciting opportunities across everything from AI to reusable tech.

We are committed to being a truly inclusive retailer, so you’ll be welcomed whoever you are and wherever you work. Around here, there’s always the chance to try something new - whether that’s as part of an evolving team or somewhere else across the business - and we take development seriously and promise to support you. We also recognise and celebrate colleagues when they go the extra mile and, where possible, offer flexible working. When you join our team, we’ll also offer you an amazing range of benefits. Starting off with colleague discount, you'll be able to get 10% off at Sainsbury's, Argos, TU and Habitat after 4 weeks. Moments that matter are as important to us as they are to you which is why we give up to 26 weeks’ pay for maternity or adoption leave and up to 4 weeks’ pay for paternity leave.

title: Senior Pedestrian Modeller, Movement Strategies
description:
Shape the future of how people move.

At GHD, our Movement Strategies team helps create safer, more connected and more vibrant communities by understanding how people move through urban environments. We combine pedestrian modelling, movement planning, spatial analytics and strategic advisory services to help clients make informed decisions about transport networks, public spaces, precincts, venues and major infrastructure investments.

Our specialists work across a diverse range of projects, from transport hubs, city centres and major events to healthcare campuses, education facilities, commercial developments and public realm improvements. Through evidence-based insights, advanced modelling tools and innovative thinking, we help clients create places that are accessible, inclusive and designed around people.

The opportunity

We're looking for an experienced Senior Pedestrian Modeller/ Senior Consultant – Movement Strategies to join our growing team. In this role, you'll work with multidisciplinary teams to deliver technically robust and client-focused movement strategies that influence the planning, design and operation of some of the most significant major games, complex infrastructure and building services projects in Australia.

You will take a lead role in delivering pedestrian modelling and movement planning projects, while also contributing to business development, client engagement and the growth of our emerging Movement Strategies capability.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about creating better places through the application of data, analytics and human-centred design principles.

This diverse and exciting role will see you working on national and international projects, with responsibilities including:

  • Lead pedestrian modelling, crowd movement and people flow projects, including the development, calibration and interpretation of simulation models and strategic movement assessments.

  • Undertake spatial and network analysis and provide strategic advice on connectivity, accessibility and pedestrian performance across transport, precinct, urban development and infrastructure projects.

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary specialists to develop integrated solutions and prepare high-quality technical reports, presentations and client deliverables.

  • Manage project tasks, budgets and timelines to ensure technical quality and client satisfaction, while supporting proposals, business development and client relationships.

  • Mentor junior team members, build capability and contribute to innovation, research and thought leadership in pedestrian modelling and movement planning.

What would you bring to the team?

  • A relevant degree in transport planning, civil engineering, urban planning, geography, mathematics, data science, architecture, urban design or a related discipline; postgraduate qualifications will be highly regarded.

  • Experience in pedestrian modelling, crowd analysis or movement and transport planning, supported by a strong understanding of pedestrian behaviour, active transport principles, industry standards and best practice.

  • Proficiency in modelling and analytics platforms such as Legion, MassMotion, Viswalk, Pathfinder, GIS or similar tools.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and report-writing skills, with the ability to interpret complex technical data and translate findings into practical recommendations.

  • Demonstrated success delivering multidisciplinary projects to deadline, building trusted stakeholder and client relationships, and collaborating with and mentoring others.

We will consider candidates to work in any of GHD’s Australian offices; however Melbourne is our preference.

title: Flexible Side Work for Drivers- One Store Visit Weekly
description:
Get Paid to Drive Your Route. Work When It Works for You.

Field Technician — FreshPure Water Machines

1099 Independent Contractor | $28/hr | HADDON TOWNSHIP, NJ

If you like working independently, hate being stuck at a desk, and want a consistent route you can count on — this might be exactly what you’re looking for.

NWS operates water vending machines in retail stores across the country. We’re building a team of Field Technicians in HADDON TOWNSHIP, NJ to keep those machines clean, stocked, and running right. It’s straightforward work, it pays well, and you’re in charge of your own time.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

Each week (or every two weeks, depending on the location), you’ll visit your assigned stores and:

  • Clean and disinfect the FreshPure machine inside and out
  • Take meter readings and log the data on your service report
  • Snap photos of the machine condition at every visit
  • Submit your completed report to the home office when you’re done
  • Call in anything that looks off — damage, mechanical issues, anything unusual

That’s it. Each stop takes about an hour. Your total hours per week depend on how many stores are on your route.

What Makes This Different from Other Gig Work

  • Consistent, scheduled route — not random job pickups
  • Same stores every week, so you know exactly where you’re going
  • $28/hr all-in — your mileage and travel are already baked into the rate
  • Supplies provided — we give you everything you need to do the job
  • Real support — a home office contact you can actually reach

This Is NOT a Repair Job

You’re not expected to fix anything. If a machine has a mechanical or technical issue, you flag it and we send a Service Technician. Your job is to keep things clean, documented, and reported — that’s where your value is.

What You Need to Get Started

  • A reliable vehicle and a valid driver’s license
  • A smartphone with a camera for photo submissions
  • Attention to detail — you follow the checklist, every time
  • You show up when you’re scheduled. That’s the most important thing.

No experience in water systems required. If you’ve done field services, retail merchandising, delivery routes, janitorial work, or anything similar — you’ll hit the ground running.

Who Thrives in This Role

This is a great fit if you’re already doing gig work and want something more predictable layered in, or if you’re looking for flexible part-time income that fits around your schedule. People who do well here tend to be:

  • Self-starters who don’t need someone looking over their shoulder
  • Detail-oriented — you notice things other people miss
  • Reliable — your stores count on you showing up
  • Good communicators — you keep the home office in the loop

How to Apply

Click “Apply Now” to be directed to our application. It only takes a few minutes to complete.

If we’re moving forward, you’ll hear from us by email. Interviews are conducted virtually via Microsoft Teams — we’ll send you a calendar invite with everything you need.

You can also view all open positions across our locations at:

freshpure.com/careers

title: Senior Hydrogeologist
description:
Your Opportunity

Stantec is seeking dynamic and creative candidates to join our growing Geosciences Team as a Senior Hydrogeologist. The Senior Hydrogeologist will take a technical lead role and execute unsaturated and saturated flow modeling and related projects for mining studies/projects of varying size and complexity, and at various project stages from initial concepts through execution. This person may be required to work on several projects at a time. We support clients in all phases of the mining life cycle, from exploration through post-closure.

The Senior Hydrogeologist will join a team of about 20 hydrogeologists and geochemists across our western regional offices. This position will require a passionate and organized individual who can interface and develop relationships with our mining clients; develop and lead teams; develop project scopes, budgets, and schedules; develop and lead site investigations and characterization; execute and review calculations; construct and simulate saturated and unsaturated flow models; and prepare expertly written reports. This individual will interact throughout the organization internally and externally with clients and members of business and professional organizations.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Work with hydrogeologists, geochemists, and geotechnical engineers, to develop conceptual site models, develop analytical and numerical models of unsaturated and saturated groundwater flow, and design evapotranspiration cover systems.
  • Develop mine water management approaches including water budgets, mine dewatering, waste material impoundments, and groundwater containment/mitigation.
  • Work with clients to deliver safe, responsible, and innovative solutions.
  • Attend meetings and interface with clients, agencies, external consultants, contractors, sub-contractors, and/or vendors.
  • Conduct quality assurance and quality control on their own projects and projects of peers.
  • Prepare technical reports.
  • Support business development efforts and proposal preparation.
  • Contribute to an innovative and collaborative work environment where creativity is valued and encouraged.
  • Supervise and mentor junior staff members and support hiring new talents.
  • International or national travel can be expected.

Your Capabilities and Credentials

  • Expertise in unsaturated flow modeling using HYDRUS or SVFlux is essential.
  • Expertise in saturated flow modeling using MODFLOW and/or FEFLOW.
  • Strong expertise in evapotranspiration cover design.
  • Ability to lead evapotranspiration cover design projects.
  • Experience in marketing and preparing proposals and presentations.
  • Ability to mentor junior to mid-level staff.
  • Strong technical report writing skills.
  • Ability to work on several projects or tasks during any given day on a consistent basis.
  • Ability to manage time, be organized, and set priorities.
  • Possess strong problem-solving skills and ability to make timely decisions.
  • Excellent organizational skills.
  • Ability to perform in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
  • Be a driver of a positive work environment.
  • Valid driver’s license.

Education and Experience

  • Minimum of an M.S. in Hydrogeology/Geology/Geochemistry or related field is preferred.
  • A minimum of 10 years of working experience in consulting or regulatory environment, regularly developing or utilizing unsaturated and saturated flow models is preferred.
  • Existing professional registration or ability to work towards a professional registration (PG or PE).

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Charger logistics Inc. is a world- class asset-based carrier with locations across North America. With over 20 years of experience providing the best logistics solutions, Charger logistics has transformed into a world-class transport provider and continue to grow.

We are looking for a highly motivated AI Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development of AI-driven solutions for various departments. This role focuses on building production AI agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations that automate real logistics workflows—dispatch, billing, compliance, and fleet operations—improving the reliability, transparency, and efficiency of AI applications in real-world, high-stakes environments.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and deploy MCP servers exposing domain services as AI-consumable tools with proper authentication, observability, and error handling.
  • Build multi-agent workflows using orchestration frameworks and agent-to-agent communication protocols for complex logistics automation.
  • Develop and optimize knowledge retrieval pipelines using RAG, KAG, and CAG strategies—selecting the right approach based on query complexity, data volatility, and domain reasoning requirements.
  • Design hybrid retrieval architectures that route between CAG for static reference data, RAG for dynamic operational queries, and KAG for multi-hop reasoning across structured domain knowledge.
  • Implement LLM integration layers—prompt engineering, function calling, structured output parsing, and model routing for domain accuracy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to collect requirements and translate operational workflows into agent capabilities.
  • Deploy and maintain agent infrastructure on Kubernetes with GitOps practices and observability tooling.

Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of experience with Bachelor's in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field.
  • Strong communication skills and experience working in interdisciplinary or team-based environments.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices architecture, and AI/ML concepts.
  • Experience building production-grade AI applications in Python—not just notebooks or prototypes.
  • Hands-on proficiency with LLM integration: function calling, tool use, structured outputs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google APIs).
  • Solid understanding of knowledge retrieval patterns including RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), with familiarity of emerging approaches like KAG (Knowledge-Augmented Generation) and CAG (Cache-Augmented Generation).
  • Proficiency with SQL and at least one analytical data platform (BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar).
  • Experience with cloud platforms and container orchestration (Kubernetes).
  • Background in MCP, agent orchestration frameworks, knowledge graphs, or streaming data systems is a strong asset.

  • Healthcare Benefit Package
  • Career Growth
