title: Groundman - Overhead
description:
Position Summary

The Groundman position is your first step to a rewarding career in the construction and maintenance of our nation's Power Grid. You will assist your team in building, repairing, and maintaining overhead electrical distribution systems. You will report to the Foreman.

Essential Functions

  • Perform new construction, maintain and repair overhead distribution systems while putting safety first.

  • Help install and repair overhead power lines, poles, insulators, conductors and related hardware.

  • Maintain company vehicles, equipment and tools in good working order.

  • Work outdoors in varying environmental conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, wind, and inclement weather.

  • Available to work outages, storms, emergencies including on call rotation.

  • Follow all safety protocols including PPE use and a comprehensive understanding of insulated protective cover to isolate differences of potential.

  • Inspect rubber goods and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

  • Understanding of when to wear personal protective equipment.

  • Will perform rigorous physical labor.

Minimum Requirements

  • Valid Driver's License and able to obtain a CDL within 60 days.

  • Willing to travel long distances on short notice.

  • Lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

  • Work for extended periods at job locations, including out‑of‑state assignments.

  • Willing to work outside of normal business hours, including weekends, holidays, emergency callouts, and overtime.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you will be required to talk, listen and use hand signals to communicate. The job frequently requires you to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle objects, operate tools or controls; reach with hands and arms.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you are frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. You are occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at construction job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. You will perform job responsibilities in extreme heat, cold, wet, windy, and storm conditions.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

  • HSA, dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability

  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and family and medical leave

If this sounds like you, come join the PIKE family.

About Us

Founded in 1945, Pike is a leading provider of construction, repair and engineering services for electric and gas utilities, as well as telecommunications companies with a growing portfolio of turnkey renewable projects. We work with hundreds of utility clients across the country, and we continuously expand our offerings to supply our customers with the ideas, technology, experience, workforce and equipment to perform any job.

"Essential" is the one word that sums up who we are, the work we do and what our people mean to us. Each of our employees plays a critical role in ensuring that infrastructure systems are up and running when people and businesses need them.

Pike is a family-oriented workplace with a strong culture of safety, collaboration, innovation and exceptional customer service.

title: Correctional Officer
description:
Do your Career Justice. Become a Correctional Officer.
About Us
The Ministry of Community Safety is responsible for overseeing Saskatchewan's correctional system and facilities, providing the safe and secure custody of adult and youth offenders and delivering programs that promote safety and reduce re-offending.
As corrections professionals, our Vision is to provide correctional services that improve lives. Our Mission is to deliver programs and services to help ensure safe communities, safe facilities and a safe and engaged workforce. We believe our core Values provide the foundation for who we are and what we do. We value modelling respect and integrity, serving citizens, practicing excellence and innovation, while acting as one team.

Why a Career as a Correctional Officer is Rewarding

  • Directly contribute to creating safer communities in Saskatchewan;
  • Aid in positive and meaningful change for adult offenders;
  • Collaborate with a supportive interdisciplinary team of professionals to deliver needs-based services that facilitate rehabilitation;
  • Engage in meaningful relationships that improve the ability of adult offenders to successfully reintegrate into their community and reduce re-offending.



The Opportunity
Whitespruce Provincial Training Centre is hiring and invites you to join our team!
Correctional Officers are professionals who work directly with adult offenders, holding them accountable and supporting positive change in their lives, while maintaining the safe and secure operation of the facility.

  • Be responsible for the safety and security of facility through monitoring, supervising, and interacting with offenders in various correctional settings;
  • Work collaboratively in the creation and implementation of case plans for reintegration into the community;
  • Lead offenders in daily programming and promote personal development in decision making and problem-solving skills;
  • Work closely with adults who may have intergenerational trauma, special needs, gender differences and various cultural and spiritual beliefs;
  • Accurately interpret and apply legislation, policy, and procedures;
  • Apply a collaborative approach that promotes interdisciplinary teamwork;
  • Continuously assess situational factors, and evaluate the level of risk, to make sound and appropriate decisions;
  • Prevent, respond to, and resolve incidents, using the safest and most reasonable intervention strategies.

Job Capabilities

For this role in Community Safety, we are seeking someone who:

  • Is accountable, takes ownership of their work by contributing to organizational outcomes and demonstrates the corporate values in our Commitment to Excellence.
  • Is innovative and seeks out ways for improvement by thinking creatively, identifying new ideas and taking responsible risks.
  • Works collaboratively with others to understand, engage and have meaningful dialogue to achieve work outcomes.
  • Is inclusive, identifies and is aware of personal bias, and readily seeks out and appreciates diverse perspectives.
  • Is adaptable, continuously learns from experience and applies those learnings to new situations.
  • Focuses on achieving public service excellence.


Technical Knowledge and Skills

  • Knowledge of the Canadian criminal justice system;
  • Knowledge of human behaviour to support positive change;
  • A valid Saskatchewan issued Class 5 Driver’s License or equivalent;
  • A valid First Aid and CPR/AED certificate with no less than 12 months remaining before expiration is required prior to the ITP start date.

Typically, the capabilities and skills required for this position would be obtained through a university degree in Social Sciences or closely related discipline, a diploma in Law Enforcement and/or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.


Physical Requirements

The COPAT requirement for employment has been temporarily replaced by a comprehensive medical evaluation completed by a licensed medical practitioner.
Should you receive a successful offer of employment, you will be enrolled into a paid, 11-week Induction Training Program (ITP). The next ITP will start on February 8, 2027.
To learn more about this employment opportunity and the Induction Training Program, please attend our Virtual Public Information Session on September 17, 2026, at 12:00 PM. Details can be found here.

Job Skills

  • Communication (Level C)
  • Critical Thinking (Level C)
  • Digital Skills (Level B)
  • Interacting with Others (Level C)
  • Navigating Ambiguity (Level B)
  • Managing Self (Level C)
  • Health, Safety and Wellness (Level A)
  • Data Literacy (Level C)
  • Influence (Level C)

Database Administrator (Computer Science or Similar Majors Required):

Coordinates pre-production activities including processing orders, quoting pricing, developing new product schedules, coordinating tooling, ensuring part readiness, etc. Assists with program timing and related activities including design changes, build out of vehicle, part number changes, obsolescence claims and packaging approvals.

title: Controller
description:
Controller
Full-Time | On-Site

Lead the Accounting Function. Influence the Business. Grow into Executive Leadership.
Are you a hands-on accounting leader who wants more than managing the numbers—you want the opportunity to help shape the business?

L&M Corrugated is seeking a Controller to lead our Accounting team and partner closely with our CFO on financial strategy, operational performance, and long-term growth.
This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll oversee the day-to-day accounting function while also having a voice in bigger-picture business decisions. From financial reporting and cost accounting to budgeting, audits, capital planning, and process improvement, you'll play an important role in helping L&M continue to grow.

For someone interested in taking the next step in their career, this position also offers a path toward future executive leadership.

Why Join L&M?
✅ Direct Partnership with the CFO
✅ Path to Executive Leadership
✅ Meaningful Ownership of the Accounting Function
✅ Opportunity to Influence Strategic Business Decisions
✅ Profit Sharing Program
✅ Employee Referral Bonus Program
✅ Tuition Assistance Program
✅ Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays
✅ 401(k) with Company Match
✅ Growing Family-Owned Company with a Team-Oriented Culture

What You'll Do
As Controller, you'll lead the accounting team and own the accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of L&M's financial reporting while remaining actively involved in the day-to-day financial operations of the business.
Responsibilities include:
  • Leading and developing the accounting team through coaching, guidance, and performance feedback
  • Partnering closely with the CFO on financial strategy, business decisions, and process improvements
  • Preparing, analyzing, and presenting accurate monthly and annual financial statements
  • Managing cost accounting processes and ensuring accurate product costing
  • Leading the annual budgeting and financial planning process
  • Managing fixed assets and supporting capital budgeting and investment decisions
  • Overseeing inventory control, physical inventory counts, and reconciliation
  • Coordinating and leading the annual audit process with external auditors
  • Ensuring compliance with GAAP and applicable accounting requirements
  • Preparing financial reporting for lending, compliance, and other business needs
  • Identifying opportunities for cost reduction, improved controls, and greater efficiency
  • Supporting the continued development of accounting processes, systems, and reporting
  • Collaborating with Quality, Operations, and other departments to support company-wide goals
  • Performing other duties as assigned

What We're Looking For
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting required
  • CPA strongly preferred
  • 6-10 years of progressive accounting experience, preferably within a manufacturing environment
  • 2-3+ years of experience in a financial management or accounting leadership role
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing accounting and cost accounting
  • Demonstrated experience with financial reporting, budgeting, audits, and inventory
  • In-depth knowledge of GAAP and financial reporting standards
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to develop and support a team
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities
  • Strong attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of the bigger business picture
  • Proficiency with accounting and reporting systems and Microsoft Office
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality
  • Corrugated packaging or related industry experience is a plus

Make an Impact at L&M
At L&M Corrugated, the Controller is more than the person responsible for the financial statements. You'll serve as a key partner to the CFO, lead an important business function, and help provide the financial insight needed to guide company decisions.
As L&M continues to grow, this role offers the opportunity to grow with us—developing your strategic leadership skills, expanding your influence across the organization, and positioning yourself for future executive leadership.
If you're a hands-on accounting leader who is ready to take ownership, develop a team, and have a meaningful voice in the future of a growing family-owned company, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of the L&M Corrugated team.

title: Dispatch Assistant - Fastfrate Group (Lachine)
description:
Fastfrate est un employeur souscrivant au principe de l’égalité d’accès à l’emploi et s’engage à créer un milieu de travail diversifié, inclusif et accessible. Nous encourageons les femmes, les membres des minorités visibles, les peuples autochtones, les personnes en situation de handicap ainsi que toutes les personnes qualifiées à soumettre leur candidature.
Si vous avez besoin de mesures d’adaptation à une étape quelconque du processus de recrutement, veuillez communiquer avec nous à accessibility@challenger.com. Nous travaillerons avec vous afin de répondre à vos besoins.
Profil de l’entreprise Fastfrate:
Le Groupe Fastfrate est l’un des plus importants fournisseurs privés de services de transport et de logistique en Amérique du Nord. Fort de son engagement envers l’innovation, la rapidité et la fiabilité, notre réseau national relie les principaux marchés nord-américains grâce à des solutions intégrées de transport ferroviaire et routier, offrant ainsi à nos clients la force d’un partenaire logistique à service complet.
Du transport par chargement complet (TL) et par chargement partiel (LTL) au transport de conteneurs, à l’entreposage, à l’exécution des commandes et à la livraison du dernier kilomètre, le Groupe Fastfrate offre de véritables solutions du port à la porte. Notre modèle de services intégrés assure un soutien fluide et complet en matière de transport et de logistique, conçu pour faire progresser les activités de nos clients.
Faire partie du Groupe Fastfrate, c’est bénéficier de possibilités de carrière enrichissantes, de perfectionnement professionnel et de l’occasion de contribuer à une entreprise qui joue un rôle essentiel dans le transport des marchandises partout au Canada.
Pourquoi vous aimerez travailler avec nous:
  • Un milieu de travail où vous pouvez apprendre, évoluer et bâtir votre carrière.
  • Une culture qui encourage les nouvelles idées et l’amélioration continue.
  • Des gestionnaires qui vous offrent du soutien et des conseils tout en favorisant votre autonomie.
  • Un environnement axé sur le travail d’équipe.
  • Une rémunération globale concurrentielle, comprenant des avantages sociaux collectifs et un régime d’épargne-retraite parrainé par l’entreprise.
  • Du soutien pour les adhésions professionnelles, la formation et les certifications.
L’occasion:
Voici votre chance de vous joindre à une équipe où votre travail a un réel impact. Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez directement au succès de nos clients, de nos opérations et du Groupe Fastfrate dans son ensemble. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement favorable qui valorise la collaboration, la résolution de problèmes et l’apprentissage continu.
Sommaire du poste:
L’adjoint(e) à la répartition fournit un soutien administratif et opérationnel quotidien à l’équipe de répartition afin de contribuer au mouvement efficace des marchandises et à la réalisation ponctuelle des livraisons et des cueillettes. La personne titulaire du poste participe à la coordination des chauffeurs, au suivi des expéditions, à la mise à jour des systèmes, à la gestion de la documentation ainsi qu’aux communications entre les chauffeurs et les différents services internes.
Dans un environnement de transport LTL dynamique et au rythme soutenu, l’adjoint(e) à la répartition veille à maintenir des renseignements précis et à jour sur les expéditions, répond aux demandes courantes des chauffeurs et des équipes opérationnelles et transmet au répartiteur les problèmes de service ou les situations exceptionnelles nécessitant une intervention.
Heures de travail:
Du lundi au vendredi, de 10 h à 18 h
Mode de travail:
Sur place
Type de poste:
Syndiqué ou non syndiqué
Statut d’emploi:
Permanent
Rémunération:
Échelle salariale : de 38 400 $ à 48 000 $
Lieu et environnement de travail:
4420, rue Fairway, Lachine (Québec); environnement d’entrepôt et de quai
Principales responsabilités:
Dans ce rôle, vous devrez :
  • Fournir un soutien administratif et opérationnel quotidien à l’équipe de répartition.
  • Aider à communiquer aux chauffeurs les renseignements relatifs aux cueillettes, aux livraisons, aux itinéraires et aux autres activités de répartition.
  • Surveiller les communications des chauffeurs et transmettre les renseignements pertinents au répartiteur ou aux autres services, au besoin.
  • Effectuer le suivi des cueillettes et des livraisons afin de contribuer au respect des échéanciers prévus.
  • Surveiller l’état des expéditions et mettre à jour les systèmes de gestion du transport et de répartition avec des renseignements précis et en temps opportun.
  • Aider à coordonner les chauffeurs pour les cueillettes et les livraisons prévues, selon les directives du répartiteur.
  • Communiquer avec les chauffeurs concernant les renseignements courants sur les expéditions, les documents, les directives de livraison et les mises à jour de statut.
  • Repérer les expéditions retardées, manquées ou autrement touchées et transmettre les situations exceptionnelles au répartiteur afin qu’elles soient résolues.
  • Soutenir l’équipe de répartition dans le suivi des chauffeurs tout au long du quart de travail.
  • Aider à préparer, organiser et tenir à jour les documents de répartition, les manifestes, les feuilles de route, les documents de livraison et les autres dossiers opérationnels.
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes du service à la clientèle, des opérations, du quai/de l’entrepôt et des autres services afin de communiquer les mises à jour concernant les expéditions et d’obtenir les renseignements nécessaires.
  • Répondre aux demandes courantes concernant l’état des expéditions et des livraisons et diriger les questions plus complexes vers le membre approprié de l’équipe.
  • Saisir et tenir à jour des renseignements précis sur les chauffeurs, les expéditions, les cueillettes et les livraisons dans les systèmes de l’entreprise.
  • Aider à examiner les cueillettes et les livraisons en suspens et effectuer les suivis demandés.
  • Soutenir la coordination des livraisons sur rendez-vous, des exigences particulières de livraison ou des directives propres aux clients.
  • S’assurer que les documents requis sont reçus des chauffeurs et qu’ils sont traités ou transmis de façon appropriée.
  • Tenir des dossiers de répartition électroniques et/ou papier organisés et précis.
  • Fournir un soutien général de bureau et administratif aux équipes de répartition et des opérations.
  • Respecter les politiques, les procédures et les exigences de sécurité de l’entreprise.
  • Effectuer toute autre tâche connexe qui lui est confiée.
Qualifications
Nous recherchons une personne possédant les qualifications suivantes :
Formation et expérience :
  • Diplôme d’études secondaires ou l’équivalent requis.
  • Une expérience antérieure dans le domaine du transport, de la logistique, de la répartition, du service à la clientèle ou dans un environnement administratif est considérée comme un atout.
  • Une expérience antérieure dans un environnement de transport LTL est considérée comme un atout.
  • Une connaissance de la terminologie du transport, des connaissements, des manifestes, des processus de cueillette et de livraison ainsi que de la documentation relative au transport de marchandises constitue un atout.
  • Une expérience avec des systèmes de gestion du transport ou de répartition est considérée comme un atout.
  • Une expérience antérieure en communication avec des chauffeurs commerciaux est considérée comme un atout.
Compétences et aptitudes :
  • Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et capacité à gérer plusieurs tâches et priorités simultanément.
  • Grand souci du détail et engagement à maintenir des dossiers et des renseignements exacts dans les systèmes.
  • Excellentes aptitudes à communiquer, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit.
  • Aisance à communiquer avec les chauffeurs et les différents services internes tout au long de la journée.
  • Capacité à travailler efficacement dans un environnement de transport dynamique où les délais sont importants.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en service à la clientèle et en relations interpersonnelles.
  • Capacité à reconnaître les problèmes opérationnels et à les transmettre de façon appropriée afin qu’ils soient résolus.
  • Capacité à suivre les processus et les directives établis tout en travaillant de façon autonome dans l’exécution des responsabilités courantes.
  • Excellentes compétences informatiques et en saisie de données, ainsi qu’une capacité à apprendre à utiliser les systèmes de gestion du transport et de répartition.
  • Esprit de collaboration et capacité à travailler efficacement au sein des équipes de répartition et des opérations.
Comment postuler :
Si vous souhaitez vous joindre à notre équipe, veuillez soumettre votre candidature par l’entremise de notre portail de carrières en ligne. Nous remercions toutes les personnes qui soumettent leur candidature; toutefois, seules les personnes retenues pour une entrevue seront contactées.
Avis : Nous utilisons certains outils technologiques, qui peuvent comprendre des outils d’intelligence artificielle (IA), afin de soutenir le processus de présélection des candidatures. Toutefois, toutes les décisions d’embauche font l’objet d’une révision humaine.

Fastfrate Company Profile:
Fastfrate Group is one of North America’s largest privately owned transportation and logistics providers. Built on innovation, speed, and reliability, our national network connects major North American markets through seamless rail and road solutions, giving customers the strength of a full-service logistics partner.

Being part of the Fastfrate Group offers meaningful career opportunities, professional growth, and the ability to contribute to a company that plays a vital role in keeping Canada moving.

The Opportunity:
This is your chance to join a team where your work truly makes an impact. In this role, you will contribute directly to the success of our customers, our operations, and the Fastfrate Group as a whole. You’ll work in a supportive environment that values collaboration, problem-solving, and continuous learning.
Role Summary:
The Dispatch Assistant provides day-to-day administrative and operational support to the Dispatch team to help ensure the efficient movement of freight and timely completion of deliveries and pickups. This position assists with driver coordination, shipment tracking and follow-up, system updates, documentation, and communication between drivers and internal departments.
Working in a fast-paced LTL transportation environment, the Dispatch Assistant helps maintain accurate and up-to-date shipment information, responds to routine driver and operational inquiries, and escalates service issues or exceptions to the Dispatcher as required.
Hours of Work:
Monday to Friday, 10:00am–6:00pm
Work Arrangement:
On-site
Position Type:
Union or Non-Union
Employment Status:
Permanent
Compensation:
Salary Range: $38,400 to $48,000
Work Location & Environment:
4420 rue Fairway, Lachine, QC; Warehouse/Dock environment
Key Accountabilities:
In this role, you will:
  • Provide daily administrative and operational support to the Dispatch team.
  • Assist with communicating pickup, delivery, routing, and other dispatch information to drivers.
  • Monitor driver communications and relay relevant information to the Dispatcher or other departments as required.
  • Track and follow up on pickups and deliveries to help ensure shipments are progressing according to schedule.
  • Monitor shipment status and update transportation management and dispatch systems with accurate and timely information.
  • Assist with coordinating drivers for scheduled pickups and deliveries based on direction from the Dispatcher.
  • Communicate with drivers regarding routine shipment information, paperwork, delivery instructions, and status updates.
  • Identify delayed, missed, or otherwise impacted shipments and escalate exceptions to the Dispatcher for resolution.
  • Support the Dispatch team with driver check-ins and follow-up throughout the shift.
  • Assist with preparing, organizing, and maintaining dispatch documentation, manifests, trip sheets, delivery documentation, and other operational records.
  • Work closely with Customer Service, Operations, Dock/Warehouse, and other departments to communicate shipment updates and obtain required information.
  • Respond to routine inquiries regarding shipment and delivery status and direct more complex issues to the appropriate team member.
  • Enter and maintain accurate driver, shipment, pickup, and delivery information within company systems.
  • Assist with reviewing outstanding pickups and deliveries and follow up as directed.
  • Support the coordination of appointment deliveries, special delivery requirements, or customer-specific instructions.
  • Ensure required documentation is received from drivers and appropriately processed or forwarded.
  • Maintain organized and accurate electronic and/or manual dispatch records.
  • Provide general clerical and administrative support to the Dispatch and Operations teams.
  • Follow company policies, procedures, and safety requirements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
We’re looking for someone who brings:
Education & Experience:
  • Secondary School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Previous experience in transportation, logistics, dispatch, customer service, or an administrative environment is considered an asset.
  • Previous experience in an LTL transportation environment is considered an asset.
  • Familiarity with transportation terminology, bills of lading, manifests, pickup and delivery processes, and freight documentation is an asset.
  • Experience using transportation management or dispatch systems is considered an asset.
  • Previous experience communicating with commercial drivers is considered an asset.
Skills & Attributes:
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate records and system information.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Comfortable communicating with drivers and internal departments throughout the day.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, time-sensitive transportation environment.
  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to recognize operational issues and appropriately escalate them for resolution.
  • Ability to follow established processes and direction while working independently on routine responsibilities.
  • Strong computer and data-entry skills with the ability to learn transportation management and dispatch systems.
  • Collaborative approach and ability to work effectively as part of the Dispatch and Operations team.

If you’re interested in joining our team, please submit your application through our online career portal. We appreciate all applicants; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: CRM & Lifecycle Lead
description:
Who we are:

Releaf Dispensary Ltd is a leading medical cannabis clinic committed to providing high-quality, safe, and effective cannabis-based treatments. Headquartered in the UK, we aim to enhance the quality of life for our patients through innovative solutions and outstanding patient service.

We’re a fast-growing team of passionate professionals on a mission to put patients back in control of their health journey. We’ve seen first-hand how alternative treatments can change lives, and we’re proud to be at the forefront of that change.

Who we're looking for

We're looking for a data-driven CRM & Lifecycle Lead to own Releaf's patient communications strategy end to end. This is a remote-first role with occasional in-person meetings.

Our patient comms need a full overhaul; with the support of our Patient Education & Content Lead, you'll rewrite the content and copy across all our email and SMS, lead the technical migration to consolidate our fragmented platform setup, and own the patient lifecycle from first touch through to retention.

The ideal candidate thinks scientifically about CRM - someone who's as strong with data as they are with copy. You test what you send, measure it, and judge it on open rates, click-through, conversion and lifetime value.

You'll be comfortable with high ownership and thriving in a fast-paced environment. Ideally you'll have 3+ years of experience in a CRM, lifecycle marketing, or retention role within healthcare, healthtech, or a regulated B2C environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Carry out a full content & copy audit across all email & SMS so they’re clear, on-brand and useful to patients.
  • Re-design and build on brand emails
  • Lead the migration to consolidate our CRM platforms into a simpler setup, hands-on and alongside our developers.
  • Own the patient lifecycle across email and SMS, from onboarding through reorder and retention.
  • Build and manage the flows and campaigns in Klaviyo and our SMS platform.
  • Test, measure and report on what's working and what to do next.
  • Look after deliverability and keep the database clean.
  • Grow our subscription, Releaf+, and the value of each patient over time.
  • Work closely with Growth, Patient Support and Clinical, and keep everything compliant.

Who you are

  • 3+ years in CRM, lifecycle or retention marketing.
  • A strong writer and designer who can take a messy set of comms and rebuild the copy, content and design.
  • Comfortable leading a platform migration, whether hands-on or working closely with developers.
  • Experienced with Klaviyo and SMS.
  • Confident with data, and able to pull your own reports and act on them.
  • Experience in healthcare, healthtech or a wellness or subscription brand, and used to working within compliance.

Nice to have

  • Subscription or membership retention experience, and experience migrating or consolidating platforms.

How to apply

Our application process starts off with an informal remote meeting followed by a written test. We are an inclusive employer and would welcome applications from a diverse range of applicants; if there is anything we can do to help support you during the interview process, please let us know.

At Releaf, we believe that diverse teams build better businesses. We're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and able to do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences — and we're happy to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process if you need them. If you'd like to discuss this, please don't hesitate to get in touch.

title: CT Technologist NIGHTS
description:
CT TECHNOLOGIST - NIGHTS

Shift

  • Full-Time
  • NIGHTS

Job Summary

The CT Technologist I is responsible for operating CT equipment to produce high-quality diagnostic images while ensuring patient safety, comfort, and adherence to established protocols. This role involves preparing and positioning patients, maintaining equipment, and collaborating with radiologists and healthcare team members to deliver accurate and timely diagnostic results. Strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and a commitment to patient-centered care are essential for success in this position.

Essential Functions

  • Operates CT equipment and processing systems to produce high-quality diagnostic images, ensuring compliance with departmental protocols and standards.
  • Prepares and positions patients appropriately for CT procedures, using suitable positioning and immobilization techniques based on patient needs and comfort.
  • Ensures accurate patient identification, verifies physician orders, and screens patients for contraindications to the examination.
  • Performs point-of-care creatinine testing and calculates GFR when required for contrast studies. Documents results and adheres to contrast administration protocols.
  • Administers contrast media as ordered, following safety protocols. Monitors patients for adverse reactions and responds appropriately.
  • Explains procedures clearly to patients, addressing questions to alleviate fear and anxiety, and provides instructions during and after the exam.
  • Collaborates with radiologists and healthcare team members to ensure accurate, timely, and patient-centered care.
  • Assists with interventional CT procedures such as biopsies or drain placements, including sterile field setup and patient support.
  • Reviews images for technical accuracy, presents completed studies to the radiologist, and communicates findings to relevant healthcare team members as needed.
  • Documents patient clinical history and correlates it with imaging studies to support accurate diagnostic interpretation.
  • Maintains and performs regular quality control checks on CT equipment, reporting any malfunctions promptly to ensure optimal functionality.
  • Responds to emergency situations, including contrast reactions or urgent imaging needs, in accordance with facility protocols.
  • Maintains a clean, organized, and fully stocked work area by monitoring supply levels and ensuring CT equipment is ready for use.
  • Adheres to safety protocols, including the use of personal protective equipment, and follows all infection control and radiation safety guidelines.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • 1-2 years of clinical experience acquired through an accredited radiologic sciences program required
  • 2-4 years of experience as a CT Technologist in an acute care hospital setting preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Proficiency in operating CT equipment to produce high-quality diagnostic images.
  • Ability to ensure patient safety and comfort while adhering to established protocols.
  • Skills in preparing and positioning patients accurately for CT scans, including using safety lifts and/or additional personnel for patient transfers.
  • Competence in maintaining CT equipment and ensuring its proper functioning.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with radiologists and healthcare team members.
  • Knowledge of aseptic, surgical, and radiologic techniques.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively with patients, families, and healthcare teams.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, prioritize tasks, and deliver accurate results under minimal supervision.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills for maintaining accurate documentation and image quality.

Licenses and Certifications

  • Licensed Radiologic Technologist as applicable by state required
  • CT - Computed Tomography certification or eligibility to obtain within six (6) months of hire required
  • BCLS - Basic Life Support within 90 days of hire required
  • (R) ARDMS or ARRT - Radiographer preferred

title: Research Scholar
description:
Position Summary:

The Research Scholar in the Department of Special Education will contribute to Project BRiiDGE, an IES-funded research project examining interactions and relationships between teachers and students who exhibit challenging behavior. The Research Scholar will play a central role in the project's methodological, analytic, and scholarly activities, including developing and iteratively refining observational coding manuals and protocols; developing and implementing data management plans; building and maintaining study databases; planning and conducting data analyses; and training and providing ongoing guidance to graduate research assistants in observational coding, scoring, data management, and data entry procedures. The Research Scholar will collaborate closely with the Principal Investigator (PI; Lloyd), Co-Principal Investigators (Co-PIs), and other project team members to interpret findings and disseminate project results to practitioner and research audiences. The Research Scholar will have opportunities to lead first-authored manuscripts and contribute as a co-author to additional peer-reviewed publications arising from the project. This position offers substantive involvement across multiple phases of the research process, including measurement and methods development, data management and analysis, research team training, and scholarly dissemination.

This is a full-time, exempt position (40 hours per week). The anticipated duration of the position is two years, contingent upon the continued availability of funding.

About the Work Unit:

This project is housed within the Lloyd Lab in Vanderbilt’s Department of Special Education. More information about the research group can be found at https://lab.vanderbilt.edu/lloyd-lab/.

Vanderbilt's Department of Special Education has a longstanding record of scholarship, training, and impact in the field of special education. Faculty and staff are committed to preparing students from diverse backgrounds and experiences to provide exceptional services and supports to individuals with disabilities and their families. The Department has consistently been recognized among the nation's leading special education programs by U.S. News & World Report. More information is available at .

Key Functions and Expected Performance:

In collaboration with the PI (Lloyd) and other members of the Project BRiiDGE team, the Research Scholar will carry out the following activities:

  • Observational Measurement, Data Systems, and Analysis
    • Lead the development, documentation, and iterative refinement of observational coding manuals and protocols.
    • Lead the design, construction, documentation, and maintenance of project databases and associated data management procedures.
    • Develop and implement procedures for monitoring data quality and the reliability of observational data.
    • Plan and conduct analyses to assess interobserver agreement and reliability of observational measures.
    • Plan and conduct statistical analyses addressing the project's primary and exploratory research questions.
    • Collaborate with the PI, Co-PIs, and other team members in interpreting and communicating study findings.
  • Research Team Leadership and Collaboration
    • Lead training and ongoing calibration activities for graduate research assistants conducting observational coding.
    • Lead research team meetings focused on observational coding, data quality, scoring, data management, and entry of data into project databases.
    • Provide ongoing guidance and feedback to graduate research assistants regarding observational coding and data procedures.
    • Collaborate with the project coordinator to support effective training, workflow, and communication among graduate research assistants and other project personnel.
    • Contribute to the continued development and documentation of efficient, rigorous, and reproducible research procedures.
  • Scholarly and Practitioner Dissemination
    • Prepare data briefs, reports, and presentations for participating school districts and schools.
    • Develop posters, papers, and symposium presentations for practitioner and research conferences.
    • Lead the development and submission of first-authored manuscripts examining teacher-student interactions and relationships involving students with challenging behavior.
    • Contribute as a co-author to additional peer-reviewed manuscripts arising from Project BRiiDGE.
    • Collaborate with the PI, Co-PIs, and other project personnel in interpreting findings and developing scholarly products.
    • Contribute to grant proposals and other funding applications, as appropriate.
  • Accountability
    • Meet weekly with the PI to establish priorities, review progress, address challenges, and plan upcoming project activities.
    • Establish and meet agreed-upon timelines for data products, school and district reports, conference submissions, and presentations.
    • Establish and meet agreed-upon timelines for the development and submission of peer-reviewed manuscripts.
    • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of coding, data management, and analytic procedures.

Supervisory Relationships:

This position does not have formal personnel supervisory responsibility. The Research Scholar reports administratively and functionally to the Principal Investigator of Project BRiiDGE (Dr. Lloyd).

Education and Certifications:

  • A doctorate in special education, education, psychology, applied behavior analysis, or a closely related discipline is required.
  • BCBA certification or substantive graduate-level training in applied behavior analysis is strongly preferred.

Experience and Skills:

  • Demonstrated experience conducting education, behavioral, or social science research.

  • Experience collecting, managing, and analyzing quantitative research data.

  • Experience with observational measurement or systematic observational data collection.

  • Demonstrated ability to learn and apply complex coding protocols with a high degree of accuracy and consistency.

  • Strong scholarly writing skills and experience contributing to research manuscripts, reports, conference presentations, or other scholarly products.

  • Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple research activities, establish priorities, and meet deadlines.

  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively and collaboratively within a research team.

Preferred Experience and Skills:

  • Experience conducting school-based research involving students with challenging behavior and/or the teachers and staff who support them.

  • Experience developing, refining, or implementing observational coding systems, particularly those focused on teacher-student interactions or behavior in school settings.

  • Experience training or supporting research assistants in observational coding and establishing or maintaining interobserver agreement.

  • Experience developing and implementing research data management procedures and maintaining study databases.

  • Experience conducting statistical analyses on observational data sets.

  • Experience using statistical software appropriate for quantitative education research.

  • A record of scholarly writing or publication related to teacher-student interactions, student behavior, special education, or a closely related area.

  • Experience contributing to conference presentations, peer-reviewed manuscripts, grant proposals, or other scholarly products.

Research experience obtained during doctoral and post-doctoral training may be used to satisfy the experience qualifications described above.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
At ZeroNorth, we are at the forefront of transforming the shipping industry through digital innovation. Our solutions go beyond optimising business operations, they are designed to lead the industry in sustainability by significantly reducing CO2 emissions.


Our core mission of making global trade greener drives everything we do. Your contributions will play a crucial role in reducing emissions, aligning commercial success with sustainability, and delivering benefits for both profitability and the environment.


ZeroNorth is powered by a diverse team of 550+ professionals with more than 38 nationalities, operating out of global hubs including Copenhagen (our headquarters), Athens, Chennai, Mumbai, Singapore, Sofia, and Tokyo.


We are leading the industry's green transition, enabling our partners to leverage data for actionable decarbonisation efforts.


Senior Data Engineer at ZeroNorth


Zeronorth is developing an industry leading agentic platform for maritime operations. We are looking for an ambitious engineer to join our ‘Data for Sensing’ team. The team owns the ingestion and processing of external real world data; making it readily available to all internal product teams.The team is in charge of turning those feeds into data products and insights. As agentic workflows take a more significant space in our company, we are looking for an individual who can also address and evaluate the shift where a data consumer can also be an AI agent rather than a human analyst/software engineer, which changes the data design.


You will work with a team of talented engineers with great and profound knowledge of the existing data ecosystem. We put a lot of emphasis on collaborative communication which we believe is key for success. You will design and evolve the data platform to serve our agentic maritime platforms of the future including the estate-level view:data freshness, costs, cataloging, governance lineage and a clear view of where quality is sufficient and where it needs improvement.


Key responsibilities:



  • Data modelling: Rigorous entity and relational modelling. Keys, dependencies, normalisation through 3NF and beyond, with denormalisation applied deliberately at the serving layer. Expert SQL assumed.

  • Resilient pipelines at scale: Batch and streaming design covering orchestration, idempotency, backfills, and late-arriving data, with immutable raw capture enabling full reprocessing. Failures must be diagnosable from the outside. Large datasets across warehouses, lakes, and distributed processing, with sound judgement on partitioning, skew, and cost.

  • High-performance APIs: Design a serving layer where latency budgets hold under load and contracts are bulletproof. For most consumers, the API is the product, and here that consumer is an agent, so provenance, freshness, and confidence are fields in the response.

  • Applied mathematics and analysis: Time series, interpolation and extrapolation, uncertainty, and clustering, applied to imperfect weather and sensor data. Units, time zones, and rounding are treated as correctness concerns. Hypotheses formed, tested against the data, and reported with a stated level of confidence. Familiarity with ML concepts, such as feature management, data drift, and training-serving skew, sufficient to build robust data foundations and collaborate credibly with Data Scientists.

  • Provider sourcing and evaluation: Assessment of external data providers on coverage, latency, licensing, and cost, documented as an actionable recommendation. Direct technical engagement with provider teams.

  • Customer value and product collaboration: Close work with product teams on scope and sequencing, recognising that a pipeline delivers value only once it reaches a customer. Proper investigation of data complaints, explained in terms a non-technical audience can act upon.

  • Agentic ways of working: Active use and advancement of agentic tooling, with repositories, documentation, and tooling structured to serve humans and agents alike, and generated output verified rather than assumed.


Your profile:



  • Creative systems thinking: Holds the feed, the model, the contract, the API, and the agent consuming it as one system, and reasons about second-order effects before building. When the obvious approach does not fit the data, revisits design before reimplementing i.e. tries to work from existing systems with incremental improvements.

  • Innovator's mindset: Curious by default and a fast learner. Leans into what agentic systems make possible and treats a new technology or methodology as something to try out. Thrives in ambiguity and takes end-to-end ownership when it serves the broader strategy, rather than sticking to rigid team boundaries.

  • Owns the contract, not the pipeline: Success is the consumer never being surprised. A green orchestration run over silently stale data is a failure. Ensures a common definition of data fields and schemas. Ensures alignment across stakeholders and data producers for common shared data fields.

  • Data quality balanced against delivery: Completeness, freshness, lineage, and checks that fail loudly rather than silently. Committed dates treated as real, with explicit acknowledgement when sufficiency is chosen over perfection.


Technology:


Our core stack is Python and SQL on AWS and Snowflake, integrating complex external feeds like gridded numerical weather, AIS, and global fleet registries. However, we hire for engineering fundamentals, not just stack-matching.


Required Qualifications:


A degree in computer science or equivalent depth, with 5+ years delivering production data systems, and a strong intuition for performance, scalability, and cost trade-offs


About ZeroNorth


At ZeroNorth, we aim to make global trade sustainable by steering the maritime industry toward zero emissions. Using advanced technology and trusted data, our platform delivers real-time insights to optimize operations and align commercial success with environmental impact.


We partner with customers on their journey toward sustainability, solving complex challenges and empowering informed decisions that benefit both the planet and their bottom line.


Our culture thrives on growth, inclusion, and collaboration. We value honesty, trust, and the unique contributions of every team member, driving meaningful change together.

description:

Typically, the knowledge and skills required for this position would be attained through a human services degree, diploma or a certificate program related to adult client counselling and/or years of experience in client case management.

Candidates must clearly demonstrate in their cover letter and resume where and how they have acquired the knowledge and abilities. This information will be used for screening purposes.

Employees of the Ministry are not eligible to apply to the Saskatchewan Immigrant Nominee Program (SINP), either as a principal applicant or an accompanying family member, or to act as a supporting family member on an application. title: Controls Room – PONY Product Owner - Vice President
description:
As a Vice President Product Manager within the Controls Room Team in Control Management, you will lead the end-to-end product development of a new, ground-up application in the Control Management space. You will partner closely with other control disciplines to oversee existing control capabilities while designing and implementing new control functions and protocols. You will unify reference hierarchies across compliance and operational risk frameworks to promote consistency, interoperability, and operational efficiency.

Our development approach is spec-driven and includes rapid prototyping, leveraging Claude Code and/or GitHub Copilot (in accordance with firm-approved tooling and controls). You will design AI-first features that embed intelligent assistance directly into core control workflows. You will collaborate with stakeholders across lines of business and corporate functions to collect, analyze, and monitor firmwide risk-based intelligence. You will empower the three lines of defense with timely, risk-based information to manage and enhance their control environments. You will contribute to maintaining a strong and consistent control environment by supporting early operational risk identification, effective control design, and sustainable risk mitigation solutions. You will help the Controls Room deliver cost-effective, automated reporting and actionable insights that improve decision-making across the firm. You will provide clear views into risks and issues, ensuring corporate and business teams are set up for long-term success.

Control Management maintains a strong and consistent control environment across the firm. With Control Managers appointed for each Line of Business, Function and Region, there is a comprehensive coverage and joint accountability model with the business executive that promotes early operational risk identification and assessment, effective design and evaluation of controls and sustainable solutions to mitigate operational risk.

The Controls Room gathers information from key business and technology partners in order to:

• Facilitate better decision making and actionable insights across the Firm.

• Create cost-effective and automated reporting; and

• Provide views into risk and issues.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Drive cross functional teams through the product development of a new application being built from the ground up in the Control Management space to deliver against the PONY roadmap
  • Lead the product focus on unifying reference hierarchies across compliance and operational risk frameworks, aligning stakeholders on definitions, standards, and adoption
  • Translate higher level strategy and requirements from internal stakeholders into actionable tasks for Product Owners and Agile development teams
  • Drive and oversee a spec-driven delivery process, ensuring high-quality product requirements (e.g., user stories, acceptance criteria) and rapid prototyping cycles leveraging Claude and/or GitHub Copilot (in accordance with firm-approved tooling and controls)
  • Ensure the product roadmap is AI-first, partnering with technology teams to embed intelligent assistance and automation into core workflows
  • Manage relationships with Line of Business and Function Leads and key stakeholders to build out and maintain long-term roadmaps
  • Partner with the Program Management team to ensure the Product’s progress is reported accurately on status reports
  • Provide subject matter expertise and impact analysis for projects driven by the Control Management organization to influence end-to-end implementation across the Controls Room teams
  • Manage and participate in multiple project workstreams concurrently to proactively enhance outcomes, identify effective solutions, and mitigate issues
  • Present roadmaps, technology solutions, and status updates on various forums with senior stakeholders

Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills:

  • Quantitative background (BA/BS in Math, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering) with 6+ years of experience working with technology partners to develop products
  • Advanced experience translating user requests to technology requirements using agile management tools like JIRA
  • Prior application of the agile methodology for product development
  • Experience driving delivery across cross-functional teams, managing dependencies, and influencing outcomes without direct authority
  • Experience with AI-assisted development and prototyping tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) in line with approved tooling/controls
  • Experience implementing AI capabilities including agentic workflows
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills; must be able to communicate with a wide variety of functional groups at various levels
  • Enthusiastic, self-motivated, effective under pressure and willing to take personal responsibility/accountability
  • Flexible, adaptable to shifting priorities; able to work in a fast-paced, results driven environment
  • Effective time management and multitasking skills

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills:

  • Knowledge of data analytics and AI tools such as Github Copilot, Claude Code, Tableau, Alteryx or Python is preferred.
  • Experience in financial industry, auditing, compliance, or consulting and an understanding of risks & controls management is beneficial.
  • Knowledge of compliance and regulatory requirements for consumer banking industry is a plus.
  • Experience with data/hierarchy concepts (e.g., taxonomies, reference data, framework mapping) is a plus
  • Experience working with internal control, compliance, and risk management

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are not able to provide immigration sponsorship or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

title: Butikschef - Elon Ljud & Bild Malmö
description:
Är du en driven ledare som älskar försäljning, människor och resultat? Då kan du vara vår nästa butikschef.

Vilka är vi?

Vi är fyra Elon Ljud & Bild-butiker i Malmö med fokus på försäljning, teknik, service och riktigt bra kundupplevelser.

I våra butiker hjälper vi kunder med allt från mobiltelefoner, abonnemang och hemelektronik till tillbehör, reparationer och teknisk support genom vårt eget servicekoncept Lagamobilen.

Nu söker vi en butikschef som vill ta ansvar för både försäljningen och människorna bakom resultaten.

Om rollen

Som butikschef är du en viktig del av den dagliga verksamheten.

Du leder från golvet och förväntas själv vara en stark del av försäljningen samtidigt som du coachar, utvecklar och följer upp ditt team.

För oss handlar ledarskap inte bara om scheman och administration. Vi söker någon som får människor att prestera, skapar energi i butiken och hela tiden letar efter möjligheter att utveckla både teamet och affären.

Du kommer ha tydliga mål och stor möjlighet att påverka butikens resultat.

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

  • Leda och utveckla butikens säljteam
  • Coacha medarbetarna löpande inom försäljning och kundbemötande
  • Följa upp försäljning, KPI:er och individuella resultat
  • Själv arbeta aktivt med försäljning och kunder
  • Skapa struktur, energi och tydlighet i teamet
  • Ansvara för den dagliga driften av butiken
  • Säkerställa hög nivå på kundupplevelse, ordning och exponering
  • Arbeta med kunduppföljning och lokala försäljningsaktiviteter
  • Vara med och utveckla våra arbetssätt och vår verksamhet framåt


Vem söker vi?

Vi tror att du är tävlingsinriktad, lösningsorienterad och tycker om att få andra människor att lyckas.

Du är bekväm med att ställa krav men också med att coacha och stötta när det behövs.

Du behöver kunna växla mellan att själv stå framför kunden och göra affärer, till att analysera resultat och hjälpa en medarbetare att ta nästa steg.

Du gillar högt tempo, tydliga mål och att ta ansvar.

Vi ser gärna att du har:

  • Erfarenhet av försäljning med goda resultat
  • Erfarenhet av att leda, coacha eller utveckla andra
  • Erfarenhet från butik, telekom eller liknande försäljningsmiljö
  • Ett tydligt affärs- och resultatfokus


Tidigare erfarenhet som butikschef, teamleader eller säljledare är meriterande, men vi är även öppna för en riktigt stark säljare som är redo att ta nästa steg som ledare.

Vad får du?

  • Fast lön + attraktiv rörlig ersättning
  • Möjlighet att påverka både din egen och butikens utveckling
  • En roll med stort ansvar och möjlighet att påverka
  • Löpande coaching och utveckling
  • Möjlighet att växa vidare inom företaget
  • Ett ambitiöst team som gillar att tävla och utvecklas
  • En arbetsplats där prestation, initiativ och resultat uppmärksammas

Det här är en operativ chefsroll i butik. Du arbetar därför efter butikens öppettider och kvällar och helger kan förekomma.

Det här behöver du ha med dig:

  • Du pratar och skriver svenska obehindrat
  • Du känner dig bekväm med engelska
  • Du är trygg i att ta ansvar och fatta beslut
  • Du gillar försäljning och att arbeta mot tydliga mål
  • Du har förmågan att få med dig människor


Vi rekryterar löpande och vill tillsätta rollen så snart som möjligt.

För oss är personlighet, driv och ledarskap minst lika viktigt som vad som står på ditt CV.

Vill du ta nästa steg och bygga ett vinnande team tillsammans med oss? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag – vi ser fram emot att träffa dig!

title: USPI Senior Counsel, Operations
description:
Tenet Healthcare Corporation (NYSE: THC) is a diversified healthcare services company headquartered in Dallas. Our care delivery network includes United Surgical Partners International, the largest ambulatory care platform in the country, which operates ambulatory surgery centers and surgical hospitals. We also operate a national portfolio of acute care and specialty hospitals, other outpatient facilities, a network of leading employed physicians and a global business center in Manila, Philippines. Our Conifer Health Solutions subsidiary provides revenue cycle management and value-based care services to hospitals, health systems, physician practices, employers, and other clients. Across the Tenet enterprise, we are united by our mission to deliver quality, compassionate care in the communities we serve. For more information, please visit www.tenethealth.com.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Tenet Healthcare seeks to add a Senior Counsel, Operations to its legal team based in its Dallas, TX headquarters or its Nashville, TN office. The successful lawyer will join a high impact and growing legal team and be expected to provide legal advice on a wide variety of matters related to Tenet’s portfolio of facilities.

The Senior Counsel, Operations responsibilities will include general legal guidance for our clinical organization, the review and analysis of all arrangements between Tenet facilities and other parties for compliance with Stark, anti-kickback and other fraud and abuse laws, EMTALA, HIPAA, and any other regulatory requirements applicable to such arrangements. The Senior Counsel will also be required to give training presentations to personnel from time-to-time on legal issues that pertain to facility operations

REQUIRED SKILLS:

A minimum of five years of experience in health care law is required. Solid experience in a healthcare operations law practice, as well as a working knowledge of health care regulations, are required. This includes experience in health care-related drafting and transactional matters. Prior large law firm experience is highly preferred.

Additionally, the successful lawyer must be self-motivated, organized, a team player and work well in a high-energy and fast-paced environment. The lawyer filling this position must also possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to interact with individuals at all levels of the company, including senior corporate executives and outside counsel. This position will involve handling confidential matters requiring the exercise of good judgment and discretion.

Professional Attributes

  • Ability to work independently, as well as function effectively, within a team framework.
  • Strong research, analytical, organizational, and computer skills are necessary.
  • Must be extremely responsive to a high volume of diverse requests.
  • Strong customer service orientation, meticulous attention to detail and initiative are essential for success in this role.
  • Excellent project management skills, ability to execute on plan, deliver results and manage external legal costs.
  • A self-motivated, organized team player who works well in a high-energy and fast-paced environment. An individual who is cooperative, encourages collaboration and builds understanding; who easily gains trust and support of superiors and colleagues; who can find common ground and solve problems, and who owns his or her projects and commitments.

Personal Attributes

  • The ability to communicate effectively with diverse constituencies and to deliver high quality written and verbal presentations. Astute interpersonal, public relations and negotiating skills.
  • An individual of highest personal and professional integrity, principle and knowledge, earning respect and support when making difficult decisions and choices.
  • This individual must also possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills and be extremely responsive to all constituents. He/she should also have the ability to effectively interact with individuals at all levels of the organization, including top executives and outside counsel. This position will involve handling confidential matters requiring the exercise of good judgment and discretion.

Education/Certifications

Juris Doctor Degree from an ASA Accredited Law School is required and fully qualified to practice in the State of Texas or Tennessee.

Travel

Approximately 5 percent. Selected candidates will be required to pass a Motor Vehicle Record check.

title: Clinical Documentation Specialist
description:
Job Summary

The Clinical Documentation Specialist (CDS) performs clinical documentation improvement (CDI) activities to support the accuracy, quality, and completeness of patient records at facilities. This role ensures that coded diagnoses and procedures reflect the patient's clinical status and care provided. The CDS collaborates with providers through education and the physician query process, ensuring medical records accurately reflect patient severity of illness and support continuity of care, appropriate quality metrics, and regulatory compliance.

This position is hybrid in Laredo, Texas at Laredo Medical Center.


Essential Functions

  • Analyzes inpatient clinical records to identify opportunities for improving documentation accuracy, ensuring assigned codes reflect patient severity and acuity.
  • Adheres to corporate recommended CDI workflows and uses CDI and medical records software, such as 3M 360 Encompass and Iodine Interact, to support documentation practices.
  • Utilizes approved physician query processes to clarify documentation, ensuring queries are compliant, necessary, and non-leading, and follows up daily on unanswered queries.
  • Conducts follow-up reviews of patient records to identify new documentation opportunities and ensures accuracy through continuous review.
  • Tracks CDI activities within CDI software, accurately reporting impact metrics and maintaining clear records of all interactions and documentation efforts.
  • Provides education and training to providers, explaining recommendations for documentation improvement and offering insights through individual or group sessions.
  • Collaborates closely with coding professionals to ensure accurate diagnostic and procedural data through complete and compliant documentation.
  • Leads physician education initiatives, developing strategies to improve documentation practices at the facility level and conducting formal training sessions.
  • Monitors regulatory changes in coding, documentation, and quality metrics, ensuring compliance with updated standards and sharing information with staff as needed.
  • Creates and submits accurate reports in a timely manner, maintaining up-to-date knowledge of best practices and industry standards to support CDI goals.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • Associate Degree in Nursing, or comparable clinical field (e.g., International MD) required
  • Bachelor's Degree in Nursing, Health Information Management, or a related field preferred
  • 3-5 years of acute care hospital nursing experience (e.g. medical/surgical unit, intensive care) required
  • 3-5 years of experience in clinical documentation improvement, health information management, or inpatient coding preferred
  • Experience in physician education or query processes preferred
  • Familiarity with regulatory standards and quality metrics related to clinical documentation preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of clinical documentation improvement principles, inpatient coding guidelines, and quality metrics.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills to identify opportunities for documentation improvement.
  • Proficiency in CDI and medical record software systems (e.g., 3M 360 Encompass, Iodine Interact).
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with physicians and interdisciplinary teams.
  • Ability to develop and deliver educational programs tailored to clinical and administrative audiences.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Commitment to maintaining compliance with regulatory standards and corporate policies.

Licenses and Certifications

  • RN - Registered Nurse - State Licensure and/or Compact State Licensure or comparable clinical license (e.g., International MD) required
  • CCS-Certified Coding Specialist or ICD-10 certification or trainer designation preferred or
  • Certified Clinical Documentation Specialist (CCDS) preferred
  • RHIT - Registered Health Information Technician preferred or
  • RHIA - Registered Health Information Administrator preferred
  • CDIP - Clinical Documentation Improvement Professional preferred or
  • Certified Coder-AHIMA or AAPC preferred

title: Arborist Sawyer
description:
Markit! Forestry is looking to gather qualified applicants to fill arborist sawyer roles.

Summary: As a member of Markit! Forestry’s sawyer team you will be working on forest health, forest fuels reduction, post-fire rehabilitation, and defensible space projects on private, state and federal lands. Markit! is positively changing the way forests are managed and the Sawyer plays an impactful role in the success of our projects and progress. We are looking for career minded individuals who are dedicated to reliably making a difference in the Forestry industry.

Location: Headquartered in Colorado Springs, Colorado; projects will be located in Colorado and possibly New Mexico.

Travel: 75-90%

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Chainsaw Operation – felling operations, directional felling, hazard felling, limbing and bucking.
  • Slash management – lop-and-scatter, chipping operations, and hauling material.
  • Climbing, rigging and roping.
  • Erosion Control – contour felling, LEB creation and installation.
  • Assisting with project layout and marking.
  • Chainsaw and tool maintenance.
  • General forestry labor.
  • Understand and implement different cutting prescriptions.
  • Direct sub-contractors to perform fuels mitigation practices and cutting prescriptions.

Requirements:

  • At least 21 years of age.
  • A valid driver’s license or ability to acquire one upon employment.
  • 1 to 2 years of outdoor work experience in forest management and restoration activities .
  • Ability to travel is a must for this position and will include extended periods on the road, dependent on current ongoing projects.
  • A National Wildfire Coordinating Group (NWCG) S-212, or equivalent certificate. Non-certified professionals with over two years of experience in forestry and logging operations will still be considered.
  • Physically fit, able to bend, squat and lift up to 50 pounds and able to handle back country hikes with heavy gear loads in elevations ranging from 6,000 to +10,000 feet. Frequently away from vehicles or amenities for the entire course of the day.
  • Ability and desire to perform strenuous outdoor work in a variety of weather conditions, away from amenities for entire day.

Preferred Background & Experience:

  • NWCG S 130/190 Wildfire Training.
  • ISA certification.
  • Electrical hazard tree trimming certification.
  • Saw mechanic experience.
  • An associates or bachelor’s degree in forestry or related natural resources field, current enrollment in a forestry degree program or similar is acceptable.
  • Ability to accurately identify tree species .
  • Ability to calculate basal area.
  • Experience working with helicopter logging.
  • Experience operating Heavy Equipment such as logging machinery and/or willingness to learn.
  • First aid, CPR, Wilderness First Aid, or other medical certifications.
  • Background in Sawyer certification.

Language:

  • English required.
  • Bi-lingual (English/Spanish) is a plus.

Benefits:

  • Competitive wages based on experience and qualifications:
    • Entry-level $22-25 per hour
    • Mid-level $25-28 per hour
    • High-level $28-31 per hour
  • Annual reviews.
  • Health insurance including medical, dental and vision.
  • Supplementary insurance including life, short and long term insurance.
  • Paid holidays, vacation and personal time.
  • Retirement with company match.
  • Company provided training for career advancement.

Markit! Forestry is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or status as a protected veteran.

title: In-Store Shopper Part Time
description:

A Day in the Life:

As an In Store Shopper (Drive Up & Go Clerk as we call it), your day is focused on selecting high-quality products for customers who shop online. You move throughout the store picking items, checking quality, and making selections that match what you’d choose yourself. Each order is an opportunity to get it just right, ensuring customers receive accurate and fresh groceries.

Another part of the role is keeping orders organized and ready for pick up. You’ll bag items carefully, manage substitutions when needed, and coordinate orders for timely handoff to customers. Between shopping, packing, and preparing orders for delivery or pickup, the work stays steady making it a good fit for someone who enjoys moving throughout the store and working in a fast‑paced environment.

  • Technology Use: Comfortable using handheld devices and systems for order picking and tracking
  • Problem Awareness: Identifying out-of-stock items and selecting appropriate substitutions
  • Operational Awareness: Following order fulfillment processes and company standards
  • Team Awareness: Coordinating order needs with team members and department processes
  • Adaptability: Comfort with changing order volume and priorities throughout the shift
  • Physical Capability: Comfort with continuous movement, lifting up to 50 lbs., and working in different store areas

Requirements:

  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • Prior retail, customer service, or fulfillment experience preferred
  • Ability to use handheld devices and follow digital order systems
  • Strong attention to detail required for product quality and order accuracy
  • Availability to work early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays

Why you will choose us:

Albertsons Companies Inc. has always been a people-oriented business, and thoughtful people practices remain a core element of our company’s philosophy. Our goal is to continue to bring people together around the joys of food and to inspire well-being and that starts with people like you bringing your unique self to our company and making it one person stronger and better!

We also provide a variety of benefits including:

Our Values

title: Pharmacy Tech II- Certified
description:
