title: Supply Chain Tech
description:
Job Summary

The Supply Chain Technician supports the accurate and efficient flow of supplies within the facility by receiving, stocking, and distributing materials in accordance with established inventory and supply chain procedures. This role ensures storerooms and point-of-care (POC) locations are adequately stocked, organized, and compliant with safety and inventory standards. The Supply Chain Technician is responsible for conducting inventory counts, processing shipments, and maintaining accurate records in the supply chain system to support patient care and operational efficiency.

Essential Functions
  • Receives, inspects, and processes incoming shipments, verifying contents against packing slips and reporting discrepancies to leadership.
  • Stocks storeroom and warehouse items in designated locations using First In, First Out (FIFO) principles to ensure proper inventory rotation.
  • Maintains safety stock levels by reviewing and updating min/max quantities for storeroom and POC supply areas.
  • Performs scheduled physical inventory counts and cycle counts to ensure inventory accuracy, resolving discrepancies as needed.
  • Picks and stages supplies based on department requisitions, applying patient charge stickers where applicable and ensuring system accuracy.
  • Organizes and maintains PAR locations with proper labeling, clean layouts, and consistent restocking to meet department needs.
  • Delivers non-stock and stock items to departments, obtaining appropriate signatures for confirmation of delivery.
  • Coordinates outbound shipments for authorized returns, preparing documentation such as bills of lading and return forms.
  • Ensures storeroom and warehouse environments remain clean, organized, and compliant with regulatory and infection control standards.
  • Supports semi-annual and year-end inventory processes by participating in comprehensive inventory counts and data validation.
  • Enters data into the ERP or inventory system for receipts, inventory adjustments, transfers, and requisitions.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.
Qualifications
  • 0-1 years of experience applying mathematical and conversion skills in a supply chain setting, including inventory calculations for bulk distribution, par levels, and units of measure (e.g., cc, mg, mL, and grams) required
  • 1-3 years of experience in supply chain, warehouse, inventory control, or materials management preferred
  • Healthcare experience preferred
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • Knowledge of inventory management practices and supply chain logistics.
  • Familiarity with ERP or inventory systems and basic data entry skills.
  • Ability to follow procedures for receiving, stocking, and distributing medical supplies.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in handling inventory and documentation.
  • Ability to lift, move, and transport materials and supplies safely.

title: Senior Benefits Analyst, HR Technology Solutions
description:

The Senior Business Analyst will work with the Benefits and Payroll team to understand the business requirements, vision, system issues and recommend a solution that will meet their short and/or long-term needs. Acts as liaison between business stakeholders and HRT team to translate business data and technology needs into Oracle HCM system configurations, integration modifications and process improvements. The Senior Business Analyst will serve as the functional subject matter expert for US and Canada benefit plans, including health & welfare, retirement, and ancillary programs. Generally provides functional input for application/vendor support of a moderate level of complexity including support for business as usual activities such as open enrollment.

  • Analyzes impact of configuration, Fast Formulas, and extensions to service delivery, downstream systems and integrations. Leads meetings to resolve priority issues of moderate complexity.

Interaction with senior management (Sr. Directors, VPs) is typically in conjunction with Domain Lead/Product Owner.

Plans for and supports migrations, releases, upgrades and/or patches - mitigating risk/downstream impacts. Develops knowledge on configuration, extensions and Fast Formulas. Engages Digital and vendor for support as necessary.

  • High School Diploma or GED (accredited) and four years of relevant experience

Ability to combine business process expertise with technical understanding to evaluate solution options, translate requirements into system capabilities, troubleshoot issues, and deliver scalable technology solutions.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration & Influence: Proven ability to build trusted relationships and collaborate effectively across HR, Digital, Reporting & Analytics, vendors, and cross-functional business partners. Ability to influence decisions, facilitate discussions, and achieve alignment across diverse stakeholder groups without direct authority.

  • Communication & Facilitation: Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts in clear, business-friendly language. Experience facilitating discovery sessions, workshops, solution design discussions, and executive presentations.

  • Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving: Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills with the ability to evaluate complex business and technical challenges, identify root causes, assess solution alternatives, and make sound recommendations supported by data.

title: Field Supervisor (Trainee)
description:
Field Supervisor
Location: Charleston, SC
Job Type: Full-time
Pay: Starting at $24.00 to $25.00 per hour, with growth to $30.00 to $36.00 per hour as you develop into the role

About the Role

This is not a desk job. McCorquodale Transfer is looking for a hands-on leader who wants to build a career, not just have a job. You will start out on the trucks, working side by side with our crews and learning the business from the ground up. As you complete training milestones and prove yourself in the field, you will grow into a Field Supervisor (a skilled operations leader who trains, develops, and mentors crews across our markets).

This role is physical and field based. You will spend the majority of your time on job sites, in client homes, and in warehouses, and you should expect to travel up to 70% of the time, including overnight stays (both inside and outside your market).

What to Expect

  • You will begin with a hands-on training period working directly with our crews, learning our equipment, procedures, and safety standards firsthand.
  • As you build experience, you will take on more responsibility: coaching Crew Leaders, helping deliver hands-on training, and supporting projects in the field.
  • Your pay grows with you. You will start at $24 to $25 per hour and work toward $30 to $36 per hour as you hit training and performance milestones over your first few months.
  • Once you are fully promoted into the Field Supervisor role, your pay structure moves to a salaried package with bonus potential.

Once You Are Fully Promoted, You Will:

  • Train and mentor Crew Leaders on managing their teams and projects, including crew assignments, job planning, and on-site decision making
  • Coach Crew Leaders on customer communication, expectation setting, and professional representation of the company
  • Deliver hands-on training for new hires and make sure every team member is certified on required equipment and safety protocols before working independently
  • Help build and maintain training content in our Learning Management System (LMS), based on real field experience
  • Support pre-planned projects, including site surveys, crew scheduling, and execution through final walkthrough and client sign-off
  • Help integrate newly acquired companies onto our systems, standards, and culture
  • Travel to support new location launches, operational turnarounds, and other special projects as a member of our Gold Key Team

What We Are Looking For

  • Willingness to start hands-on and physical, working alongside our crews on the trucks
  • A valid driver's license and the ability to travel up to 70% of the time, including overnight and extended stays
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust with crews, customers, and leadership
  • Sound judgment and the ability to make decisions quickly under pressure
  • Leadership potential. We are looking for someone who wants to grow into developing and mentoring others
  • Bachelor's degree preferred, but we will consider an equivalent combination of education and hands-on experience in moving, logistics, installation, or a related field
  • Experience designing or delivering training is a plus

Physical Demands

This role requires regular standing, walking, and use of hands and arms, along with occasional stooping, kneeling, crouching, climbing, or balancing. You should be able to lift and move up to 25 to 50 pounds. Frequent travel by car and/or air is required, sometimes with limited notice.

title: Senior Director, Delivery Center Strategy & Integration
description:
Grant Thornton is seeking a Senior Director, Delivery Center Strategy & Integration to join the team. Approved office locations can be found below.

Role Overview

The Senior Director, Delivery Center Strategy and Integration plays a critical role in building, scaling, integrating and optimizing our Global Delivery Center (GDC) ecosystem across EMEA, APAC, and LATAM. This Sr. Director-level leader will establish the GDC Strategy, Service catalog across delivery centers, Location strategy, work placement guidelines with a strategic goal of growing the global delivery workforce to 10,000+ resources.

The leader would also drive GDC Adoption and Acceleration, stakeholder management and governance across firms/functions and oversee the portfolio execution of integration projects to drive standardization and consistency across delivery centers.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned IT services expert with proven experience building, scaling and integrating multi-region delivery centers, transitioning service portfolios, and driving operational excellence at scale. This role requires exceptional knowledge of global delivery center, communication, strong executive presence, and the ability to influence and collaborate with senior leadership across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Global Delivery Center Strategy & Build and Integration

  • Lead the development the overarching multi-year GDC strategy, strategic priorities and focus areas across delivery centers. This includes developing GDC strategy, Service catalog outlining services delivered across centers, Location strategy to deliver the service catalog and Work placement guidelines across delivery center.
  • Lead portfolio of critical programs to drive build, adoption, standardization and integration across delivery centers.
  • Establish and drive stakeholder management and governance including SteerCo’s, monthly quarterly reviews to effectively communicate strategy and progress against the strategy.
  • Develop the GDC Playbook, including operating model, governance, processes, KPIs, knowledge management, and workforce planning.
  • Establish repeatable onboarding playbooks, transition processes, and best practices to support growth to 10,000+ delivery resources across delivery centers.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in IT, Business or another related field; MBA preferred.
  • 12+ years of experience in IT service delivery, shared services, global operations, or managed services environments.
  • Proven track record in building, scaling and integrating global delivery centers across multiple regions.
  • Strong understanding of onshore/nearshore/offshore delivery model, delivery center operations, global service delivery, and multi-tower integration.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and executive-level influencing skills.
  • Should be a hands-on leader with strategic thinking and a strong bias towards execution.
  • Fluent and professional English—verbal and written.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in complex, multinational environments and collaborate effectively with senior leadership.
  • Experience in high-growth environments with large-scale ramp-ups (500+ - 1000 resources).
  • Ability to travel regularly, with international travel requirements.

Personal Attributes

  • Strong executive presence with the ability to lead strategic discussions at the Director and Managing Director level.
  • Highly collaborative, diplomatic, and influential—able to align diverse teams toward common goals.
  • Structured, process-oriented, and able to build scalable operational frameworks.
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments with aggressive growth targets.
  • High degree of cultural awareness and ability to operate across multiple geographies.

The base salary range for this position is between $187,500 and $312,500. Placement within the pay range is at Grant Thornton’s discretion, and it is based on multiple factors, including but not limited to, job -related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, progression within the role, geographic location, and internal equity. At Grant Thornton, compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate.

title: Senior Java Developer – TDD, JUnit, CI/CD & Code Quality
description:
1. Senior Java Developer – TDD, JUnit, CI/CD & Code Quality

    Roles and Responsibilities:

    • Deep commitment to code quality, clean code, SOLID principles, and design patterns.

    • Experience building RESTful APIs and microservices using frameworks such as Spring / Spring Boot.

    • Experience integrating automated tests and quality checks into CI/CD pipelines (for example, Jenkins).
    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and technical documentation skills.

    • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

title: B Lineman - Overhead (Duke)
description:
Position Summary

The Class B Lineman is a safety focused professional with the ability to construct and repair electrical overhead distribution systems. You will work on energized and de‑energized powerlines and may be required to travel to different job sites, including out‑of‑state locations, as operational and customer needs dictate. You will report to the Foreman.

Essential Functions

  • Perform new construction, maintain and repair energized and de‑energized overhead distribution systems while putting safety first.

  • Install and repair overhead power lines, poles, insulators, conductors and related hardware.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of switching and tagging procedures, grounding and induced voltage on energized and de-energized lines while using the proper tools and test equipment.

  • Climb different structures (wood, steel, concrete) using approved climbing methods and equipment.

  • Work at heights, in confined spaces, and in proximity to energized equipment.

  • Operate and maintain bucket trucks, digger derricks, tensioners and pullers and other pieces of overhead line equipment.

  • Work outdoors in varying environmental conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, wind, and inclement weather.

  • Available to work outages, storms, emergencies including on call rotation.

  • Perform live‑line work using approved gloving and hot‑stick techniques of energized lines, including troubleshooting and fault locating.

  • Follow all safety protocols including PPE use and possess a comprehensive understanding of insulated protective cover to isolate differences of potential.

Minimum Requirements

  • Three (3) years of recent overhead line experience.

  • Valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL).

  • Willing to travel long distances on short notice.

  • Lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

  • Work for extended periods at job locations, including out‑of‑state assignments.

  • Willing to work outside of normal business hours, including weekends, holidays, emergency callouts, and overtime.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you will be required to talk, listen and use hand signals to communicate. The job frequently requires you to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle objects, operate tools or controls; reach with hands and arms.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you are frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. You are occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at construction job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. You will perform job responsibilities in extreme heat, cold, wet, windy, and storm conditions.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

  • HSA, dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability

  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and family and medical leave

If this sounds like you, come join the PIKE family.

About Us

Founded in 1945, Pike is a leading provider of construction, repair and engineering services for electric and gas utilities, as well as telecommunications companies with a growing portfolio of turnkey renewable projects. We work with hundreds of utility clients across the country, and we continuously expand our offerings to supply our customers with the ideas, technology, experience, workforce and equipment to perform any job.

"Essential" is the one word that sums up who we are, the work we do and what our people mean to us. Each of our employees plays a critical role in ensuring that infrastructure systems are up and running when people and businesses need them.

Pike is a family-oriented workplace with a strong culture of safety, collaboration, innovation and exceptional customer service.

Comerțul este vital pentru economia globală, creând oportunități și îmbunătățind calitatea vieții oamenilor din întreaga lume. Cu o echipă dedicată, diversă și profesionistă formată din peste 115.000 de angajați, reprezentând 160 de naționalități din 78 de țări de pe șase continente, DP World împinge limitele comerțului spre lanțuri de aprovizionare mai fluide, pregătite pentru viitor.

Transformăm rapid și integrăm afacerile noastre – Porturi și Terminale, Servicii Marine, Logistică și Tehnologie – unind infrastructura globală cu expertiza locală pentru a crea soluții de lanț de aprovizionare mai puternice și mai eficiente, schimbând modul în care lumea face comerț.

Mai mult decât atât, remodelăm viitorul prin investiții în inovație. De la sisteme inteligente de livrare până la stivuirea automată în depozite, ne aflăm în fruntea tehnologiilor disruptive, conducând sectorul către modalități mai bune de a face comerț, minimizând întreruperile de la linia de producție până la ușa clientului.

Misiunea DP World este de a transcende granițele și de a construi punți între toate națiunile și culturile – nu doar prin ceea ce facem, ci și prin modul în care acționăm.

Suntem dedicați creării unei culturi în care fiecare persoană să se simtă respectată, sprijinită și împuternicită să-și atingă potențialul maxim. Credem că acceptarea diversității și incluziunii stimulează inovația și creșterea, ajutându-ne să conectăm oameni, afaceri și societăți. Mințile libere și perspectivele diferite schimbă lumea, iar împreună putem schimba ceea ce este posibil.

title: Acting Headteacher Viewforth High School
description:
Proposed Interview Date: Thursday 24 September 2026

Closing Date: Sunday 20 September 2026

Contract Type: Temporary until June 2028

Salary: DHHT13 £98,904

Working Pattern: 36 Hours per week

Location: Viewforth High School

Purpose and Values of Education Directorate

The Education Directorate is committed to Improving Life Chances for All through a wide range of direct services which support our children, young people, families and the wider Fife community. Our approach to improvement is rooted in our core values: Compassion, Ambition, Respect and Equity which reflect the ethos, culture and practice principles of all staff across the directorate. We strive to ensure that our attitudes and behaviour reflect these core values in all our dealings with children, young people, their families, and the wider community in partnership with those who support them.

Supporting Statement

As part of your application, you must provide us with a Supporting Statement which outlines to us how your skills and experience make you a good candidate for this vacancy. For more information, check out the How to Apply section of our Career Site. Without a Supporting Statement, your application will not be progressed. Please upload your Supporting Statement at the section marked ‘upload resumé’. Your Supporting Statement must not be a CV. More information is available on our Career site at .

Please consider and demonstrate the following when completing your Supporting Statement:

Ways in which you have modelled and promoted the GTCS Professional Values (social justice, trust, respect and integrity) and Professional Commitment in your current and previous roles.

(Consider the following: how you have ensured equity of opportunity for all; how you have developed relationships built on trust and respect that enable others to take responsibility; how your moral and ethical principles inform your practice and how your own professional learning underpins your development as a leader and the development of others.)

How you have used your knowledge, skills and understanding of leading strategic change to bring about improvement.

Your ability to build capacity, through inspiring and motivating others to be leaders of

learning.

Partnership working which has led to a positive impact on outcomes for learners.

(School, local, regional and national levels, if appropriate).

How you have used self-evaluation to inform decisions and improvements across a school community.

(Consider the following: how have you promoted the professional learning of others through your strategic leadership, how have you ensured all stakeholders are involved in decision-making around school improvement priorities and how have you made best use of resources to support the development of the curriculum, pedagogy, people and teams.)

Job Details

We are looking for a highly skilled school leader who is passionate about improving life chances for all through commitment to leading change and improvement that ensures positives outcomes for our children and young people. As a Headteacher in Fife you will be responsible for the strategic direction of the school, implementing and pursuing the objectives set in policies, and for contributing to the development of a self-improving system across the education community and beyond.

Qualification, Registration and Skill Requirements

You are required to have high levels of interpersonal skills and abilities which will enable you to lead and manage the school community, both at strategic and operational levels, to ensure continuous improvement.

You are required to demonstrate a commitment to your own professional learning as a school leader through career-long professional learning activity and to be able to show how this has impacted on your practice.

You are required to be fully registered with the General Teaching Council for Scotland (GTCS) and to model all behaviour expected of a Teacher in Scotland in line with the relevant Professional Standards.

As of 1st August 2020, all successful candidates appointed to a permanent Headteacher role in Scotland are required to hold the Standard for Headship, through completion of the Scottish Qualification for Headship (SQH), Flexible Route to Headship (FRH) or Into Headship. For those appointed, who do not yet hold the Standard for Headship, you will be required to complete the Into Headship qualification within 30 months of appointment. Please note that those candidates who already or have previously held a permanent Headteacher position are not required to complete the Into Headship programme and will not need to complete it within 30 months of appointment.

Before confirming to your appointment, you will be required to obtain Protection of Vulnerable Groups (PVG) scheme membership through Disclosure Scotland and become a member of the relevant PVG scheme.

description:
Om Ditt Café

Varumärket Ditt Café ägs och förvaltas av de fyra bolagen Stigs Café och Bageri AB, Agdas Café i Apladalen, Bernts Konditori AB och Bernards Konditori AB. Under varumärket samlas 9 caféer samt en produktionsanläggning/kontor som nu befinner sig i Gnosjö. Vi bedriver verksamhet på fem orter inom Jönköpings län och sysselsätter runt 70 medarbetare.

Vår affärsidé är att vara ledande på den lokala marknaden, erbjuda närproducerade bageri, konditori- och restaurangvaror i en attraktiv miljö med hög kvalitet, personligt bemötande och med kunden i fokus. Vi arbetar efter våra kärnvärden glädje, kvalitet och engagemang och vi är övertygade om att den största framgången nås genom ett välfungerande lagarbete.

Här på Dittcafe så jobbar vi tillsammans och stöttar varandra, för oss är det viktigt att vi hjälps åt och stöttar upp där det behövs, vilket då också skapar vår sanna laganda.

Bernts söker en kallskänka som vill bli en del av vårt team!

Vi söker dig som trivs med att arbeta med mat, är noggrann och gillar ett arbete där tempot kan variera. Tjänsten passar dig som vill ha ett återkommande schema, men också möjlighet att arbeta extra vid behov.

Om tjänsten

Vi söker i första hand en kallskänka som kan arbeta var tredje helg, natten mellan fredag och lördag. Arbetet innebär bland annat förberedelser och produktion av våra kalla produkter inför helgens försäljning och leveranser.

Utöver de schemalagda nätterna ser vi gärna att du är flexibel och kan hoppa in vid sjukdom och VAB när behov uppstår.

Vi söker även dig som vill arbeta extra vid behov under lov och ledigheter samt under perioder då vi har högre arbetsbelastning. Arbetspassen kan förekomma både dagtid och nattetid.

Vi söker dig som

  • Har erfarenhet av arbete som kallskänka eller liknande arbete inom café, restaurang eller livsmedel
  • Är noggrann, ansvarstagande och självgående
  • Trivs med att arbeta i ett högt tempo
  • Har känsla för kvalitet och presentation
  • Är flexibel och kan ställa upp när verksamheten behöver extra hjälp
  • Tycker om att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra
  • Är positiv och bidrar till en god stämning på arbetsplatsen


Vi erbjuder

Hos oss får du arbeta i ett härligt team i en verksamhet där det händer mycket. Du får ett varierande arbete med möjlighet till återkommande arbetspass och extra timmar när behov finns.

Det finns möjlighet att kombinera de schemalagda nattpassen med extraarbete under dagtid, lov och vid arbetstoppar.

Arbetstid

  • Schemalagt arbete var tredje natt, fredag–lördag
  • Extra arbete vid sjukdom och VAB
  • Extraarbete vid behov under lov och ledigheter
  • Extra pass både dagtid och nattetid när vi har mycket att göra

Ansökan

Känner du att detta skulle passa dig? Då ser vi gärna att du skickar in din ansökan till oss!

Vi arbetar med löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Välkommen med din ansökan – vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Bernts konditori

title: Foreman - Overhead (AP)
description:
Position Summary

The Foreman is a safety focused professional with the ability to lead a crew to construct and repair electrical overhead distribution systems. You will work on energized and de‑energized powerlines and may be required to travel to different job sites, including out‑of‑state locations, as operational and customer needs dictate. You will report to the General Foreman.

Essential Functions

  • Perform new construction, maintain and repair energized and de‑energized overhead distribution systems while putting safety first.

  • Lead crew members and conduct pre-job and tailgate safety briefings.

  • Must be experienced with coaching and training lower classification employees in safe and productive work procedures.

  • Oversee work related to each project and assume full responsibility for its quality and completion deadline.

  • Install and repair overhead power lines, poles, insulators, conductors and related hardware.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of switching and tagging procedures, grounding and induced voltage on energized and de-energized lines while using the proper tools and test equipment.

  • Climb different structures (wood, steel, concrete) using approved climbing methods and equipment.

  • Work at heights, in confined spaces, and in proximity to energized equipment.

  • Operate and maintain bucket trucks, digger derricks, tensioners and pullers and other pieces of overhead line equipment.

  • Work outdoors in varying environmental conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, wind, and inclement weather.

  • Available to work outages, storms, emergencies including on call rotation.

  • Perform live‑line work using approved gloving and hot‑stick techniques of energized lines, including troubleshooting and fault locating.

  • Follow all safety protocols including PPE use and possess a comprehensive understanding of insulated protective cover to isolate differences of potential.

Minimum Requirements

  • Five (5) years of recent overhead line experience.

  • Proficient in basic computer operations including Microsoft Word and other Microsoft Office applications.

  • Valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL).

  • Willing to travel long distances on short notice.

  • Lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

  • Work for extended periods at job locations, including out‑of‑state assignments.

  • Willing to work outside of normal business hours, including weekends, holidays, emergency callouts, and overtime

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you will be required to talk, listen and use hand signals to communicate. The job frequently requires you to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle objects, operate tools or controls; reach with hands and arms.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you are frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. You are occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at construction job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. You will perform job responsibilities in extreme heat, cold, wet, windy, and storm conditions.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

  • HSA, dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability

  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and family and medical leave

If this sounds like you, come join the PIKE family.

About Us

Founded in 1945, Pike is a leading provider of construction, repair and engineering services for electric and gas utilities, as well as telecommunications companies with a growing portfolio of turnkey renewable projects. We work with hundreds of utility clients across the country, and we continuously expand our offerings to supply our customers with the ideas, technology, experience, workforce and equipment to perform any job.

"Essential" is the one word that sums up who we are, the work we do and what our people mean to us. Each of our employees plays a critical role in ensuring that infrastructure systems are up and running when people and businesses need them.

Pike is a family-oriented workplace with a strong culture of safety, collaboration, innovation and exceptional customer service.

Pike Electric LLC, is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Associate - Product Controller
description:
Role Overview

This role supports the Controllers organization within the Retail Banking/Card business, with primary responsibility for month-end close, management reporting, regulatory/SEC support, and ongoing enhancement of financial and regulatory reporting processes and controls. The associate will partner closely with Card business leaders, Finance, Project Managers, and control groups to deliver accurate, timely, and well-governed reporting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Month-end close & reporting oversight
    • Prepare, review, and supervise month-end close and reporting deliverables, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
    • Perform and review variance analysis, identify key drivers, and communicate insights to stakeholders and management.
  • Financial, SEC & regulatory submissions
    • Support preparation and review of financial reporting and documentation required for internal and external reporting.
    • Provide support for SEC and regulatory reporting processes, including coordination, validation, and timely issue resolution.
  • Recovery & Resolution / US regulatory support
    • Support periodic Recovery & Resolution appendices and other US regulatory submissions, ensuring adherence to governance and documentation standards.
  • Systems, controls, and change management
    • Review, test, and validate system enhancements impacting financial and regulatory reporting (e.g., SAP/Essbase outputs, upstream/downstream impacts).
    • Drive process improvements, strengthen controls, and implement sustainable procedures to reduce operational risk.
  • Accounting standards & policy implementation
    • Assist with adoption of new US GAAP accounting standards and evolving regulatory requirements; assess impacts and support implementation and reporting updates.
  • Stakeholder management & escalation
    • Build strong working relationships across Card leadership, Finance, PMs, and control partners.
    • Proactively and constructively escalate issues, and present complex topics clearly and concisely to management.
  • People development
    • Coach and support onboarding for new joiners and junior team members; contribute to a strong team culture and knowledge-sharing.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (required).
  • Experience: 8–10 years in an accounting/controllership environment (internal or external).
  • Preferred certifications: CA / CPA / MBA (Finance).
  • Domain preference: Prior experience in Controllers within Retail Banking/Card (preferred).

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong understanding of US GAAP (preferred).
  • Strong analytical capability including variance analysis and ability to synthesize large datasets into clear messaging for leadership.
  • Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and attention to detail; able to operate with appropriate governance and controls mindset.
  • Ability to learn quickly, structure an approach, and execute to deliver results in a deadline-driven environment.

Two-year business, construction management, or related degree preferred with minimum of 1-year appropriate course work in project management, accounting, finance, or business preferred.

title: Groundman - Transmission (Oncor)
description:
Position Summary

The Groundman is your first step to a rewarding career in the construction and maintenance of our nation's Power Grid. You will report to the Foreman.

Essential Functions

  • Perform new construction, maintain and repair de‑energized powerlines while putting safety first.

  • Help install and repair overhead transmission lines, poles, insulators, conductors and related hardware.

  • You will perform rigorous physical labor and regularly lift heavy tools and equipment.

  • Maintain company vehicles, equipment and tools in good work order.

  • Work outdoors in varying environmental conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, wind, and inclement weather.

  • Available to work outages, storms, emergencies including on call rotation.

  • Inspect rubber goods and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

  • Follow all safety protocols and understand when to wear Personal Protective Equipment.

Minimum Requirements

  • Valid Driver's License and ability to obtain a valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL) within 60 days.

  • Willingness to travel long distances on short notice.

  • Lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

  • Work for extended periods at different job locations, including out‑of‑state assignments.

  • Willing to work outside of normal business hours, including weekends, holidays, emergency callouts, and overtime.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you will be required to talk, listen and use hand signals to communicate. The job frequently requires you to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle objects, operate tools or controls; reach with hands and arms.

Work Environment

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you are frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. You are occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at construction job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. You will perform job responsibilities in extreme heat, cold, wet, windy, and storm conditions.

Our Benefits

  • HSA, dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts

Pike is a family-oriented workplace with a strong culture of safety, collaboration, innovation and exceptional customer service.

title: Python Developer / Data Scientist
description:
A Python developer with a data science background to become the long-term owner of the NDT project. The developer will co-build across the entire codebase with the current team to understand it and then take over ownership once the current team leaves. From that point, the developer will keep the project running and continuously adapt it to changing business requirements.

Expected Tools & Knowledge

Must have

  • Python: solid and production-minded
  • Experiment tracking with MLflow
  • Collaborative programming and Git
  • Self-reliance, with the ability to unblock minor technical issues independently

Nice to have

  • Classical machine learning
  • REST / FastAPI

Responsibilities

  • Co-build across the entire codebase with the current team and prepare to take full ownership once they leave.
  • Own the project long term, maintain it, and continuously adapt it to changing business requirements.
  • Collect new data and re-trigger model training when needed.
  • Critically challenge the training data and determine whether a model is good enough to deploy.

Python & Software Engineering

  • Solid, production-minded Python.
  • Comfortable taking over and maintaining an existing codebase.
  • Uses Git and works effectively in a collaborative development setup.

Data Science & Model Judgment

  • Questions whether the training data is sound and whether a model is genuinely ready to deploy, rather than trusting metrics at face value.
  • Evaluates model performance and knows when to collect data and retrain.

Business Stakeholder Interaction

  • Works directly with business stakeholders to understand and clarify changing requirements.
  • Translates business requests into concrete changes to the project.
  • Communicates results and model limitations clearly to non-technical audiences.

title: Learning Engagement Coordinator
description:
Learning Engagement Coordinator

Marbles Kids Museum is a vibrant, nonprofit children’s museum and IMAX Theatre located in the heart of downtown Raleigh. Marbles has been sparking imagination, discovery, and learning through play since opening its doors in 2007. Marbles’ serves a diverse population of families, school groups, and community organizations through award-winning play-based exhibits, summer camps, IMAX documentaries, feature movies, and special events year-round. Today Marbles ranks among the top family destinations in North Carolina providing learning experiences for children with creative programs, and larger-than-life movies.

The Opportunity

At Marbles, every program is an opportunity to ignite imagination and create meaningful learning moments for children and families. We are seeking a passionate Learning Engagement Coordinator responsible for coordinating and delivering facilitated learning programming in the museum, including Family STEM Club, Ready Set School, Masterminds, Summer Camp Pre-K Lead, Guest Star Fitness, and offsite Saturday events. In addition, they play a key role in leading a Guest Star Scientists Program.

Job Responsibilities

  • Deliver facilitated hands-on, play-based daily programming and activities geared towards children ages 0-11, with occasional delivery at off-site locations.
  • Coordinate with sponsors and other external partners to deliver and support engaging programs and activities.
  • Lead and assist with learning events, including but, not limited to planning food, activities, and setting up and breaking down events.
  • Coordinate and lead Guest Star Scientist Program in coordination with external partners.
  • Provide exceptional, proactive customer service by initiating and engaging in interactions with museum guests.
  • Collect and share data, including but not limited to programmatic surveys and participation numbers on museum programs and events.
  • Perform all other duties assigned by the supervisor.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Train and supervise interns and volunteers involved in the programs this role facilitates.

Ideal Experience & Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Child Development, Education, or a related field preferred.
  • 2 years of experience delivering engaging learning experiences for children (0-11 years old) and creating inspiring environments is ideal.
  • 2 years of experience in early childhood development and play-based learning preferred.
  • Proven ability to initiate, prioritize, organize, and execute multiple projects at a time.
  • Demonstrated ability to share creative, fresh ideas.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Valid driver’s license and clean driving record.

Physical Demands

  • Walking, standing, stooping, bending, and reaching.
  • Ability to stand for long periods of time.
  • Must frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

Work Environment

  • Exposure to a noisy and crowded atmosphere.
  • May need to walk between two buildings with some outdoor exposure.
  • Schedule is generally Tuesday-Saturday with flexibility required, including weekends, evenings, and holidays.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision insurance

  • Health Savings and flexible spending accounts

  • Life and AD&D insurance

  • Short and Long-Term Disability

  • Parking benefits and GoTriangle Bus Pass

  • Paid time off for 17 vacation days and 9 holidays

  • Eligible to participate in the Company’s 401k program with employer matching after a waiting period

  • Employee Assistance Program

  • Great Marbles Perks & Discounts

  • Fitness Benefits

If you require reasonable accommodations to complete the hiring process, please contact the People Team at ojohnson@marbleskidsmuseum.org or 919-857-1069.

Please be aware that employment with Marbles Kids Museum is contingent on a satisfactory background check and references.

Marbles Kids Museum is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment opportunities because of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, disability, genetic information or any other federal, state or local protected class.

title: Receiving Clerk
description:
SUMMARY: Responsible for the proper receiving and tagging for stock activities, insuring the proper quantity and quality of product is received.

This position has a 1am start time

This position supports AWG’s mission to remain firmly committed to our long-established mission statement:

“Our mission is to ensure the success of our member retailers and provide opportunities to our employees. This will be accomplished by satisfying the customers’, and our member retailers’, needs for quality supermarket merchandise and superior support services. We will do this with high quality employees whose mission is to provide the lowest possible cost of goods in order to ensure our members profitability, competiveness and continued growth.”

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The individual must have the ability to perform the responsibilities listed below. The list is not all inclusive of duties that may be requested by the department head or a member of upper management but are intended for an understanding of the purpose of the position. It is the responsibility of each individual at AWG to provide ultimate customer service to our members to support their efforts in increasing same store sales and profits.

  1. Verify driver's purchase order with the receiving schedule for schedule appointment.
  2. Compare bill of lading versus receiving document.
  3. Check completed paperwork for variances.
  4. Check product for contamination and or infestation.
  5. Stamp the bill of lading and note shortages.
  6. Give copy of paperwork to driver and file remaining paperwork.
  7. Tag the pallet of product with proper pallet tag.
  8. Communicate with supervisor any issues and concerns relating to position.
  9. Keep area clean.
  10. Work as a member of the AWG team so the total job responsibilities are met. Actions must always stress a sense of cooperation, integrity, tact and consideration with our members, associates and division management.

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. A reasonable accommodation will be considered according to the ADA if it would not impose an undue hardship on the operations of the business without significant difficulty or expense. The accommodation would permit a qualified employee the ability to perform all essential functions of the job within the safety and company guidelines of the position.

EDUCATION/CERTIFICATIONS and/or EXPERIENCE: High school diploma preferred; prior warehouse experience plus warehouse mobile equipment operating experience preferred.

LANGUAGE SKILLS: Ability to read and speak fluent English. Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating instructions, procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence relating to position.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS: Ability to calculate figures and apply concepts of basic math and algebra.

REASONING ABILITY: Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form. Posses the ability to work with coworkers and gain mutual respect with a common goal of increasing sales and profitability.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl; and smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Must have the ability to operate safely warehouse mobile equipment.

WORK ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions providing a hardship is not required of the company or membership.

Indoors, with adequate cooling, heating, and adequate lighting. Outdoors as needed. Working in warehouse environment with moderate noise due to industrial mobile equipment operation and varied temperatures based on assigned work area. title: Senior Frontend Developer (Shopify)
description:
Are you our new Senior Frontend Developer (Shopify)?

Do you want to build high-quality ecommerce experiences on Shopify for ambitious Danish and international brands? At Novicell, you will work with modern Shopify storefronts in close collaboration with backend developers, solution architects, project managers, and specialists across UX, CRO, SEO, and paid media. The Shopify team is growing quickly, and this role is designed to strengthen our ability to deliver robust, scalable, and high-performing frontend solutions across both new implementations and ongoing client development.

Then this opportunity might be just the step you’re looking for in your career.

A part of the team

Novicell is a leading digital consulting firm that helps companies realize their digital potential. We combine technical expertise with creative innovation to deliver tailored solutions to our clients. Our diverse team of specialists works together with one goal in mind: to create exceptional results and push the boundaries of digital development.

As a Senior Frontend Developer in our Shopify Team, you will be part of the Platform Solutions Unit, working closely with backend developers, solution architects, project managers, and specialists across adjacent disciplines. Your primary focus will be theme‑based Shopify frontend development, where you will take both hands‑on implementation responsibility and senior ownership of frontend workstreams across projects.

This is not only about building features. It is also about making sound technical decisions, structuring solutions for long‑term maintainability, and helping ensure high standards in frontend delivery across the Shopify Team. In senior capacity, you are expected to take ownership of your area, collaborate directly with clients when relevant, and help drive work forward from scoping to delivery.

Your Responsibilities

  • Designing, building, and maintaining high-quality storefront solutions on Shopify
  • Developing and extending Shopify themes using Liquid, HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript
  • Taking ownership of frontend workstreams across new and existing client projects
  • Translating design, business, and user requirements into performant and maintainable frontend solutions
  • Collaborating closely with backend developers on integrated functionality and custom frontend requirements
  • Advising on the best approach for theme customizations, reusable components, and frontend architecture within Shopify
  • Taking part in client dialogue to provide qualified technical sparring on frontend-related decisions
  • Supporting solution scoping and estimation together with developers, project managers, and solution architects
  • Making informed technical trade‑offs and communicating them clearly to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders
  • Acting as a quality gate through code reviews, sparring, and shared standards across frontend delivery
  • Contributing to reusable patterns, best practices, and continuous improvement within the Shopify Team

Your day‑to‑day tasks will include

  • Building and maintaining Shopify storefront features and theme customizations
  • Implementing sections, templates, components, and content structures in Shopify
  • Writing clean, well‑structured, and maintainable frontend code
  • Collaborating closely with designers and specialists to ensure strong implementation quality
  • Debugging frontend issues across browsers, devices, and environments
  • Reviewing code from other developers and contributing to shared frontend standards
  • Working closely with backend developers, architects, and project managers on solution design and delivery
  • Supporting QA, regression validation, and release readiness across projects
  • Participating in technical workshops and internal sparring sessions when scoping or refining solutions
  • Helping ensure that delivered solutions are stable, scalable, and maintainable over time

We expect that…

  • You have 5+ years of experience working with frontend development for ecommerce platforms
  • You have solid experience with Shopify frontend development
  • You are confident working with Liquid, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS/SCSS
  • You are comfortable taking technical ownership and leading frontend workstreams on projects
  • You can translate business and design requirements into clear technical solutions and executable tasks
  • You work in a structured, pragmatic way and follow initiatives from idea to production
  • You communicate confidently in spoken and written English. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement
  • You are comfortable working directly with clients when needed and can explain technical trade-offs clearly
  • You thrive in cross‑functional collaboration with developers, project managers, and specialists

Nice To Have (but Not Required)

  • Experience with Shopify Plus
  • Experience with React, Vue, or similar frontend frameworks
  • Experience with headless commerce or modern frontend architecture
  • Experience from an agency or consultancy environment
  • An eye for frontend quality related to UX, CRO, and accessibility

In return, we offer

  • Challenging and meaningful tasks on real‑world ecommerce platforms
  • Strong focus on professional and personal development
  • Ambitious and inspiring colleagues across disciplines
  • Great career opportunities in a growing Shopify practice
  • Salary based on qualifications

Get a chance to work at a “flink” and “flittig” workplace

Work amongst innovative and inspiring colleagues in a challenging work environment, in which your contribution is highly valued. Here at Novicell we have replaced extensive employee handbooks and ancient rules with dialogue, responsibility, and trust. We encourage social interaction to create an even better work environment and it is our shared opinion that work must be enjoyable. title: DevOps Engineer - Emerging Technologies
description:
Do you like to solve complex problems in order to delight customers? Want to work side-by-side with passionate and talented people who love their jobs?

You'll need to have excellent communication and cross-group collaboration skills, be able to make forward progress despite ambiguous circumstances, be a self starter, a quick learner of new technologies and have experience shipping products. You will be a critical part of the DevOps/SRE team for a high-performing, low latency enterprise application. You will be responsible for planning and design of new infrastructure, contributing to the deployment architecture of core functionality and future planning for this exciting endeavor. We need someone who is something of a generalist - a savant who can work on load balancers one day and optimize database performance the next. The ideal candidate has a strong mix of education and practical experience, and loves diving in to interesting problems head first.

This role requires your to operate, monitor, and triage applications in the production and non-production environments, ensuring reliability, scalability and performance across its low-latency, active/active cloud infrastructure.

The role will requires you to architect, build, and own robust CI/CD pipelines and automation systems, from design through long-term maintenance.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5 years of hands-on experience in infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability engineering.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, Go or Java.
  • Experience operating and supporting applications across cloud infrastructure ( eg, AliCoud, AWS and GCP).
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, and Helm.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Good command on Linux, networking concepts (TLS/SSL, DNS, Load Balancers, etc.,) and troubleshooting skills in large scale environments
  • Exposure to AI-assisted or AI-infused automation in DevOps workflows (e.g., using LLM-based tools, copilots, or intelligent agents for scripting, incident triage, or pipeline optimization).
  • Hands on experience in one or more databases (Relational / NoSQL like Oracle, MongoDB). Experience managing large Databases with very high transaction rates. Knowledge of Oracle Database architecture and replication.
  • Hands-on experience with Splunk, Prometheus, and Grafana.
  • BS or MS in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent education/experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8 years of hands-on experience in infrastructure, DevOps, or software engineering, with a proven track record of independently owning complex systems or initiatives from start to finish.
  • Extensive experience architecting and operating multi-region, high-availability infrastructure across AliCloud, AWS and GCP, with ownership of cloud cost, resilience, and scaling strategy.
  • Proven ownership of build/release systems and CI/CD pipelines at scale, including designing pipeline architecture, improving reliability, and reducing release friction.
  • Proven experience in Terraform, Pulumi, and Helm, including designing reusable modules and adopting organizational-level IaC standards.
  • Proven ability to operate with minimal direction: scoping ambiguous problems, proposing architecture, executing, and being accountable for outcomes.
  • Hands-on experience designing and building AI-powered automation for DevOps, including LLM-powered runbooks, autonomous remediation agents, anomaly detection pipelines, and AI-assisted code/infra review tools, with a proven track record of team adoption.

The Primary Therapist provides individual, group and family therapy, crisis intervention services, psychoeducation presentations and experiential learning groups for clients and their families.

  • Provides clinical services including individual, group and family therapy, crisis intervention services, primary process groups, psychoeducation presentations and experiential learning groups for clients and families.

  • Ability to demonstrate an understanding of diverse cultures and gender-specific issues and ability to incorporate needs of gender and culturally diverse groups into practice setting.
  • Excellent organizational skills, including the ability to prioritize workload and work independently.
  • Proficient computer skills.

title: Linen Attendant - NoMad Singapore
description:
The Linen Attendant is responsible for the management, storage, and control of all hotel linen, uniforms, and related inventory items to ensure smooth housekeeping operations and consistent service standards across the hotel.

This role ensures that all linens, guest supplies, and team member uniforms are properly maintained, organised, and available in the required quantities to support daily hotel operations. The Linen Room Attendant plays a key behind-the-scenes role in maintaining cleanliness, efficiency, and operational readiness throughout the hotel.

LINEN & UNIFORM MANAGEMENT

• Receive, sort, and organize all hotel linens and ensure proper storage and handling.
• Check team member uniforms for wear and tear and send for cleaning or repair when required.
• Ensure uniforms are properly maintained, organized, and readily available for distribution.
• Maintain orderly storage systems for all linen and uniform items.

INVENTORY CONTROL & STOCK MANAGEMENT

• Monitor and maintain inventory levels of linens, uniforms, and related supplies.
• Ensure sufficient stock levels are maintained at all times to support hotel operations.
• Keep accurate records of linen movement and inventory usage.
• Assist in stock-taking and inventory audits as required.

DELIVERY & HOUSEKEEPING SUPPORT

• Support the delivery of uniforms, linen, and housekeeping items to designated areas.
• Assist in setting up extra beds, cribs, and related guest room requirements when needed.
• Coordinate with Housekeeping to ensure timely fulfilment of linen and supply requests.
• Ensure smooth flow of linen between laundry, storage, and operational areas.

CLEANLINESS & ORGANISATION

• Maintain a clean, organized, and well-structured linen room at all times.
• Ensure all linen is stored in a hygienic and orderly manner.
• Follow proper procedures for handling soiled and clean linen.
• Uphold high standards of cleanliness and hygiene in all storage areas.

HEALTH, SAFETY & COMPLIANCE

• Adhere strictly to hotel Health & Safety regulations at all times.
• Use equipment safely and report any hazards or maintenance issues promptly.
• Follow proper procedures when handling laundry, chemicals, and cleaning materials.
• Ensure safe working practices are maintained in all linen operations.

EXPECTATIONS

The Linen Attendant is expected to:

• Demonstrate strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Maintain high standards of cleanliness, hygiene, and orderliness.
• Work efficiently to support housekeeping and operational needs.
• Show reliability and consistency in managing linen and uniform flow.
• Communicate effectively with Housekeeping and related departments.
• Maintain a positive and team-oriented attitude.
• Follow instructions accurately and support smooth daily operations.

• Previous experience in housekeeping, laundry, or linen operations preferred.
• Strong attention to detail and organisational ability.
• Basic communication skills (oral and written).
• Ability to work in a physically demanding, fast-paced environment.
• Commitment to maintaining high standards of hygiene and cleanliness.
• Good teamwork and interpersonal skills.
• Positive attitude with willingness to support operational needs.

title: Senior Scientist, Bioassay Team
description:
SystImmune is a leading and well-funded clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company located in Bothell, WA and Princeton, NJ. It specializes in developing innovative cancer treatments using its established drug development platforms, focusing on bi-specific, multi-specific antibodies, and antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). SystImmune has multiple assets in various stages of clinical trials for solid tumor and hematologic indications. Alongside ongoing clinical trials. SystImmune has a robust preclinical pipeline of potential cancer therapeutics in the discover and IND-enabling stages, representing cutting-edge biologics development. We offer an opportunity for you to learn and grow while making significant contributions to the company's success.

This is a hands-on laboratory role within the Immuno-Oncology Bioassay Team. The Senior Scientist will design, develop, execute, and automate high-throughput bioanalytical and functional assays to support the discovery and preclinical characterization of immuno-oncology antibody therapeutics, including bispecifics, multi-specific antibodies, and ADCs. This position requires daily bench work in a BSL-2 environment and close collaboration with cross-functional teams across discovery, translational science, and IND-enabling studies.

This position is full-time onsite position in Bothell, WA.

Responsibilities
  • Design, establish, and execute mechanism-driven in vitro preclinical bioassays (including ex vivo and human translational systems) to identify, characterize, and advance novel immuno-oncology antibody therapeutic
  • Perform routine assay runs, troubleshoot and resolve assay performance issues, and maintain assay documentation and SOPs.
  • Oversee sample management, method quality control, and inter-site harmonization through systems like LIMS.
  • Prepare written reports, assay summaries, and oral presentations for internal review, cross-functional meetings, and support regulatory submissions.
  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to assay platform standardization, automation across the expanded Bioassay Team.
  • Support IND-enabling studies, GLP transitions, and regulatory audits as assigned.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications
  • PhD in immunology, cancer biology or related field with 2-5+ years of relevant academic and/or pharmaceutical or biotech experience.
  • Hands-on experience in the discovery and development of protein therapeutics, with a focus on functional bioassays and mammalian cell culture.
  • Background in human immune cell biology, immune checkpoint signaling, or T-cell/B-cell receptor signaling research.
  • Direct experience developing and running bioassays for bispecific antibodies, multi-specific formats, or ADCs is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in high-dimensional data analysis and visualization (e.g., flow cytometry, multiplex assays) using tools such as R or Python.
  • Experience in assay automation is a plus.
  • Excellent time management, organizational skills, and written/oral communication abilities.
  • Possess the right attitude (agile, curious, positive, open-minded, “can-do” mindset), and have the ability and strong desire to “make things happen”

Work Environment

  • Bench top work in a BSL-2 laboratory environment, including potential exposure to biohazards
  • Adherence to Health and Safety standards when working with temperature-controlled systems, including liquid and vapor phase liquid nitrogen

Physical Demands

  • Occasional lifting to 30 pounds
  • Requires repetitive multi-channel pipetting, single channel pipetting, and computer data entry
  • Fine motor movements in fingers/hands to operate computers and other office and lab equipment, repetitive motion with lab equipment
  • Stooping, bending, crouching, reaching, or climbing ladders

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work

  • May need to work outside of standard working hours at times
  • This role is currently working onsite and is expected to work onsite for working hours, with flexibility to work start time.

Travel

  • Attendance and participation in national and international conferences encouraged

Compensation and Benefits:
The expected base salary range for this position is $90,000 - $140,000 annually. Actual compensation will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to a candidate’s level qualifications, experience, and skills.
While most offers typically fall within the low to mid-point of the range, we may extend an offer toward the higher end for exceptional candidates whose background and expertise exceeds the requirements of the role.

SystImmune is a leading and well-funded biotech company with a bright future. We offer an opportunity for you to learn and grow while making significant contributions to the company’s success. SystImmune offers a comprehensive benefits package including: 100% paid employee premiums for medical/dental/vision, also STD, LTD, a 401(k) plan with a 50% company match of up to 3% and a vesting schedule of only 5 years, 15 PTO days per year, sick leave, plus 11 paid holidays and MORE.

We offer an opportunity for you to learn and grow while making significant contributions to the company’s success.

SystImmune is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome diverse talent and encourage all qualified applicants to apply.

title: Spacecraft Avionics and C&DH Engineer
description:
METECS is seeking a motivated Spacecraft Avionics and Command and Data Handling Systems Engineer to support the NASA EV2 Command and Data Handling Branch. This position will contribute to the development and integration of avionics, computing, networking, and C&DH architecture for future Moon Base habitation systems, utility and infrastructure systems, and lunar surface assets.

The selected candidate will work with NASA personnel, contractors, engineering organizations, and other stakeholders to develop requirements, evaluate architecture options, define interfaces, support trade studies, and mature integrated Moon Base C&DH concepts. The work may include habitation systems, power and communications infrastructure, rovers, relay systems, partner-provided systems, and other lunar surface elements.
This on-site position involves working closely with NASA and contractor engineering teams through technical meetings, design reviews, integration efforts, demonstrations, and test events.

Responsibilities:
  • Develop Moon Base C&DH, avionics, computing, and network architecture.
  • Define and assess system requirements, interfaces, interoperability, redundancy, and fault management.
  • Identify architecture gaps, integration risks, constraints, and technical issues.
  • Evaluate computing and networking approaches for reliability and performance.
  • Develop and use testbeds, simulations, and emulators to support integration and verification.
  • Support testing, demonstrations, technical reviews, and discrepancy resolution.
  • Coordinate technical activities with NASA, contractors, partners, and engineering teams.
  • Document technical decisions, results, risks, and recommendations.

Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in electrical engineering, computer engineering, systems engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Experience with spacecraft avionics, command and data handling, embedded computing, network architecture, data systems, or a closely related technical area.
  • Experience with network protocols, network architecture, avionics communication systems, or distributed computing systems.
  • Ability to evaluate technical information, identify integration issues, and develop practical engineering recommendations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with customers, contractors, engineering teams, and other stakeholders.
  • Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams with a range of technical backgrounds.
  • Ability to create clear engineering documentation, requirements, interface descriptions, analysis products, and technical presentations.

Desired Qualifications:
  • Experience with spacecraft C&DH, flight computers, embedded systems, or avionics networks.
  • Familiarity with TSN, TTE, Deterministic Ethernet, or similar communication technologies.
  • Experience with network performance, redundancy, fault management, and resilient architecture.
  • Experience with integration labs, testbeds, simulations, hardware-in-the-loop systems, or spacecraft testing.
  • Knowledge of requirements management, interface development, architecture modeling, and verification planning.
  • Experience working with NASA, contractors, international partners, or other multidisciplinary organizations.
  • Familiarity with lunar surface systems, habitats, power and communications infrastructure, robotics, or autonomous systems.


Citizenship or lawful permanent resident required due to federal position.

About METECS

We are a high-performance team providing advanced engineering, software, and analysis solutions for human space flight and terrestrial applications. We develop and integrate custom software for NASA and other government and commercial customers utilizing a wide variety of in-house, commercial, and open-source technologies. Our specialties include robotics automation, embedded systems, hardware/software integration, multibody dynamics simulations, immersive computer graphics, XR systems and advanced web-based tools.
METECS is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including veterans and individuals with disabilities.

Each intern will also be paired with a mentor, to assist with pursuing a research project and guidance on career progression. We also boast a thriving programme of continuing education within the hospital, including dedicated weekly seminars for interns, as well as practical sessions, journal clubs, board review sessions, specialty rounds and book clubs.

An internship is a 12-18 month fixed term position awarded to qualified veterinary surgeons (usually early career) who wish to explore becoming a Specialist by achieving a Specialist qualification. A 12 month internship rotating through different Specialties is a requirement to be eligible to apply for the next step in Specialist training -a residency.

title: Associate - Analytics Solutions
description:
Within the JPMorganChase CCB Card Controllers organization, the Analytics Solutions Associate – Senior will support core controllership reporting and analytics (e.g., daily/month-end reporting and analysis, management reporting, balance sheet / P&L analytics, data quality monitoring, governance metrics, and ad-hoc executive insights). Job Responsibilities

Key responsibilities include the following.

  • - Build and maintain advanced SQL queries and curated datasets to enable reporting, trend analysis, and explain/bridge analytics.

  • - Develop Alteryx workflows and Python automation for data cleansing, transformation, reconciliation support, exception handling, and repeatable control checks.

  • - Design and implement scalable data pipelines and transformations in Databricks (e.g., reusable notebooks/jobs, performance-oriented processing patterns) to support controllership analytics.

  • - Lead end-to-end delivery of complex data/MI initiatives, including regular KPI updates and recurring reporting, while managing priorities across multiple concurrent deliverables and stakeholder deadlines.

  • - Provide day-to-day leadership behaviors (mentoring, best practices, delivery discipline) to foster continuous learning and improvement across the team.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

The role requires the following qualifications and skills.

  • - 7+ years of relevant experience with a B.Tech / MSc in Computer Science (or similar degree).

  • - 5+ years in data visualization, data management, data warehousing, or unstructured data environments

  • - Banking/Finance domain experience, ideally in controllership, reporting, or finance governance contexts.

  • - Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools such as JIRA/Confluence.
