title: Lifesharing (ID/A Program) Coordinator
description:
Lifesharing is a unique program that allows individuals (18 and older) with intellectual disabilities to live with qualified, trained providers and become a part of their lives and families. The Lifesharing Coordinator plays a key role in connecting individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities to Lifesharing provider homes that best match their needs, preferences, and goals. Working collaboratively with individuals, families, providers, and community partners, this role supports person‑centered planning, coordination of services, and successful integration into home and community life. This position ensures that services are delivered safely, compliantly, and in alignment with state and county regulations, while promoting dignity, independence, and meaningful community connection.

Each Coordinator supports a caseload of and regularly travels to Lifesharing provider homes within their assigned caseload. Homes are located throughout the Lehigh Valley region, with the primary office location based in Bethlehem, PA. This role balances community‑based work and administrative responsibilities.

Note: This role includes participation in an on‑call rotation and may require 15–20 hours of after‑hours direct care support when needed to ensure continuity of care.

What You’ll Do

  • Coordinate and oversee person‑centered plans that support individuals’ social, emotional, physical, and educational needs.
  • Match individuals with appropriate Lifesharing provider homes and support successful transitions.
  • Train and support providers to ensure understanding of individual service plans and regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor provider homes for quality, safety, and compliance with county and state regulations.
  • Facilitate team meetings and collaborate with Supports Coordination Organizations (SCOs), Administrative Entities (AEs), and other community partners.
  • Ensure timely and accurate documentation, including service notes, assessments, and required reviews.
  • Connect individuals and families to community resources, supports, and respite services.
  • Participate in on‑call coverage and respond to after‑hours needs as required.

Requirements

The selected candidate must meet all qualifying and ongoing job criteria including background checks, physical examination, and a driving history record.

Driving Requirements:

  • A valid US driver’s license for at least two years, not including time with permit.
  • No serious traffic convictions within the past three years. (Serious convictions include, but are not limited to, DUI, reckless driving, leaving the scene of an accident, or three or more traffic violations and/or at-fault accidents within that period).
  • Access to a reliable vehicle during work hours. Vehicle must have valid registration and inspection stickers.
  • Valid auto insurance. You will be asked to provide proof that you are a covered driver on the policy.

Education & Experience (one of the following):

  • Bachelor’s degree plus 2 years of experience supporting individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities and autism (IDD), OR
  • Associate degree/60 credits plus 4 years of experience supporting individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities and autism (IDD), OR
  • High school diploma plus 6 years of experience supporting individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities and autism (IDD)

Skills & Strengths:

  • Strong organizational, communication, and relationship‑building skills.
  • Ability to collaborate with individuals, families, providers, and public partners.
  • Knowledge of person‑centered planning and community‑based supports.
  • Comfort navigating documentation systems and common workplace technology.
  • Ability to balance office work, community‑based work, and on‑call responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of principles and methods of habilitation.
  • Knowledge of behavior management, safety techniques and program planning principles.
  • Knowledge of basic concepts in family therapy and group work.
  • Knowledge of disbursements of medications according to state licensing regulations. Knowledge of pertinent community resources and facilities.

Essential Working Conditions/Physical Demands:

  • Work in program sites and the community routinely providing direct care and/or support with individual(s).
  • Stand, sit or run by self, or to provide proper care and supervision with an individual.
  • Able to move and stay with an individual to keep them safe, both in home environment and community, both at near and far distances, even when an individual may struggle to meet identified expectations.
  • Able to assist an individual who has fallen, regardless of weight or size.
  • Walk, climb stairs by self, or to provide direct care and/or support.
  • Work in a standard office environment. Utilize desktop computer equipment on a daily basis. Able to lift or move items associated with sedentary work and light work (exert up to 20 lbs.) Travel to offsite locations and regional office locations if necessary.

Work Environment

  • Lifesharing coordinators work both in our Bethlehem office and the community.
  • This role qualifies for hybrid remote work, subject to the Access Services Hybrid Remote Work Policy and supervisor approval. Decisions regarding hybrid remote work will be based on individual performance, program requirements, and the overall needs of Access Services.

Benefits

Schedule and Compensation

  • The work schedule is generally within regular business hours (e.g., Monday–Friday, 9AM-5PM) with flexibility to adapt to the needs of the caseload.
  • Participation in a paid on‑call rotation is required, which may include evenings or weekends as needed.
  • Hourly rate starts at $21.50/hour, based on education and experience.

What You’ll Gain at Access Services

When you join our team, you’re not just getting a job, you’re stepping into a career with real support, growth, and impact. We offer a benefits package designed to meet you where you are in life.

  • Health & Security: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and prescription coverage, plus company-paid life insurance, disability protection and catastrophic sick leave. Access Services covers up to 88% of health premium with many employees paying less than $150/month.
  • Time to Recharge: Full-time employees start their first year earning up to nearly 6 weeks of paid time off (20+ PTO days plus 9 paid holidays), with even more time added as you grow your career with us.
  • Invest in Your Future: 401(k) with company match, tuition reimbursement program, and access to college tuition discounts.
  • Built into the Job: Mileage & Toll Reimbursement.
  • Support Beyond Work: Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free, confidential resources for you and your family, including:
    • Counseling and emotional support through in-person, telehealth and text therapy.
    • Financial and legal guidance
  • Grow With Us: Paid training, ongoing professional development, and opportunities to learn and advance across diverse roles and programs.

Access Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Special Investigations Analyst, Senior
description:
Your Role


The Special Investigations Unit (SIU) is responsible for detecting, investigating, and preventing healthcare fraud, waste, and abuse involving providers, facilities, members, and brokers across all lines of business, and for coordinating with law enforcement and regulatory agencies. The Special Investigations Analyst, Senior will report to the Senior Manager, Special Investigations Unit. In this role you serve as the front of the SIU detection pipeline, independently identifying suspect providers and emerging fraud schemes through advanced data mining and claims analysis.

You will quantify financial exposure, develop well-supported lead packages, and drive the analysis that enables prepayment review placement, investigation, and payment containment. Your work directly protects members and reduces the cost of healthcare by stopping improper payments before they are made.

Your Work

In this role, you will:

  • Lead development of complex fraud leads within the Individual & Family Plan (IFP) line of business, linking and analyzing multiple datasets to identify underlying schemes, trends, and financial exposure, with focus on substance use disorder and behavioral health provider fraud
  • Build and maintain detection queries, analytic models, and repeatable workflows that identify suspect providers, aberrant billing patterns, and rapid claim-volume escalation
  • Quantify provider-level financial exposure and produce high quality, audit ready lead and case packages that support SIU prioritization and investigative decision making
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguous analytic problems and deliver well supported lead recommendations, including prepayment review placement
  • Communicate complex analytic findings and recurring program reporting clearly to SIU leadership and cross-functional stakeholders with limited guidance
  • Provide guidance, coaching, and quality review for other analysts on complex analyses and documentation standards
  • Partner with investigators, prepayment review staff, SIU leadership, Medical Directors, and internal business units to advance cases toward disposition
  • Ensure all data gathering, analysis, and documentation comply with applicable state and federal regulations and Blue Shield privacy and information security requirements
  • Other duties as assigned

Your Knowledge and Experience

  • Requires a bachelor's degree or High School Diploma/GED and 4 years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree

  • Requires 5 years of prior relevant experience in healthcare fraud analytics, claims analysis, payment integrity, audit, or a related investigative or analytical field

  • Requires advanced knowledge of health insurance reimbursement methodologies, coding frameworks (CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10, revenue codes), and government program requirements; coding certification such as CPC preferred

  • Requires proven ability to apply independent analytic judgment to complex, ambiguous scenarios and quantify financial exposure or relevant metrics

  • Requires advanced ability to read, interpret, and synthesize medical documentation without routine assistance

  • Requires strong written, verbal, and presentation skills with limited guidance, including the ability to produce defensible documentation for internal, regulatory, and law enforcement audiences

  • Requires proficient use of advanced analytic tools, queries, and visualization techniques used for fraud detection; SQL, Excel, and claims platforms such as Facets

  • Experience with fraud detection platforms such as HCFS preferred

  • Knowledge of behavioral health and other fraud schemes preferred

Hybrid

This role requires employees to be in-office based on our hybrid workplace model, balancing purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility. For most teams, this means coming into the office two days each week.

Employees living more than 50 miles from an office location will work with their manager to determine in-office time based on business need.

title: Junior Software Developer
description:
We are looking for a Junior Software Developer who wants to grow in modern software development and help build digital solutions for restaurants and foodtech.

This role is for you if you have a solid foundation in programming and want hands-on experience building, testing, and maintaining software with experienced developers and other team members.

You’ll work across multiple product areas and contribute to solutions used in everyday restaurant operations—such as POS, online ordering, kitchen screens, self-service kiosks, payments, and integrations.

About the role

As a Junior Software Developer, you’ll be part of our development team—developing, improving, and maintaining our digital products.

You’ll participate in the full development lifecycle, from understanding requirements and planning solutions to writing code, testing, troubleshooting, and following up on deliveries.

You’ll work closely with senior developers, product owners, QA, and other team members to deliver solutions with high quality, great user experience, and stable operations.

What you’ll do

  • Develop and maintain features in our web and backend solutions.
  • Write clean, structured, and testable code.
  • Participate in planning, estimation, and technical discussions.
  • Troubleshoot and analyze bugs in development and production.
  • Write and update unit and integration tests.
  • Contribute to building AI solutions.
  • Work with APIs, databases, and system integrations.
  • Review code with colleagues and give/receive feedback constructively.
  • Continuously improve development practices, code quality, and documentation.


What we’re looking for

  • Post-secondary education in software development, computer science, or equivalent knowledge.
  • Basic programming experience (e.g., JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, C#, Python, or similar).
  • Understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, and core software architecture.
  • Basic knowledge of databases, REST APIs, and Git version control.
  • Understanding of testing, debugging, and agile development methods.
  • Ability to communicate in English, both written and spoken.
  • A drive to learn, take ownership, and grow with the team.


Nice to have

  • Experience with React, Node.js, Java, TypeScript, or other modern frameworks.
  • Experience with cloud services, CI/CD, or containers.
  • Experience with SQL, relational databases, or message-based integrations.
  • Personal projects, open-source contributions, or relevant internship/work experience.
  • Experience building web applications, SaaS solutions, payments, POS systems, or e-commerce platforms.
  • Interest in AI tools and how they can be used for development, testing, and product innovation.

Who you are

You’re curious and solution-oriented—you like understanding how things work. You take initiative, ask questions when something is unclear, and use feedback to improve.

You work in a structured way and care about code quality, testing, and documentation, while also enjoying collaboration and sharing knowledge.

You don’t need to know everything from day one. The key is a strong technical foundation, genuine interest in software development, and the desire to grow in the role.

About us

We build digital systems used every day by restaurants and foodtech companies—POS, online ordering, self-service kiosks, payments, integrations, and customer-facing tools.

Our products operate in environments where stability, performance, and usability are critical. That’s why we work closely with customers and product teams to create solutions that make restaurant operations easier and more efficient.

Here, you’ll develop as a developer, work on real products, and be part of a team building the future of the digital restaurant experience.

title: Expert Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Ciklum is looking for a Expert Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning Engineer to join our team full-time in Poland.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Expert Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

In this role, you will operate as an Expert AI Engineer, fully integrated into our partner's technical ecosystem. You will architect, build, and scale the internal AI platform and infrastructure designed for both software developers and non-technical teams across the business.

Rather than focusing on a single framework or programming language, this role is evaluated on your hands-on experience building and shipping production AI tooling, including custom skills, MCP connectors, and autonomous agent workflows. You will combine this delivery focus with sharp security judgment around credential handling, least privilege access, and prompt injection defense to drive safe, company-wide AI adoption.

  • Host Infrastructure: Architect and manage scalable cloud hosting environments to support internal AI tools, model integrations, and regular automated execution pipelines

  • Agentic Execution & Automation: Design resilient multi-agent execution loops, integration layers, and orchestration pipelines that automate complex business and engineering tasks
  • AI FinOps & Governance: Implement token cost controls (semantic caching, model routing) and define internal AI governance standards, security policies, and quality benchmarks

Requirements:

  • Proficiency in any modern backend-focused programming language (e.g., Python, TypeScript/Node.js, Go, Java)—proven hands-on delivery in the AI enablement space matters far more than mastery of a specific language
  • Hands-on AI Tooling Delivery: Proven track record of building, shipping, and maintaining production AI tooling, including MCP connectors, custom skills, and agentic workflows
  • Security Judgment: Deep practical understanding of AI security risks, including secure credential handling, least privilege access controls, and prompt injection mitigation

  • Enablement & Leadership: Demonstrated ability to guide engineering teams through AI adoption, optimize team processes, and align AI initiatives with business outcomes

Desirable:

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment

  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Flexibility: Enjoy flexibility – full remote working possibilities
  • Care: We've got you covered with company-paid premium medical package through Luxmed

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

title: Substation Foreman (GPC)
description:
Position Summary: The Substation Foreman is responsible for the supervision, assignment and coordination of the Substation Construction and Maintenance activities to ensure a productive workforce that supports all divisional, departmental, site and corporate goals while in accordance with all company policies and local, state, and federal regulations. The Substation Foreman will direct the work and provide technical assistance to subordinates assigned to assist him/her and craft employees working under lump sum and fixed unit price contracts. The Substation Foreman requires 8-9 years of continuous experience with 5 of these years worked as Top Substation Technician A craft position, and will be responsible for identifying, properly tracking and reporting of completed job units to the Project Manager or General Foreman. The Substation Foreman will participate in job estimation and will be expected to attend pre-bid meetings and to conduct client pre-construction meetings. The Substation Foreman will be responsible for the safety and work quality of his crew. This is a working Foreman position, and it may also be required to travel to another state depending on customer demands.

**NOTE: TRAVEL TO FLORIDA AND OTHER STATES/LOCATIONS IS REQUIRED

Essential Functions:

Oversees job to ensure crew is working safely while performing new construction, maintenance or repair, testing, adjusting and troubleshooting work of substation equipment/systems which includes, but is not limited to, work involving the following:

  • Concrete Foundations, ground grids, and steel erection
  • Buswork (High and Low Voltage)
  • Airbreak / Hookstick Switches
  • Control Cable
  • Terminations (High / Low Voltage)
  • Control Buildings
  • Conduit and duck banks
  • Capacitor bank installations 23kv- 230 kv
  • Transformers, regulators and circuit breakers
  • Circuit Switchers, motor-operated and manual switches
  • Responsible for maintaining Company vehicles, test equipment and tools in good working conditions
  • Frequently works with energized high voltage systems requiring skill and care to protect the lives of themselves and others.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Able to perform rigorous physical labor.
  • Must be capable of climbing and working at heights up to 125 feet above ground.
  • Must possess a Commercial Drivers’ License.
  • Must supply own personal hand tools required by the company for this work.
  • Must supply own safety toed work boots.
  • Must be capable of lifting in excess of 50 lbs.
  • Must be capable of working in confined spaces/areas.
  • Must be able to work independently or with others.
  • Operational experience of various types of heavy equipment :
    • Bucket, derrick and boom trucks
    • Backhoes, excavators and skid steer loaders
    • Articulating Man-lifts
    • Pressure Diggers
    • Trenchers
    • Track Crawler Loader/Backhoe
    • Rough Terrain Telescopic Forklifts
  • Willing to work over-time or long hours during emergency conditions and/or when requested. Schedules can change frequently and with short notice.
  • 90% Travel Required
  • Capable of following Company safety rules and policies.
  • Must have extensive knowledge of construction standard practices, techniques, quality requirements, applicable codes and standards.
  • Must be capable of working in close proximity of energized substation equipment.
  • Must interpret substation structural drawings (i.e. elevations, plan views, section views, grounding details, and foundation plans) and communicate with customers and subordinates.
  • Ability to accurately appraise technical situations and recommend resolutions to problems.
  • Ability to lead/coach subordinates on the crew.
  • Ability to develop and interpret a material list.
  • Ability to trace out phasing in a substation and verify to the three line diagrams.
  • Proficient knowledge in all aspects of substation systems.
  • Ability to determine the proper phase shift and rotation in paralleling transformer banks.
  • Able to direct the daily work of the crew.
  • Have the capability of reading and working from drawings, specifications, procedures, standards, as well as the ability to work within the confines of a project’s performance schedule.
  • Responsibility for all crew members
  • Able to motivate work crew members and develop pride in crew members.
  • Ability to establish grade, elevations, and layout of foundations and cable trough in new and existing stations.
  • Able to work for extended periods in various locations, when requested.
  • Willing to work over-time when requested.
  • Willing to work outside of the normal work schedule including weekends, holidays, and overtime as required for the position.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to stand; walk; use hands to fingers, handle to feel; and reach with hands and arms.

Work Environment:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. The employee is occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at construction job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. This position is performed in outside weather conditions.

Competencies:

  • Self-Motivated
  • Team-Oriented
  • Customer Oriented
  • Must be able to follow Company safety rules and all other Company policies.

EOE/Minorities/Females/Vet/Disabled

Pike Electric, LLC is a Non-union Company

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties as requested to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer - Acquisition
description:
We are seeking a strong Senior Frontend Engineer - Acquisition to join our Acquisition team. This is primarily a senior engineering role focused on frontend architecture, React/TypeScript expertise, performance, ownership, and solving complex problems across web and mobile app experiences.

This engineer will work on customer-facing digital experiences that support acquisition, conversion, and marketing initiatives across web and mobile app surfaces. The role will partner closely with Product, Design, Marketing, Brand, Analytics, and other engineering teams to build scalable, performant, and maintainable frontend applications.

While this role operates in an acquisition and marketing technology domain—CMS, SEO, analytics events, GA/GTM, RudderStack, Mixpanel, React Native surfaces, and deep linking—deep prior experience in every tool is not required. Strong engineering fundamentals are the primary hiring bar; the right engineer can quickly learn domain-specific tools and apply sound technical judgment.

This is a senior individual contributor role for an engineer who can own complex frontend problems end-to-end, contribute to architecture, and raise the engineering bar. Success means building scalable, high-quality web and mobile app experiences in an acquisition-focused environment where performance, experimentation, analytics accuracy, SEO, deep linking, and conversion matter.

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, performant frontend applications across web and mobile app surfaces.

  • Lead technical initiatives that improve stability, performance, maintainability, and developer experience.

  • Own complex frontend features from discovery through delivery, including architecture, testing, launch, and iteration.

  • Partner with Product, Design, Marketing, Brand, Analytics, and Engineering to translate business needs into technical solutions.

  • Build acquisition and conversion experiences, including landing pages, registration flows, promotional surfaces, app entry points, and related growth experiences.

  • Contribute to React Native app experiences where acquisition, onboarding, deep linking, or cross-platform journeys intersect with mobile.

  • Develop reusable components, patterns, and frontend systems that scale across teams and use cases.

  • Ensure applications meet high standards for performance, accessibility, responsiveness, SEO, and cross-platform quality.

  • Partner with marketing and analytics teams on event tracking, attribution, experimentation, and reporting.

  • Implement and maintain analytics instrumentation, including dataLayer events, GA4, GTM, RudderStack, Segment, or similar integrations.

  • Work with CMS-driven content experiences so business teams can manage content efficiently while engineering quality stays strong.

  • Support technical SEO needs such as metadata, structured data, canonical strategy, sitemaps, SSR/SSG, and page performance.

  • Support web-to-app acquisition journeys, including deep links, deferred deep links, app install paths, and attribution-aware flows.

  • Debug complex frontend issues across code, APIs, tracking, rendering, performance, and third-party integrations.

  • Conduct code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and contribute to architectural decisions.

  • Mentor engineers and contribute to a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.

  • Stay current with modern frontend technologies and introduce improvements where they create meaningful value.

What You Will Need

  • 5–6+ years of professional frontend engineering experience building production-grade applications.

  • Advanced proficiency with React.js, TypeScript, modern JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

  • Strong understanding of frontend architecture, component design, state management, performance, accessibility, and maintainability.

  • Experience building reusable frontend systems and writing clean, testable code.

  • Experience with modern frontend tooling, build systems, CI/CD, automated testing, code quality, and release practices.

  • Ability to integrate with APIs and communication patterns such as REST, GraphQL, or WebSockets.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across complex frontend systems.

  • Proven project ownership from technical design through rollout and operational support.

  • Effective communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders across Product, Design, Marketing, Analytics, QA, and Engineering.

  • Interest in cross-platform frontend work, including mobile app experiences such as React Native.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.

Strong Engineering Expectations

  • Strong engineering fundamentals and sound technical judgment.

  • Ability to balance scalability, maintainability, performance, and delivery speed in architectural decisions.

  • Ownership mindset, with the ability to take ambiguous problems to completion.

  • Ability to break complex problems into practical, incremental technical solutions.

  • High standards for code quality, testing, observability, and operational reliability.

  • Comfort across the frontend lifecycle: planning, architecture, implementation, testing, monitoring, and iteration.

  • Ability to mentor others and influence engineering direction without formal authority.

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn new tools, systems, and business domains quickly.

Nice to Have / Domain Experience

The following experience is helpful but not required. We value strong engineering ability over direct prior experience with every tool listed below, though React Native and cross-platform app work may be part of the role.

  • Experience with React Native or mobile-adjacent frontend development.

  • Experience supporting web-to-app acquisition flows, including deep linking, deferred deep linking, universal links, app links, and app install journeys.

title: Säljare Vilt & Fisk - Järfälla
description:

Viltbilen är ett nystartat företag som säljer och levererar viltkött och fisk till privatpersoner.

Viltkött är enligt Världsnaturfonden det enda klimatvänliga köttet. Vårt kött kommer från svenskt frilevande vilt. Köttet är därför fritt från antibiotika och bekämpningsmedel.

Vi vill att fler ska få tillgång till detta fina kött och söker nu hemförsäljare till olika distrikt i Stockholmsområdet.

  • Eget distrikt - Områdeschef
  • Behovsanpassad utbildning
  • Fint kontor med säljaktiviteter och event
  • Flexibla arbetstider - Exempel: Vardagar 16.00-21.00 och/eller Helger 10-17

Vad innebär tjänsten:

Varje säljare får ett distrikt som man bearbetar själv. Man kör en snyggt loggad och eldriven skåpbil, försedd med frys som är fylld med våra fina varor.

Vi har provsmakningar regelbundet så att du kan berätta om varorna med ärlighet och tyngd.

Vårt fina och nyrenoverade kontor ligger 700 meter från Högdalens T-bana.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

title: Graduate Sports Trader
description:
We are looking for a sports enthusiast who is excited to immerse themselves in the world of sports trading. We pride ourselves in empowering each other to do our best work and as a sports trader, you will work in a challenging environment which will sharpen your sports knowledge. The UK based trading function is fully responsible for the expert trading of the core non-US Sports, including Soccer, Tennis, European & International Basketball, Asian Baseball, Cricket, Darts, Table Tennis & eSports, to name a few. As a Graduate Sports Trader, you will report directly into the Team Manager. In the initial phase of your employment, you will be responsible for covering Risk on sports that fall under the UK remit, ensuring we are maximising profit for the team, whilst giving you a solid understanding of the industry and gaining knowledge of all our internal tools and systems. Our shifts are flexible to suit regular sports fixtures and major competitions, so typically we are busiest during evenings and weekends. title: Research Engineer on Digital Monitoring for Mining Assets
description:
ArcelorMittal is the world’s largest steel producer. We use the most innovative technologies to create the steels tomorrow’s world will be made of. Every day over 125,000 of our talented people, located in over 60 countries, push the boundaries of digitalization, and use advanced technologies to create a stronger, faster, and smarter world. To help make this possible, they know they can depend on the support and training that a company of our scope and scale can provide.

Comprising 1,650 researchers spread across 14 Research Centers around the world, our Global R&D team aims to continuously improve the quality of steel and its manufacturing processes. This involves investigating and developing disruptive technologies, reducing the carbon footprint of steel, and optimizing costs while maintaining uncompromising quality. The team's strong multicultural diversity, with over 30 nationalities, offers international experience and makes it possible to meet global needs.

Our team is dedicated to advancing the sustainability and circularity of both mining and steelmaking within ArcelorMittal. We develop knowledge, technologies and innovative solutions to support responsible tailings management, resource efficiency, waste valorization and the transition towards more circular production systems. Based in Asturias and working within a global network, we collaborate with industrial operations, research centers and external partners to create the next generation of sustainable technologies for mining and steel.

Your role

We are looking to strengthen the team with a technically skilled professional who will support ArcelorMittal mining operations in the deployment of tailings monitoring and geotechnical risk management solutions, while contributing to applied R&D projects. You will work within a multidisciplinary team to:

  • Maintain a continuous technology watch on tailings monitoring, characterization and geotechnical assessment technologies, providing critical evaluation of the most suitable technical and economic solutions for different tailings facilities and operating conditions.
  • Support mining operations in the implementation of tailings monitoring and risk management strategies, acting as a reference for best practices related to tailings characterization, dam surveillance, instrumentation and data interpretation.
  • Define, coordinate and evaluate laboratory, field and industrial-scale testing programs required to validate monitoring technologies, characterization methodologies and predictive assessment tools for tailings storage facilities.
  • Establish and maintain effective communication with site teams throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring alignment between operational needs, corporate standards and R&D objectives, while supporting the selection and deployment of the most appropriate solutions.
  • Lead or contribute to applied research and innovation projects focused on tailings characterization, geotechnical monitoring, digitalization, data-driven risk assessment and the long-term safety and sustainability of tailings storage facilities

Your profile

  • You hold a Master's degree or PhD in Mining Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Geology or a related discipline
  • You have knowledge a proven track record in knowledge of tailings storage facilities (TSFs), geotechnical monitoring systems, instrumentation, geophysics and/or risk assessment methodologies.
  • You demonstrate a strong understanding and knowledge of tailings storage facilities (TSFs) and geotechnical risk assessment.
  • Familiarity with geotechnical instrumentation and monitoring systems.
  • Knowledge of geophysical investigation techniques applied to tailings and civil infrastructure.
  • Ability to interpret and analyse monitoring data to support operational decision making.
  • Knowledge of IT/Digital aspects with be valorated.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to interpret technical data and support evidence-based decision making.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder management skills, enabling effective interaction with operational sites, technical experts and external partners.
  • Proactive, innovation-oriented mindset with the ability to challenge existing practices, identify opportunities and drive the implementation of new solutions.
  • Fluent in English is mandatory. Fluency in Spanish would be a plus, and willingness to learn it will be required.
  • You are able to work effectively in an international environment, including occasional travel to mining operations

Join us and you will see that your work will help create renewable energy, impact major industries and boost economies. At ArcelorMittal, we'll help you create your world.

The Emissions Management and Compliance Unit within the Climate Resilience Branch is seeking a Professional Engineer committed to service excellence to join our team as a Senior Emissions Engineer. The unit provides regulatory oversight for Saskatchewan’s Output-Based Performance Standards (OBPS) Program, which is designed to incentivize growth, operational efficiencies and technology innovation to reduce greenhouse gas emission intensities while protecting industrial economic competitiveness. Reporting to the Manager of Approvals and Compliance, the Senior Emissions Engineer provides technical, analytical, regulatory, and policy expertise to support the delivery and continuous improvement of Saskatchewan's OBPS Program.

  • Completing analytical, scientific and technical calculations of greenhouse gas emission intensities.

Technical Knowledge and Skills:

  • Knowledge of measurement, reporting and verification of GHG emissions under ISO 14064-3.
  • Knowledge of operations and processes from emission-intensive trade-exposed (EITE) sectors in Saskatchewan.
  • A strong understanding of GHG and related environmental legislation, guidelines, policies and procedures and their application.

title: 1680 Person In Charge (PIC)
description:
Position: Person In Charge

Position Purpose: Exemplifies and ensures strong customer service in all aspects of the job. Directs and controls the operation of the Front End in the absence of store management to achieve sales and profit objectives.

Job Description: As a primary contact for customers, the Person In Charge (PIC) provides friendly, courteous, and helpful service. During the absence of the Store Manager and the First & Second Assistant Managers, the PIC is in charge of the store, with analogous authority to make necessary decisions to operate the store at maximum profit, efficiency, and superior customer service. When in charge of the store (generally at night) the PIC will supervise the store employees. The PIC also acts as a Cashier-Checker (see job description). May be required to work in many of the departments within the store.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

· Provide customer service as currently defined by the employer within the scope of the position and within company policy.

· Responsible for appropriately handling emergencies, customer complaints, employee or customer accidents and supervising all store personnel.

· Maintains high level of familiarity with company policies and procedures.

· Supervises the sales floor to monitor service and replenishment of products.

· Replaces stock in displays surrounding the checkout area.

· Assists in maintaining a clean and safe work environment within the store.

· Assists other cashiers with computer, register, and scanner problems.

· Responsible for performing basic office functions to assist customers and personnel.

· Operates electronically scanning cash register to total customers’ final bill.

· Receive payment for customer purchase and count back correct change.

· Bag groceries in paper, canvas, or plastic bags. Lift bags into grocery cart. Offer customer assistance with carry out, and perform that task if a Courtesy Clerk is not available.

· Knowledge of all positions within the store.

· Ability to work independently.

· Desired: Prior experience as a clerk or manager.

All store employees during the absence of the Store Director or Assistant Store Director.

Varies depending on store location and state/county requirements.

%Inside: 100%%Outside: Rare

Temperature Extremes: N/A

Chemicals: Seldom (mild detergents or glass cleaner)

six-wheeled cart, grocery cart, box cutter, pens and pencils, spray bottle, rags, mops, broom, telephone/intercom, cash register, credit card scanner, computer, pallet jack, bailer

Constant (over 70% of the time)

Frequent (30-70%)

Occasional (10-30%)

Seldom (1-10%)

Lifting:

Constantly lifts 1-10 lbs. Frequently lifts 11-20 lbs. Seldom lifts 21-35 lbs.

Carrying:

Occasionally carries 1-10 lbs. Seldom carries 11-50 lbs.

Pushing/Pulling:

Constantly pushes/pulls 1-10 lbs. Occasionally pushes/pulls 11-20 lbs.

Reaching:

Constant knee to shoulder reaching. Seldom overhead and at or above shoulder level reaching.

Standing:

Constant standing while on job. Sitting allowed on breaks.

Walking:

Frequent walking while on job.

Climb/Balance:

Seldom. May use step stool while stocking/facing product on high shelves.

Trunk Functions:

Frequent neck rotation and bending of head. Occasional bending/stooping, twisting, crouching, and squatting. Seldom kneeling.

Constant handling/grasping and repetitive motion while checking, facing, and replacing stock. Frequent fine finger manipulation.

Vision:

Use of peripheral vision and depth perception to move around store and push carts in aisles. Near vision used to operate scanner, make change, and troubleshoot equipment.

Hearing:

To converse with customers, provide service, and receive questions from employees and customers. Answer pages and telephone.

Speech:

To respond to customers and employees and use intercom/telephone.

Job responsibilities include tasks or duties that could affect the safety or health of the employee performing the task or others.

title: Software Portfolio Strategist
description:
Business Operations, Employee Engagement, and Strategy is part of IS&T and shapes the strategy, operations, and culture of IS&T. The team oversees business planning, IS&T's partnership strategy across Apple, and the technology tools that support the organization's day-to-day operations. This team also leads IS&T's enterprise generative AI strategy and manages compliance across systems. Through its communications and employee programs, it champions the growth, inclusion, and development of everyone in IS&T and drives the standard for IS&T brand and product communications across Apple.

Apple's IS&T Software Asset Management team, within the Office of the CIO, governs a $450M+ software portfolio spanning 1300+ products and 250+ vendors. Our mandate is to enable and create value for Apple's business — ensuring every software investment delivers measurable impact through total cost of ownership (TCO) optimization, strategic lifecycle management, and cross-functional partnership.

We are hiring a Software Portfolio Strategist who thinks like a strategist, moves like an operator, and influences like a consultant — someone who sees a renewal as an inflection point, not a transaction, and who treats data as a language for driving enterprise decisions. This role is for someone who is restlessly curious about where software spend is headed, why it is growing, and what levers actually exist to shape it.

You will not inherit a playbook — you will write one. This role sits at the intersection of technology strategy, financial planning, and cross-functional influence within the Office of the CIO. You will own a portfolio of enterprise software investments end-to-end: setting lifecycle direction, building the analytical case for action, and driving decisions through rooms where you do not have positional authority but earn credibility through rigor and clarity.

The OCIO exists to enable Apple's business and create value — and this role is a direct expression of that mission. You will quantify and optimize total cost of ownership across your portfolio, ensuring Apple gets maximum strategic and operational value from every software dollar spent. That means going beyond sticker price to evaluate implementation costs, operational overhead, integration complexity, and long-term vendor trajectory. Our operating model is shifting from manual processing to automation-enabled strategic work. That means less time chasing renewals and more time answering harder questions: Should we build or buy? Where is AI-driven cost growth outpacing value? Which vendors are strategic partners vs. commodity suppliers? What does a 5-year TCO view of this portfolio actually look like?

You will work directly with IS&T leadership, product teams, Finance, and Procurement — not as a support function, but as a decision-shaping partner who connects software investment strategy to business value.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and 7+ years in software asset management, IT vendor management, technology finance, or strategic portfolio roles
  • 5+ years leading complex cross-functional programs or investment portfolios
  • Strong command of enterprise licensing models (ELAs, subscriptions, perpetual, consumption/token-based, hybrid)
  • Demonstrated ownership of multi-million-dollar software budgets and forecasts
  • Track record of presenting strategic recommendations to senior leadership and influencing outcomes
  • Hands-on analytical capability — you build the analysis, not just review it

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with software rationalization, optimization, or portfolio governance at enterprise scale
  • Familiarity with complex license metrics (Oracle Processors, IBM PVUs, vCPUs, points/credits)
  • Ability to read and interpret enterprise software contracts, audit clauses, and compliance frameworks
  • Background in IT finance (capex vs. opex, prepaid structures, contractual uplifts, NTE pricing)
  • Experience creating or re-engineering processes and tools that improve operational efficiency
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and making independent judgment calls with enterprise-level impact
  • Consulting, strategy, or finance background (in addition to or in lieu of traditional SAM experience) is a plus

title: IR Rad Tech
description:
Job Summary

The Cardiovascular Invasive Technician - Certified provides specialized support during diagnostic and therapeutic/interventional cardiovascular procedures. This role involves assisting physicians, operating specialized equipment, and maintaining sterile techniques to ensure patient safety and quality care. The Technician ensures accurate data recording, documentation, and effective communication with the healthcare team to support optimal patient outcomes.

Essential Functions
  • Assists physicians during cardiovascular diagnostic and interventional procedures, maintaining sterile techniques and adhering to clinical protocols.
  • Operates advanced cardiovascular equipment safely and efficiently, monitoring patient status and adapting to changing conditions as necessary.
  • Records, calculates, and verifies data during procedures for physician review, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
  • Prepares and maintains detailed procedural documentation, including treatment plans, evaluation results, and progress reports, in line with department standards.
  • Ensures a safe and efficient environment in the acute care area, responding promptly to patient needs and changes in condition.
  • Supports patient preparation, positioning, and monitoring, providing reassurance and ensuring patient comfort throughout procedures.
  • Collaborates with healthcare team members to ensure seamless workflow, equipment readiness, and effective communication during procedures.
  • Participates in quality improvement initiatives and maintains compliance with best practices, policies, and regulatory standards for cardiovascular care.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.
Qualifications
  • 0-1 years of experience in cardiovascular or invasive procedures required
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • Comprehensive understanding of cardiovascular anatomy, physiology, and procedural protocols.
  • Proficiency in operating advanced cardiovascular equipment and adhering to sterile techniques.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced, acute care setting.
  • Detail-oriented, with a high level of accuracy in data recording and patient documentation.
Licenses and Certifications
  • RCIS - Registered Cardiovascular Invasive Specialist from the National Board of Cardiovascular Technology required
  • BCLS - Basic Life Support obtained within 90 days of hire required and
  • ACLS - Advanced Cardiac Life Support required

title: Power Engineering Technologist I
description:
Position Overview:

This is an entry-level position that supports our Engineering team and reports directly to regional operational leadership. The role includes a combination of office and field work, providing hands-on experience applying technical skills to help design safe, reliable, and cost-effective solutions for power distribution projects. You should be comfortable learning design tools, following company and client workflows and procedures, accurately entering data, and developing a foundational understanding of each project's technical requirements.

Essential Functions:

  • This role requires regular on-site attendance and is not eligible for remote or hybrid work.

  • Interpret and comply with all applicable codes, regulations, policies, and procedures while maintaining accurate, well-organized project documentation.

  • Support Project Design & Preparation: Assist with the development of complete project and job packages, including drawings, material lists, estimates, and requisitions, using company and client design software and work management tools.

  • Develop Technical Field & Construction Knowledge: Prepare comprehensive project and job packages—such as drawings, material lists, estimates, and requisitions—while utilizing company and client design software and work management tools.

  • Provide regular project status updates and build strong working relationships with internal and external partners to ensure expectations, timelines, and business objectives are met.

  • Engage in Continuous Learning & Mentorship: Actively build technical, design, and field knowledge through ongoing training and mentorship from experienced team members, supervisors, and Professional Engineers.

  • Participate in storm restoration activities as needed.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Regular attendance is required.

  • High school diploma or GED (Certain client projects or contractual requirements may require an Associate degree from a two - year college or technical school).

  • 0-2 years of experience in power distribution engineering, electrical craft work, or GIS/CAD-related work.

Other Abilities:

  • Valid driver's license and vehicle suitable for business use (mileage reimbursement may apply).

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

This role involves primarily office-based work with regular sitting and frequent use of hands for computer and tool handling, and talking and hearing throughout the day. The position also includes occasional standing, walking, reaching, climbing or balancing, and stooping or kneeling during field activities. We may require employees to lift up to 10 pounds regularly. The job also requires visual abilities, including close and distance vision, color distinction, peripheral vision, and depth perception. Reasonable accommodations can be made for individuals with disabilities.

Work Environment:

Your work will involve a mix of office and field work. While most duties are performed in a typical office setting, you may occasionally perform work outdoors in various weather conditions and in areas that you or others elevate or deem hazardous. Some tasks may also involve exposure to a risk of electrical shock during field visits. We make reasonable accommodations to support individuals with disabilities.

Our Benefits:

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

  • HSA, dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability

  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and family and medical leave

If this sounds like you, come join the PIKE family.

Pike Engineering is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin and/or status as a protected veteran or individual with a disability.

title: General Foreman-GF - Transmission (Oncor)
description:
Position Summary:

General Foreman is a skilled position in the construction, maintenance and repair of electrical overhead distribution systems. The General Foreman ensures projects are completed in a safe and timely manner. The General Foreman effectively plans ahead anticipating issues and project needs in order to accomplish Company and crew goals. Provides optimum customer service to his employees and customers.

Essential Functions:

  • Work safely while performing new construction, maintenance or repair work of energized and de-energized overhead work.
  • Supervises crew members.
  • Must possess working knowledge of leadership and management skills.
  • Must possess the capability of leading and training lower skilled employees in safe and productive work procedures.
  • Capable of leading and teaching hot stick work on energized lines.
  • Conducts pre-job or tailgate briefings.
  • Must possess a working knowledge of all aspects of line work.
  • Stringing overhead wire.
  • Setting poles and anchors.
  • Installing transformers, lightening arrestors, cutouts, crossarms, insulators, switches and switchgear.
  • Troubleshoots problems and supervises troubleshooting in primary and secondary systems.
  • Replaces cutout fuses and clears faulted circuits and systems.
  • Frequently works with energized high voltage systems requiring skill and care to protect the lives of themselves and others.
  • Responsible for ensuring Company vehicles, equipment and tools are maintained in good working conditions.
  • Responsible for complying with Company reporting procedures and completing required Company paperwork.
  • Responsible for coordinating and inspecting the work of crew members.
  • Does all other related work as required to complete the job.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Able to perform rigorous physical labor.
  • Able to identify primary and secondary voltage on a circuit.
  • Must be familiar with induced voltage.
  • Able to properly sag wire.
  • Capable of properly phasing a circuit through a substation.
  • Able to identify and locate puller and tensioner setups.
  • Understands grounding procedures.
  • Capable of working at heights and/or confined spaces.
  • Capable of properly installing and removing PPE and cover up.
  • Must be able to climb different types of structures (wood, steel, etc.) and possess the necessary tools to do so.
  • Understands grounding procedures.
  • Understands how to safely operate equipment.
  • Understands how to phase out a line using phasing sticks.
  • Capable of planning safe work based on a job print or work order.
  • Understands how to obtain a one shot on a recloser.
  • Must be able to safely perform a reconductoring job.
  • 10 year minimum of recent field experience.
  • Capable of safely installing and removing mechanical jumpers.
  • Understands how to use a load bust tool.
  • Able to properly ask for and take line clearances.
  • Able to identify and locate puller and tensioner setups.
  • Possesses a working knowledge of line protection devices.
  • Able to properly inspect rubber goods and PPE.
  • Able to travel long distances on short notice, when required.
  • Understands flag and tag procedures.
  • Possesses a CDL and demonstrates safe driving.
  • Able to work for extended periods in various locations, when required.
  • Able to lift in excess of 50 lbs.
  • Must be able to work outside, frequently in inclement weather.
  • Willing to work over-time when requested.
  • Willing to work outside of the normal work schedule including weekends, holidays, and overtime as required for the position.

Competencies:

  • Self-Motivated
  • Team-Oriented
  • Customer Oriented
  • Must be able to follow Company safety rules and all other Company policies.

Physical Demands:
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, use hands/fingers to handle or feel, reach with hands and arms.


Work Environment:
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to dirt, fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical equipment and vibration. The employee is occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at construction job sites. The employee may be subject to one or more of the following atmospheric conditions that may affect the respiratory system from fumes, odors, dust, mists, or gases. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. This position is performed in outside weather conditions.

title: Courtesy Clerk
description:
A Day in the Life:

As a Front-End Team Member, your day is centered around creating a smooth and positive checkout experience for customers. You’re often the final stop before customers head home, helping complete their purchase accurately while keeping interactions friendly and efficient. Whether scanning items, bagging groceries, or answering questions, your role helps ensure each visit ends on a strong note.

Another part of the role is keeping the front end organized, clean, and running consistently throughout the day. You’ll rotate between tasks like handling transactions, collecting carts, restocking supplies, and maintaining the checkout area. With a steady flow of customers and changing priorities, the work stays active, making it a good fit for someone who enjoys variety and staying engaged in a fast‑paced environment.

What you bring to the table:

  • Customer Interaction Skills: Friendly, clear communication during checkout and customer assistance
  • Transaction Handling: Processing purchases accurately, including cash, card, and digital payments
  • Attention to Detail: Accuracy in scanning, pricing, produce codes, and order completion
  • Basic Math Skills: Handling cash transactions, counting change, and balancing registers
  • Organization & Time Management: Managing multiple tasks while maintaining steady workflow
  • Store Support Awareness: Assisting with bagging, cart retrieval, stocking, and general front‑end upkeep
  • Problem Awareness: Recognizing and addressing pricing, transaction, or customer service questions
  • Operational Awareness: Following company policies, register procedures, and checkout processes
  • Adaptability: Comfort managing changing tasks and customer flow throughout the shift
  • Physical Capability: Comfort with standing for extended periods, lifting up to 50 lbs., and working indoors and outdoors as needed

Requirements:

  • Must be 16 years of age or older (or 18 years of age or older, depending on local/state requirements)
  • Completion of company cashier or front-end training upon hire
  • Basic math and communication skills required
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays
  • Prior customer service experience preferred but not required

Why you will choose us:

Albertsons Companies Inc. has always been a people-oriented business, and thoughtful people practices remain a core element of our company’s philosophy. Our goal is to continue to bring people together around the joys of food and to inspire well-being and that starts with people like you bringing your unique self to our company and making it one person stronger and better!

We also provide a variety of benefits including:

  • Inclusive work culture built on belonging

  • Leaders invested in your training, career growth & development.

  • Vacation / Paid Time Off

Our Values

  • We put people first.
  • We are customer driven.
  • We value different perspectives.
  • We raise the bar.
  • We act as owners.
  • We are one team.
  • We build belonging.

title: EEG Technician
description:
EEG Technician

Schedule: Full time (days)

Your experience matters

Highpoint Health – Sumner with Ascension Saint Thomas, formerly Sumner Regional Medical Center, is part of Lifepoint Health, a diversified healthcare delivery network with facilities coast to coast. We are driven by a profound commitment to prioritize your well-being so you can provide exceptional care to others. As an EEG Technician joining our team, you’re embracing a vital mission dedicated to making communities healthier ®. Join us on this meaningful journey where your skills, compassion and dedication will make a remarkable difference in the lives of those we serve.

More about our team

People are our passion and purpose. Come to work where you are appreciated for who you are, not just what you can do.

How you’ll contribute

  • Reviews existing clinical data, collects additional data and recommends obtaining additional pertinent data. Evaluates all data to determine appropriateness and medical necessity of the test ordered.
  • Selects, assembles and checks the equipment necessary to perform the diagnostic test.
  • Initiates, conducts and modifies the prescribed diagnostic procedure.
  • Maintains patient records and communicates relevant information to members of the health care team.
  • Continue with self-development and assists Director with orientation and continuing education of trainees, medical staff, and other hospital employees.
  • Promotes age appropriate care to all patients, provides age appropriate care to all patients.

Why join us

We believe that investing in our employees is the first step to providing excellent patient care. In addition to your base compensation, this position also offers:

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Multiple levels of medical, dental and vision coverage for full-time and part-time employees.
  • Financial Protection & PTO: Life, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity insurance, short- and long-term disability, paid family leave and paid time off.
  • Financial & Career Growth: Higher education and certification tuition assistance, loan assistance and 401(k) retirement package and company match.

  • Licenses: Registered Diagnostic Cardiac Sonographer (RDCS) by the American Registry of Diagnostic Sonographers (ARDMS) or Registered Cardiovascular Technologist by the National Board of Cardiovascular Technology preferred or one year experience.
  • Certifications: Basic Life Support (BLS)

title: Foreman - Underground (FPU)
description:
Position Summary

The Foreman is a safety focused professional with the ability to lead a crew to construct and repair electrical underground distribution systems. You will work on energized and de‑energized powerlines and may be required to travel to different job sites, including out‑of‑state locations, as operational and customer needs dictate. You will report to the General Foreman.

Essential Functions

  • Perform new construction, maintain and repair energized and de‑energized underground distribution systems while putting safety first.

  • Lead crew members and conduct pre-job and tailgate safety briefings.

  • Must be experienced with coaching and training lower classification employees in safe and productive work procedures.

  • Oversee work related to each project and assume full responsibility for its quality and completion deadline.

  • Install and repair underground facilities, underground conductors, including trouble shooting and fault locating on primary and secondary systems.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of switching and tagging procedures, grounding and induced voltage on energized and de-energized lines while using the proper tools and test equipment.

  • Understand how and when to obtain a one shot on a reclosing device.

  • Work in confined spaces, and in proximity to energized equipment.

  • Operate and maintain excavation equipment to include backhoes, trenchers, excavators, and pulling equipment.

  • Work outdoors in varying environmental conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, wind, and inclement weather.

  • Available to work outages, storms, emergencies including on call rotation.

  • Perform live‑line work using approved PPE and insulated sticks required for testing voltage and switching of energized lines.

  • Follow all safety protocols including PPE use and possess a comprehensive understanding of insulated protective cover to isolate differences of potential.

Minimum Requirements

  • Five (5) years of recent underground line experience.

  • Valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL).

  • Willing to travel long distances on short notice.

  • Lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

  • Work for extended periods at job locations, including out‑of‑state assignments.

  • Willing to work outside of normal business hours, including weekends, holidays, emergency callouts, and overtime.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you will be required to talk, listen and use hand signals to communicate. The job frequently requires you to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle objects, operate tools or controls; reach with hands and arms.

Work Environment

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you are frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. You are occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at constructions job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. You will perform job responsibilities in extreme heat, cold, wet, windy, and storm conditions.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

  • HSA, dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability

  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and family and medical leave

If this sounds like you, come join the PIKE family.

About Us

Founded in 1945, Pike is a leading provider of construction, repair and engineering services for electric and gas utilities, as well as telecommunications companies with a growing portfolio of turnkey renewable projects. We work with hundreds of utility clients across the country, and we continuously expand our offerings to supply our customers with the ideas, technology, experience, workforce and equipment to perform any job.

"Essential" is the one word that sums up who we are, the work we do and what our people mean to us. Each of our employees plays a critical role in ensuring that infrastructure systems are up and running when people and businesses need them.

Pike is a family-oriented workplace with a strong culture of safety, collaboration, innovation and exceptional customer service.

title: Corporate Sustainability Analyst
description:
At Sensient Technologies, we are experts in the science, art and innovation of color and flavor. We are market savvy and visionary. We are problem solvers. And we will be better with you.


The Supply Chain Sustainability and Compliance Analyst is responsible for developing supply chain sustainability initiatives, coordinating the Company’s efforts to track and manage supply chain emissions, assessing sustainability and compliance risks within the supply chain, and overseeing supply chain sustainability management systems. This position works closely with both our sustainability and procurement teams and interacts with all departments in the organization to develop and advance Sensient’s sustainability strategy and supply chain legal compliance.


This position is office-based in Milwaukee, WI with travel to Sensient operations and supplier sites worldwide as need requires. 20% travel.

What you will do:

  • Lead Scope 3 emissions management, focusing on purchased goods and services and transportation, and collaborate with R&D, Procurement, and other stakeholders to develop and implement emissions reduction plans.
  • Manage supplier sustainability, risk, and trade compliance, including supplier and raw material assessments, onboarding requirements, sanctions screening, supply tracing, tariff matters, related systems, and compliance testing.
  • Lead sustainability and procurement regulatory compliance, including CSRD, CSDDD, EUDR, state-level EPR requirements, and other applicable regulations; partner with local business units to support sustainability audits.
  • Engage with suppliers and customers to assess performance and legal compliance, communicate expectations, and drive improvements across raw materials, emissions, water, waste, social impact, and other supply chain sustainability priorities.
  • Embed sustainability into procurement and sourcing, serving as the supply chain sustainability subject matter expert, incorporating sustainability into RFPs and sourcing decisions, partnering with R&D and Sourcing on sustainable raw material selection, and developing training and educational materials for Procurement.
  • Strengthen procurement governance and processes, including supplier standards, contracts, documentation, risk management, legal requirements, and policies that support compliance and mitigate risk; manage RFPs for Legal, Global Security, and sustainability initiatives.

What you will bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferably in Supply Chain, Sustainability, Environmental Science, or a related field
  • Familiarity with sustainability reporting frameworks, including SASB, TCFD, the EU’s ESRS, and CDP, is preferred but not required.
  • Experience in supply chain, sourcing, corporate sustainability, or a related field is preferred but not required.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with excellent time management and the ability to effectively prioritize competing demands.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail and a strong commitment to compliance.

What you will get:

  • Play a key role in advancing Sensient’s global sustainability and supply chain strategy and shaping how sustainability and compliance are integrated across our supply chain.
  • Build expertise across sustainability, supply chain, procurement, compliance, and emerging global regulations while gaining exposure to a broad range of business functions.
  • Receive comprehensive onboarding, ongoing training, and opportunities to develop your skills and advance your career.
  • An excellent salary, benefit offering, and development opportunities
  • Global exposure through collaboration with colleagues, suppliers, customers, and cross-functional teams across Sensient’s worldwide operations.

ABOUT SENSIENT TECHNOLOGIES CORPORATION:
Sensient Technologies Corporation is a leading global manufacturer and marketer of colors, flavors, and other specialty ingredients. Sensient uses advanced technologies and robust global supply chain capabilities to develop specialized solutions for food and beverages, as well as products that serve the pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and personal care industries. The Company’s customers include major international manufacturers representing most of the world’s best-known brands. Sensient is headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.

Hilton, lüks tam hizmet otel ve tatil köylerinden uzun süreli konaklama süitlerine ve orta fiyatlı otellere kadar konaklama sektörünü kapsayan lider küresel konaklama şirketidir. Yaklaşık bir asırdır Hilton, iş ve tatil amaçlı seyahat edenlere konaklama, hizmet, olanaklar ve değerler açısından en iyiyi sunmaktadır. Hilton, küresel markalarıyla olağanüstü konuk deneyimleri sunma geleneğini sürdürmeye kendini adamıştır. "Dünyayı misafirperverliğin ışığı ve sıcaklığıyla doldurma" vizyonumuz, bizi her gün dünya çapında olağanüstü misafirperverlik deneyimleri yaratmak için bir ekip olarak bir araya getiriyor. Ve muhteşem Ekip Üyelerimiz tüm bunların merkezinde!

Neler yapacağım?

Makineleri test etmek ve denetimlerin şirket standartlarına uygun olmasını sağlamak da görevleriniz arasında yer alacaktır. Spesifik olarak, aşağıdaki görevleri en yüksek standartlarda yerine getirmekten sorumlu olacaksınız:

  • Misafir odalarındaki ve genel alanlardaki teknik sorunların giderilmesini sağlamak ve gerekli yönlendirmeleri yapmak,
  • İşletmenin çalışmasına etki edebilecek tüm unsurları kontrol altında tutmak ve kontrollerinin yapılmasını sağlamak, (jeneratör, kazan dairesi, klimalar v.b.) oluşabilecek sorunları gidermek,
  • Bina içerisindeki ve dışındaki tüm klima, sıhhi tesisat, yangın tesisatı müşteri odaları ile ilgili bütün mekanik aksam ile, mutfak ekipmanları, çamaşırhane, kuru temizleme ekipmanları,sağlık kulübü, ofisler, pis su gider ve rogarların, salonlar ekipmanları gibi tüm mekanik işlerin bakım ve onarımdan sorumludur.
  • Planlanmış olan işlerin takibini yapmak,
  • İşletme içerisindeki tüm cihazların periyodik kontrol ve bakımını takip etmek
  • Teknik müdürden gelen işleri yapar,
  • Yedek parça ihtiyaçlarını belirler ve amirine bildirir.
  • Mekanik atelyelerde takım ve techizatın bakımı ve onarımından sorumludur.

İstenen Yetenek ve Uzmanlıklar

  • Meslek Liselerinin veya Meslek Yüksek Okullarının ilgili bölümlerinden mezun,
  • Minimum 2 yıl bina işletmelerinde (otel, hastane, avm, rezidans vb. yerlerde) benzer pozisyonlarda görev almış,
  • Mekanik bakım ve onarım alanında tecrübeli,
  • Tesisat, kaynak ve mekanik aksamların onarımlarında görev alabilecek,
  • Ekip çalışmasına yatkın, çözüm odaklı çalışan,
  • Vardiyalı çalışabilecek, esnek çalışma saatlerine uyum sağlayabilen,

title: Flexible Side Work for Drivers- One Store Visit Weekly
description:
Get Paid to Drive Your Route. Work When It Works for You.

Field Technician — FreshPure Water Machines

1099 Independent Contractor | $29/hr | WEST DEPTFORD & SEWELL, NJ

If you like working independently, hate being stuck at a desk, and want a consistent route you can count on — this might be exactly what you’re looking for.

NWS operates water vending machines in retail stores across the country. We’re building a team of Field Technicians in WEST DEPTFORD & SEWELL, NJ to keep those machines clean, stocked, and running right. It’s straightforward work, it pays well, and you’re in charge of your own time.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

Each week (or every two weeks, depending on the location), you’ll visit your assigned stores and:

  • Clean and disinfect the FreshPure machine inside and out
  • Take meter readings and log the data on your service report
  • Snap photos of the machine condition at every visit
  • Submit your completed report to the home office when you’re done
  • Call in anything that looks off — damage, mechanical issues, anything unusual

That’s it. Each stop takes about an hour. Your total hours per week depend on how many stores are on your route.

What Makes This Different from Other Gig Work

  • Consistent, scheduled route — not random job pickups
  • Same stores every week, so you know exactly where you’re going
  • $29/hr all-in — your mileage and travel are already baked into the rate
  • Supplies provided — we give you everything you need to do the job
  • Real support — a home office contact you can actually reach

This Is NOT a Repair Job

You’re not expected to fix anything. If a machine has a mechanical or technical issue, you flag it and we send a Service Technician. Your job is to keep things clean, documented, and reported — that’s where your value is.

What You Need to Get Started

  • A reliable vehicle and a valid driver’s license
  • A smartphone with a camera for photo submissions
  • Attention to detail — you follow the checklist, every time
  • You show up when you’re scheduled. That’s the most important thing.

No experience in water systems required. If you’ve done field services, retail merchandising, delivery routes, janitorial work, or anything similar — you’ll hit the ground running.

Who Thrives in This Role

This is a great fit if you’re already doing gig work and want something more predictable layered in, or if you’re looking for flexible part-time income that fits around your schedule. People who do well here tend to be:

  • Self-starters who don’t need someone looking over their shoulder
  • Detail-oriented — you notice things other people miss
  • Reliable — your stores count on you showing up
  • Good communicators — you keep the home office in the loop

How to Apply

Click “Apply Now” to be directed to our application. It only takes a few minutes to complete.

If we’re moving forward, you’ll hear from us by email. Interviews are conducted virtually via Microsoft Teams — we’ll send you a calendar invite with everything you need.

You can also view all open positions across our locations at:

freshpure.com/careers

National Water Services, LLC. | freshpure.com/careers

We are looking for people who are friendly, welcoming, and full of life to join over 1,200 colleagues who are always finding ways to make every guest's experience an enjoyable one. We value the passion and enthusiasm of our colleagues and encourage you to share your passion when you work with us.

A little taste of your day-to-day:
