title: Sr. Staff Scientist (TERM) - Castiglione Lab
description:
Position Summary:

The Sr. Staff Scientist (TERM) will be part of Professor Gianni Castiglione’s Laboratory in the Department of Biological Sciences, with a focus on Ophthalmology. This position will aid the Castiglione lab’s investigations into preclinical ophthalmic research and animal models. The Sr. Staff Scientist (TERM) is an essential position, responsible for conducting independent research and training new students. The duties will include specialized ocular microsurgery, primary retinal cell isolation and culture, and molecular biology techniques. Substantial experience with specialized procedures, including subretinal injection, intravitreal injection, and retinal dissections. The position is full-time, with renewal contingent on funding and performance.

About the Work Unit:

The Department of Biological Sciences has an excellent staff to facilitate issue resolution involving personnel, financial management, supply and equipment orders proposal submission, and infrastructure. The faculty in the department carry out diverse research projects and often collaborate with other members within the department and in nearby departments. This department covers a broad spectrum of biology, from molecules and cells to tissues and organisms to populations and ecosystems. Award-winning faculty and graduate students teach and carry out research in Biochemistry, Structural Biology and Biophysics, Cell Biology, Genetics, Molecular Biology, Computational Biology, Evolutionary Biology, Ecology, Developmental Biology, and Neurobiology.

Key Functions and Expected Performance:

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Animal Models & Ocular Microsurgical Techniques:
    • Perform subretinal and intravitreal injections in mice
    • Conduct retinal and choroidal dissections on human donor eyes, non-human primates, mice, and rats.
    • Perform fresh ocular tissue collection, biopsies, and retinal sectioning
  • Tissue, Cell Culture & Primary Cell Isolation:
    • Establish, maintain, and distribute primary isolation and culture of photoreceptors, and retinal pigment epithelial cells from human donor eyes.
  • Molecular Biology:
    • Perform RNA extraction from retina, choroid, and cells.
    • Execute cDNA synthesis, quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR), and DNA sequencing.
    • Conduct protein extraction, BCA protein assays, Western blotting, and ELISA.
  • Daily Lab Operations & Training:
    • Train and mentor grad students, postdocs, and new laboratory personnel in ocular microsurgical techniques, dissections, cell culture, and qRT-PCR.
    • Design and perform experiments independently.
    • Develop expertise with research literature in our field.
    • Maintain a high level of intellectual engagement in the research project.
    • Maintain detailed notebooks and well-organized data.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Relationships:

The Sr. Staff Scientist trains and mentors grad students, postdocs, and new laboratory personnel in lab protocols and procedures. This position reports administratively to the department Administrative Manager and functionally to the Principal Investigator.

Education and Certifications:

  • A Doctor of Medicine (M.D.) degree from an accredited institution or a PhD in Biology, Cell Biology, Molecular Genetics, Biochemistry or related field or an equivalent combination of education and relevant research experience (e.g., five years of research experience in lieu of a degree) is required.

  • Certification as a Certified Ophthalmic Assistant (COA) by the Joint Commission on Allied Health Personnel in Ophthalmology (JCAHPO) is highly preferred.

Experience and Skills:

  • Extensive experience with ocular microsurgery, including subretinal and intravitreal injections is required.
  • Experience establishing primary human retinal pigment epithelium cell cultures from human donor eyes is required.
  • Experience with molecular biology techniques including RNA extraction, qRT-PCR, and Western blotting is required.
  • Extreme attention to detail and organizational abilities is required.
  • Ability to function independently as well as part of a team is required.
  • Ability to maintain a detailed lab notebook and experimental documentation is required.

title: Buyer
description:
Janos Technology (Fluke) is a world class manufacturing company and is seeking a multifaceted individual with strong skills, proven track record, and willingness to grow and advance within a top-notch organization. We offer excellent compensation, benefits, and a bright future. We have a superb reputation and potential for rapid growth.

The Buyer is responsible for procuring materials to meet customer demand and manufacturing schedules. Coordinates products through the complete production cycle including outside services. Develops supply plans for raw material and assembly components to optimize manufacturing and assembly processes based on demand forecasts, manufacturing capacity and availability of materials. Evaluates and analyzes data regarding processes and systems. Maintains planning parameters in the ERP system. Resolves problems with inventory, production schedules, or materials shortages and recommends countermeasures to avoid future problems. Establishes a balance between vendors and internal and external customers based on supply and demand for materials and finished goods. Onboards new vendors and supports supplier development with feedback on performance and supplier self-assessments.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Procure materials for custom sales orders and forecast orders
  • Request quotations on materials and coordinate with Sales, Engineering & Materials Team to provide lead times for customer quotes.
  • Review incoming materials against the manufacturing schedules to ensure the demand plan is met. Coordinate with Planning and Sales on updates to vendor commitments and impact to schedule. Develop action plans and counter measures.
  • Resolve vendor line stopping issues. Ensure the supply of products meets quality and delivery standards
  • Analyze Supply and Demand at the Item, Customer Order and Master Schedule levels. Determines out of balance conditions, identifies alternatives, and recommends actions.
  • Collaborate with the Sales, Inventory, Operations and Planning team to ensure that vendors are aligned with SIOP commitments.
  • Liaison with Quality and Engineering to hold vendors accountable to standards using Supplier Correction Action Requests (SCARS) and generate Vendor Scorecards.
  • Drive lean culture by implementing inventory strategies to reduce inventory and meet our customer commitments.
  • Create paperwork for USMCA, COO, Reach, RoHs & Prop65
  • Collaborate with New Product Introduction team (NPI) to ensure the successful launch of new products from engineering design to production in the factory.
  • Back-up for other Buyer and Planner as required
  • Establish and maintain standard work including training materials for area of responsibility

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in manufacturing supply chain or equivalent/related fields
  • 3- 5 years of experience in role progressively increasing responsibilities in purchasing, planning, and inventory control within a lean Manufacturing environment
  • Self-starter who seeks out ways to improve processes and seeks out solutions before being asked.
  • The ability to manage time and balance multiple projects at once in an organized way.
  • Must be proficient in Excel and data analysis software tools, specifically advanced formulas and logic.
  • Strong collaboration abilities with Operations, Engineering, Sales, Customer Service and Management
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent Verbal and Written Communication

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Supply chain certifications - APICS & ASCM
  • Optics Experience

title: Ultrasound Technologist - PRN
description:
Ultrasound Technologist, PRN

Benefits: 401(k) with matching

Job Summary

The Ultrasound Technologist performs high-quality diagnostic ultrasound examinations to assist physicians in the evaluation and treatment of patients. This role requires independent judgment, technical expertise, and a commitment to patient safety and comfort. The Ultrasound Technologist ensures all procedures are appropriately ordered, patient identification is verified, and imaging protocols are followed to produce accurate and reproducible results.

Essential Functions

  • Performs all ultrasound procedures independently, adhering to department protocols and ensuring high-quality, diagnostic imaging results.
  • Verifies patient identification and ensures the appropriate procedures are ordered and acknowledged prior to conducting imaging.
  • Recognizes and documents pathologies during scanning for interpretation by the radiologist, following established protocols.
  • Assumes responsibility for patient care, safety, and comfort during all imaging procedures.
  • Maintains a clean, safe, and organized work environment, ensuring compliance with safety and infection control guidelines.
  • Operates ultrasound equipment safely and effectively, following departmental policies and manufacturer guidelines.
  • Accurately documents imaging procedures and patient information in the electronic health record system, ensuring all associated documents are scanned into PACS for radiologist interpretation.
  • Monitors and maintains an adequate supply of imaging materials and coordinates inventory replenishment as needed.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • 1-3 years of clinical experience as an Ultrasound Technologist required
  • 2-4 years of clinical experience as an Ultrasound Technologist preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Proficiency in ultrasound imaging techniques and equipment operation.
  • Knowledge of anatomy, physiology, and pathology relevant to diagnostic sonography.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively with patients and healthcare teams.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills to ensure accurate imaging and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently and make informed decisions within the scope of practice.
  • Commitment to maintaining patient confidentiality and adhering to ethical standards.

Licenses and Certifications

  • (S) - ARDMS or ARRT - Sonography certification or registry eligible required
  • BCLS - Basic Life Support obtained within the 7 days of employment required

title: MAX Västervik söker restaurangbiträde
description:
Vi vill bli världens bästa burgarkedja och vi vet att vägen dit går genom engagerade medarbetare, starka team, grym service och riktigt goda burgare. Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med och skapa serviceupplevelser i världsklass vid varje besök.

Som restaurangbiträde på MAX är du en nyckelperson i vårt dagliga arbete. Tillsammans med dina kollegor ser du till att våra gäster får bästa möjliga bemötande och att restaurangen alltid levererar på högsta nivå. Både när det gäller kvalitet, tempo och service. Du arbetar i team och har varierande arbetsuppgifter: du serverar gäster, håller rent och snyggt i restaurangen, jobbar i köket med att laga burgare och pommes, och ansvarar för kassan där du ser till att gästerna får det som beställts varor. Hos oss är arbetsglädje, gemenskap och utveckling alltid i centrum. Så under dina första dagar lär du dig jobbet steg för steg av din restaurangchef eller en erfaren kollega och på vår lärplattform MAX Academy via digitala utbildningar.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

  • Servera gäster, ge ett schyst bemötande och skapa serviceupplevelser i världsklass
  • Hålla rent och snyggt i restaurangen
  • Laga burgare, smoothies och pommes i köket
  • Ansvara för kassan och se till att gästerna får det som beställts
  • Arbeta i team och stötta dina kollegor

Vad erbjuder vi?

  • Ett fartfyllt jobb i ett sammansvetsat team med mycket goda möjligheter att växa och utvecklas
  • Interna utbildningar och tydliga karriärvägar
  • Lön och villkor enligt kollektivavtal samt friskvårdsbidrag
  • En arbetsplats där bemötandet, goda burgare, en ren och fräsch restaurang och snabb service alltid står i fokus
  • En kultur där vi lägger stor vikt vid hälsa, miljö och socialt ansvar

Hur går processen till?

För våra tjänster som restaurangmedarbetare har vi valt ett enklare och mer relevant sätt att söka jobb. Det betyder att du inte behöver skicka in CV eller personligt brev. I stället får du svara på några urvalsfrågor och genomföra ett Servicetest. Vi rekommenderar att du svarar så utförligt och ärligt du kan på frågorna.

När du har skickat in din ansökan får du ett mejl med en länk till Servicetestet. Testet består av olika situationer som kan uppstå i vardagen på MAX, där du får beskriva hur du skulle agera. På så sätt får du redan tidigt en bra bild av hur det är att jobba hos oss. Testet tar cirka 15 minuter att genomföra.

När vi har gått igenom både din ansökan och ditt test återkopplar vi till dig så snart vi kan. Går du vidare i processen blir du inbjuden till intervju. Om du inte går vidare får du besked via mejl. Vi hanterar ansökningarna löpande, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Tjänsten inleds med en provanställning upp till 6 månader.

Observera att Servicetestet är ett obligatoriskt steg i vår rekryteringsprocess och att vi därför inte kan ta kandidater vidare som inte genomför testet.

Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan!

Vill du läsa om hur vi hanterar dina personuppgifter? Gå in på www.max.se/dataskydd

Öppen för alla Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

title: Software Engineer - Go Specialist
description:
Software Engineer – Go/Golang Backend & Distributed Systems | Cybersecurity Platform | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Software Engineer specializing in Go/Golang backend development to build and scale the infrastructure powering a modern cybersecurity platform.

This is not a basic CRUD development role. You’ll work on technically challenging backend and infrastructure problems involving high-volume security data, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, 100+ enterprise integrations, scalable APIs, PostgreSQL, cloud infrastructure, and multi-tenant data architecture.

You’ll have meaningful ownership over the systems that ingest, process, enrich, and move security data across the platform while improving reliability, performance, scalability, and observability.

If you enjoy solving complex backend, infrastructure, data, and integration problems at scale, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Backend Engineering – Go & APIs

  • Build and maintain backend services primarily using Go (Golang)
  • Design scalable REST APIs and internal microservices
  • Build production services designed for reliability and scale
  • Implement:
    • Authentication
    • Rate limiting
    • Retry mechanisms
    • Fault tolerance
    • Robust error handling
  • Diagnose performance bottlenecks and improve backend efficiency
  • Write clean, maintainable, production-ready code
  • Improve existing services as platform usage and data volume grow

Enterprise Integrations

  • Build and maintain integrations across 100+ enterprise systems
  • Work extensively with:
    • REST APIs
    • OAuth
    • Webhooks
    • External services
  • Design integrations that remain reliable as customer usage and data volume scale
  • Handle external API failures, rate limits, retries, and changing dependencies
  • Troubleshoot integration failures and improve resilience
  • Implement monitoring and observability around integration health
  • Maintain reliable data exchange between the platform and third-party systems

Event-Driven Systems & Data Pipelines

  • Design event-driven architectures for processing security data
  • Build pipelines for:
    • Data ingestion
    • Transformation
    • Enrichment
  • Work with asynchronous processing, messaging systems, and distributed workflows
  • Process high-volume data reliably and efficiently
  • Improve pipeline performance and fault tolerance
  • Identify bottlenecks within distributed processing workflows
  • Design systems that can scale as data volume increases

PostgreSQL & Data Architecture

  • Design scalable data models for multi-tenant applications
  • Work extensively with PostgreSQL
  • Design and maintain database schemas
  • Optimize complex queries and indexes
  • Diagnose database performance issues
  • Support both operational and analytics-oriented data requirements
  • Maintain data integrity as the platform scales
  • Consider scalability and performance when designing new data models

Cloud Infrastructure & Observability

  • Deploy and operate services across cloud environments, with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) preferred
  • Work with scalable compute, managed storage, and messaging infrastructure
  • Implement:
    • Monitoring
    • Logging
    • Observability
  • Diagnose production issues systematically
  • Improve service reliability and platform stability
  • Contribute to infrastructure and platform scalability initiatives
  • Help ensure production systems remain observable as complexity grows

Architecture & Platform Development

  • Collaborate closely with:
    • Product
    • Security
    • Engineering
  • Participate in architecture decisions and technical design reviews
  • Identify opportunities to improve:
    • Reliability
    • Scalability
    • Performance
    • Maintainability
  • Contribute to platform architecture as requirements evolve
  • Support AI-powered security workflows and automation initiatives
  • Take ownership of technical problems from investigation through resolution

Requirements

  • Strong professional backend software engineering experience
  • Proficiency in Go/Golang, or strong professional experience with Python, Java, or TypeScript with willingness to transition to Go
  • Experience building production APIs and distributed backend systems
  • Strong relational database experience, ideally PostgreSQL
  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform:
    • GCP
    • AWS
    • Azure
  • Hands-on understanding of:
    • REST APIs
    • Webhooks
    • Authentication systems
    • Asynchronous processing
    • Database design
    • Database optimization
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to independently own technical problems through resolution
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering and cross-functional teams
  • Availability during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

Experience with any of the following is highly valuable:

  • OAuth
  • Event-driven architectures
  • Message queues and asynchronous systems
  • Distributed systems
  • High-volume data pipelines
  • Multi-tenant SaaS architecture
  • Cybersecurity platforms
  • SIEM systems
  • Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • Endpoint security platforms
  • Startup or high-growth engineering environments
  • AI/LLM-powered applications and workflows

Core Technology Stack

Backend: Go / Golang
Database: PostgreSQL
APIs & Integrations: REST | OAuth | Webhooks
Cloud: GCP Preferred | AWS | Azure
Architecture: Microservices | Distributed Systems | Event-Driven Processing
Infrastructure: Messaging Systems | Monitoring | Logging | Observability

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Prefer backend and systems engineering over frontend/UI development
  • Have built production systems designed for scale
  • Enjoy working with Go or want to make it your primary backend language
  • Understand that integrations must handle failures, retries, rate limits, and changing external APIs
  • Think carefully about distributed systems and asynchronous processing
  • Care about clean architecture and long-term maintainability
  • Think deeply about reliability, performance, and observability
  • Are comfortable optimizing databases and investigating performance bottlenecks
  • Can troubleshoot complex production issues systematically
  • Take ownership without requiring constant direction
  • Enjoy fast-moving, engineering-heavy environments

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing system health, integration performance, or an issue affecting production data processing.

Throughout the day, you could build and ship backend services in Go, design an integration with an enterprise platform, troubleshoot a production integration, optimize PostgreSQL queries and indexes, or improve API performance.

You may also build or refine event-driven data pipelines, review architecture decisions with other engineers, improve monitoring and observability, or contribute to AI-powered security and automation workflows.

In short: you’ll build the scalable backend infrastructure, integrations, APIs, and data systems that power a modern cybersecurity platform.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Backend reliability and uptime
  • API latency and performance
  • Scalability under increasing workloads
  • Reliable processing of high-volume security data
  • Reduced third-party integration failures
  • Strong integration monitoring and observability
  • Database and query performance
  • Platform stability and maintainability
  • Effective handling of production issues
  • Quality and speed of engineering execution

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Work on real distributed backend systems rather than basic application development
  • Solve challenging integration problems across 100+ enterprise systems
  • Build infrastructure supporting high-volume cybersecurity data
  • Work across:
    • Go/Golang
    • PostgreSQL
    • APIs
    • Distributed systems
    • Event-driven architecture
    • Cloud infrastructure
  • Exposure to AI-powered security workflows
  • Meaningful influence over platform architecture and reliability
  • Strong technical ownership in a fully remote environment
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Backend Engineer
    • Senior Go Engineer
    • Platform Engineer
    • Systems Architect
    • Infrastructure Lead

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Technical Interview
  4. Practical Backend/API Assessment
  5. Cross-Functional Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re a Backend Software Engineer who enjoys working with Go/Golang, PostgreSQL, distributed systems, APIs, integrations, event-driven architecture, and scalable cloud infrastructure, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a technically challenging environment where you can build backend systems that process high-volume security data and directly influence the architecture, scalability, and reliability of a growing cybersecurity platform.

title: A Lineman - Transmission (GTC)
description:
Position Summary

The Class A Lineman is a safety focused professional with the ability to construct and repair electrical overhead distribution systems. You will work on energized and de‑energized powerlines and may be required to travel to different job sites, including out‑of‑state locations, as operational and customer needs dictate. You will report to the Foreman.

Essential Functions

  • Perform new construction, maintain and repair energized and de‑energized overhead distribution systems while putting safety first.

  • Lead crew members in the absence of the Employee in Charge and conduct pre-job and tailgate safety briefings.

  • Train and mentor apprentices and groundmen.

  • Install and repair overhead power lines, poles, insulators, conductors and related hardware.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of switching and tagging procedures, grounding and induced voltage on energized and de-energized lines using the proper tools and test equipment.

  • Climb different structures (wood, steel, concrete) using approved climbing methods and equipment.

  • Work at heights, in confined spaces, and in proximity to energized equipment.

  • Operate and maintain bucket trucks, digger derricks, tensioners and pullers and other pieces of overhead line equipment.

  • Work outdoors in varying environmental conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, wind, and inclement weather.

  • Available to work outages, storms, emergencies including on call rotation.

  • Perform live‑line work using approved gloving and hot‑stick techniques of energized lines, including troubleshooting and fault locating.

  • Follow all safety protocols including PPE use and possess a comprehensive understanding of insulated protective cover to isolate differences of potential.

Minimum Requirements

  • Five (5) years of recent overhead line experience.

  • Valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL).

  • Willing to travel long distances on short notice.

  • Lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

  • Work for extended periods at job locations, including out‑of‑state assignments.

  • Willing to work outside of normal business hours, including weekends, holidays, emergency callouts, and overtime.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you will be required to talk, listen and use hand signals to communicate. The job frequently requires you to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle objects, operate tools or controls; reach with hands and arms.

Work Environment

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you are frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. You are occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at construction job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. You will perform job responsibilities in extreme heat, cold, wet, windy, and storm conditions.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

  • HSA, dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability

  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and family and medical leave

If this sounds like you, come join the PIKE family.

About Us

Founded in 1945, Pike is a leading provider of construction, repair and engineering services for electric and gas utilities, as well as telecommunications companies with a growing portfolio of turnkey renewable projects. We work with hundreds of utility clients across the country, and we continuously expand our offerings to supply our customers with the ideas, technology, experience, workforce and equipment to perform any job.

"Essential" is the one word that sums up who we are, the work we do and what our people mean to us. Each of our employees plays a critical role in ensuring that infrastructure systems are up and running when people and businesses need them.

Pike is a family-oriented workplace with a strong culture of safety, collaboration, innovation and exceptional customer service.

Pike Electric, LLC, is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Executive Director, EMEA HR Cross Border Tax & Global Mobility Lead
description:
As the Executive Director, EMEA HR Cross Border Tax & Global Mobility Lead within the EMEA HR organization, you lead HR’s employee cross-border tax agenda across EMEA and serve as the senior regional point person for Global Mobility.

The role is accountable for providing deep technical expertise across cross-border tax and mobility matters, while partnering closely with the business and HR leadership through excellent stakeholder management - bringing clear judgment, pragmatic solutions, and strong governance to complex, multi-jurisdictional situations. JPMorganChase’s EMEA workforce comprises 31,000 employees in 30 countries.

The position operates within a global and regional matrix, with a global reporting line to the Head of Workforce Movement (U.S.), a regional reporting line to the EMEA Head of HR Operations & Servicing, and key accountability to the Global Head for HR Cross-Border Taxes (U.S.) and the EMEA HR Region Head.

As the most senior Workforce Movement leader in EMEA and a member of the Global Workforce Movement management team, the Executive Director also supports broader regional priorities as needed, including acquisitions/integration activity, immigration-related escalations, and crisis management support impacting EMEA, within the context of the firm’s global footprint (310k employees in 66 countries)

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead EMEA HR cross-border employee tax agenda: Oversee HR’s cross-border employee tax activity across EMEA, ensuring appropriate governance, compliance, and risk management.
  • Provide technical subject-matter leadership: Advise on complex cross-border employee tax matters including Posted Workers Directive requirements, special work arrangements, business travelers, cross-border directives, German tax settlements, social security, and other country-specific employee tax obligations.
  • Manage tax implications of evolving work models: Assess and manage tax impacts arising from cross-border working arrangements, including remote working where applicable.
  • Oversee UK – US Business travel lanes: Oversee cross-border business travel tax lanes, partnering closely with Global Cross-Border Tax team
  • Drive cross-functional delivery and compliance: Partner with Tax, Payroll, Legal, Immigration, HR, and external tax providers to identify and manage employee/employer tax, reporting, and compliance requirements.
  • Serve as senior EMEA Global Mobility lead: Act as the senior Global Mobility point person for EMEA, providing regional oversight, coordination, and escalation support across mobility activity.
  • Advise regional HR leadership on mobility risks: Partner with the EMEA HR Region Head and EMEA Head of HR Operations & Servicing on significant mobility matters and emerging cross-border workforce risks.
  • Support strategic activity (M&A and organic expansions): Provide local leadership support for acquisitions, integrations, divestitures, and other strategic initiatives across EMEA, identifying and managing associated implications, as required by Global HR M&A team
  • Represent EMEA in global agenda-setting: Represent EMEA within the global Cross-Border Tax and Global Mobility agenda, ensuring regional requirements are reflected in global policies, controls, operating models and transformation priorities.
  • Monitor regulatory change and strengthen controls: Identify emerging regulatory developments and drive timely updates to policies, processes, controls, and governance frameworks.
  • Lead and develop EMEA team: Provide leadership, coaching, and strategic direction to the EMEA Cross-Border Tax and Global Mobility teams, fostering a high-performing, inclusive, and risk-focused culture.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

  • Depth of technical expertise: Significant experience in cross-border employee tax, expatriate tax, Global Mobility, or related disciplines.
  • Strong EMEA regulatory knowledge: Demonstrated knowledge of European cross-border tax, posted-worker requirements, business traveler compliance, and related regulatory obligations.
  • Matrix leadership capability and excellent partnership skills: Proven ability to operate effectively in a complex global matrix, balancing global functional alignment with regional leadership priorities.
  • Risk, controls, and judgment: Strong risk and control orientation with sound judgment; ability to translate complex technical issues into practical, business-focused solutions.
  • Executive stakeholder management: Demonstrated ability to influence, advise, and build credibility with senior HR, business, and functional stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Leadership and vendor management: Strong leadership skills with the ability to manage external providers effectively and drive outcomes through partnership rather than direct authority.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

  • Experience within a large multinational and/or financial services environment

title: Sports Information Assistant, Part-Time (24-hours/week, 10-months)

This is an in-person part-time position working 24 hours per week for 10 months (August through mid-June), based on our Gorham Campus. This position offers an annual salary of $21,500.00. The first-year salary will be adjusted based upon start date.

The University of Southern Maine offers highly competitive benefits for full-time and eligible part-time employees that includes (but is not limited to):

USM is committed to providing expanded access to high-quality education that elevates economic opportunity and contributes significantly to the vitality of a diverse society. To learn more about USM, visit About Our University.

title: Operational Technology Network Enigneer/Consultant

title: Management Consultant - Junior Associate
description:
You'll work in teams of typically 3 - 5 consultants to identify, and oftentimes implement, potential solutions for a specific client problem or challenge. Together, you will help clients make lasting improvements to their performance and realize their most important goals.

Over the course of each project, you will gather and analyze information, formulate and test hypotheses, and develop and communicate recommendations. You'll also present results to client management and implement recommendations in collaboration with client team members. In some cases, you will be asked to travel to your client site.

When you join McKinsey, you are joining a firm that will invest in your professional development. As a junior associate, you will receive training and coaching on how to better:

  • Structure ambiguous problems and take action to solve them
  • Synthesize clear takeaways from complex information into clear takeaways and recommendations using both qualitative and quantitative methods
  • Work effectively with diverse teams to come up with the best solution and move people and organizations to act
  • Establish trust-based relationships with clients to better serve their organizations
  • Communicate effectively with all audiences, including senior leaders, in a structured manner
  • Develop your leadership style, leveraging your own passions, strengths, and personal values

McKinsey believes in strengths-based development and coaching, and you’ll receive frequent mentoring from colleagues. This will include a senior colleague from your office or practice who will help you grow and achieve your career goals. Additionally, you will have a professional development manager who manages staffing to help you choose projects based on your priorities as well as the needs of client service teams.

While all consultants develop specialized knowledge as they progress with McKinsey, most are initially broad in their focus, meaning they do not need specific industry or functional expertise to be successful. For consultants who join McKinsey as experienced professionals, this can mean building on previous knowledge or developing experience in an area that is completely new.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree; Advanced graduate degree (e.g., MBA, PhD, etc.) or equivalent (typically 5+ years) work experience preferred; Requirements may vary by country or practice
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team and create an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organization
  • Comfort with ambiguous, ever-changing situations
  • Ability to break down and solve problems through quantitative thinking and analysis
  • Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, in English and local office language(s)

title: Associate - Financial Planning & Analysis
description:
﻿Financial Analysis is responsible for partnering across the firm to provide financial and strategic analysis, oversight, and coordination of budgeting and forecasting. Our Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) teams are responsible for a wide range of activities including financial control, forecasting and budgeting, analysis of financial/business metrics, delivery of weekly/monthly/quarterly management reporting, development of new reporting capabilities (e.g. dashboards), and advising the line of business CFOs on how to increase profitability and efficiencies.

You will analyze, prepare, and reconcile accounting and technical data as well as prepare reports, while always thinking of and devising ways to streamline and minimize cycle times through automated applications and process improvement. You will also help develop recommendations effecting business procedures and operations and maintain financial and reporting systems. In addition, you will assist the department and other team members with special projects or components of other projects as needed.

In a Financial Analysis role, you would be responsible for:

  • Managing annual/continual financial planning activities for product areas, providing business rationale and decisions for all month-end financial performance and forecasting, conducting reviews and analysis on product financial performance, consumption/demand planning, budgeting, billing, trends, and exception reports
  • Efficiency reporting, analytics and strategy - including, but not limited to - location strategy, span of control, reporting and analytics
  • Creating financial business cases supporting business initiatives
  • Reporting on and monitoring key metrics, driving data quality initiatives across the product area, and helping define future needs of the product area
  • Developing and tracking performance metrics, creating presentations, and generally providing financial analysis on a variety of topics to senior management
  • Performing variance analysis to understand the key drivers of the results and presenting commentary to senior managers, explaining changes from prior forecasts/budgets
  • Helping design new reports and dashboards to efficiently deliver the financial results to senior management
  • Enhancing controls and streamlining processes, introducing automation where possible

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a subject of a technical nature
  • 5+ years of work experience, preferably in Financial Services, and/or accounting/controller background
  • Advanced skills in Excel and PowerPoint
  • Proficiency with data mining/gathering and manipulation of data sets
  • Inquisitive, enthusiastic and diligent, and capable of challenging peers
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex issues clearly
  • Ability to create ad hoc reporting for senior management
  • Proven track record for executing on special projects / assignments, often with little lead time or information
  • Highly motivated and able to thrive and think clearly under pressure and tight deadlines
  • Team player with the ability to be respected as a trusted partner for the Business, Finance, and FP&A Teams
  • Highly motivated self-starter with excellent time management/prioritization skills
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills with ability to analyze large data sets and present conclusions concisely
  • Proficiency with Alteryx and Gen AI tools would be a plus

description:

title: Operations Lead
description:
1. Job Purpose

The Operations Lead is responsible for ensuring the smooth, efficient and safe day-to-day operation of Enko Bonanjo. The role oversees school facilities, logistics, suppliers, maintenance, security, administrative operations and operational compliance, while ensuring that the campus provides a safe and effective environment for students, staff and visitors.

Campus & Facilities Management

  • Oversee the daily functioning, maintenance and cleanliness of the school premises.
  • Ensure classrooms, offices, common areas and other facilities are properly maintained and operational.
  • Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance activities.
  • Monitor utilities, equipment and other operational resources.

  • Coordinate the procurement of goods and services required for the smooth running of the campus.
  • Identify and liaise with suppliers, service providers and contractors.
  • Obtain and compare quotations in accordance with company procedures.

Logistics & Inventory

  • Monitor stock levels and ensure timely replenishment of essential supplies.

  • Support the preparation and monitoring of the campus operational budget.
  • Track operational expenses and ensure spending remains within approved budgets.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce unnecessary costs.
  • Provide regular operational and financial updates to management.

Administrative & Compliance Support

  • Maintain accurate operational records, contracts, licences and other relevant documentation.
  • Ensure operational activities comply with applicable legislation and Enko policies.
  • Coordinate inspections, audits and visits from relevant authorities or service providers when required.
  • Support the Head of Campus with operational projects and school events.

3. Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Logistics, Facilities Management or a related field.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in operations, administration, facilities or logistics management.
  • Previous experience in a school, educational institution or service-oriented organisation is an advantage.
  • Experience managing suppliers, contractors and operational budgets.

title: Early Professional, Water Quality
description:

The Opportunity

Shape the Future of Water Resources – Join a team that helps clients solve complex water quality challenges that directly impact communities, ecosystems, and the environment. As a Water Quality Scientist, you'll apply advanced modelling techniques and scientific expertise to support major infrastructure, watershed, environmental, and climate resilience projects across Canada. You'll work alongside environmental scientists, geochemists, engineers, biologists, and planners to deliver innovative solutions that help protect and manage our most valuable natural resource.

What you can expect to do here:

  • Develop and apply surface water, mine water, and water quality models to support mining projects across all stages of development, from exploration and environmental assessment through operations and closure.
  • Design and support water quality monitoring programs, including baseline characterization, environmental effects monitoring, compliance monitoring, and adaptive management programs.
  • Analyze, manage, and interpret large water quality datasets to support environmental impact assessments, regulatory approvals, permitting applications, and operational decision-making.
  • Analyze hydrodynamic, water quality, and environmental datasets to support project planning, design, assessment, and regulatory approvals.
  • Evaluate contaminant fate and transport, metal loading, nutrient dynamics, mixing zones, assimilative capacity, and receiving environment responses to mine-related discharges.
  • Support water quality predictions and effects assessments for environmental assessment and permitting processes, including federal and provincial regulatory reviews.
  • Collaborate with hydrogeologists, geochemists, hydrologists, aquatic biologists, engineers, and environmental assessment specialists to develop integrated and defensible solutions for mining clients.
  • Contribute to technical reports, impact assessment chapters, regulatory submissions, permit applications, and presentations that effectively communicate complex scientific findings.
  • Prepare technical reports, modelling documentation, visualizations, and presentations that clearly communicate complex results.
  • Apply rigorous QA/QC procedures to environmental datasets and contribute to the development of defensible technical conclusions and regulatory commitments.

What you'll bring to WSP:

  • Bachelor's or graduate degree in Environmental Science, Water Science, Water Resources Engineering, Hydrology, or a related discipline.
  • Experience assessing water quality data in mining environments
  • Experience developing and applying water quality and hydrodynamic models for lakes, rivers, estuaries, watersheds, or municipal systems.
  • Experience with industry modelling software such as GoldSim, CE-QUAL-W2, WASP, MIKE, HEC-RAS, QUAL2K, EFDC, Delft3D, or similar tools is an asset.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and data management skills.
  • Experience using GIS, Python, R, or other tools for data analysis and visualization.
  • Eligibility for registration or registration as a Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) or Professional Geoscientist (P.Geo.) is considered an asset.
  • A passion for solving complex environmental challenges through science and innovation.

Why Choose WSP?

We exist to shape communities and advance humanity.

  • Proudly Canadian, with a global network of technical experts and industry leaders.
  • Meaningful work that supports environmental stewardship, climate resilience, and sustainable development.
  • Opportunities to collaborate on high-profile and technically challenging projects across Canada and beyond.
  • Flexible work options that support work-life balance.
  • Comprehensive benefits, virtual healthcare, wellness programs, and savings plans.
  • Limitless opportunities for growth, development, and career advancement.

Compensation

AB, BC, NT, NU, SK, & YT - $30.80 - $40.80

MB & ON - $28.10 - $38.70

NB, NL, NS, PE & QC - $27.80 - $36.90

The final salary awarded for this role may vary from the above range based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs. The wage range provided in this job posting may be subject to change for business purposes

Ready to Shape the Future?

Launch your engineering career with meaningful work, expert mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to projects that have a lasting impact on communities. Join WSP and discover how far your talent, curiosity, and ambition can take you.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Quality Assurance Engineer – Manual & Automation Testing | SaaS | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours | Flexibility Required for Releases & Sprints

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Quality Assurance Engineer (QA Tester) to ensure software products are thoroughly tested, reliable, and production-ready before release.

This is a hands-on QA role combining manual testing, test automation, API testing, defect management, regression testing, and release validation. You’ll serve as a critical quality gate throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), identifying bugs, validating fixes, testing edge cases, and helping prevent issues from reaching production.

You’ll collaborate closely with Product and Engineering teams throughout development rather than testing only at the end of the release cycle.

If you naturally look for what could break, think through edge cases others might miss, and care deeply about delivering reliable software, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Test Planning & Coverage

  • Create and maintain:
    • Test plans
    • Test cases
    • Test scenarios
    • Acceptance criteria
  • Define appropriate test coverage across:
    • New features
    • Integrations
    • Regression flows
    • Critical user journeys
  • Review requirements and identify potential gaps or risks before development is completed
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to ensure requirements are clear and testable
  • Identify edge cases and potential failure scenarios early in the development process

Manual Testing – Core Responsibility

  • Execute:
    • Functional testing
    • Regression testing
    • Integration testing
    • UI/UX validation
    • Cross-browser testing
    • Cross-device testing
  • Identify bugs, inconsistencies, and edge cases before release
  • Log and manage defects using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms
  • Provide developers with clear:
    • Reproduction steps
    • Expected vs. actual behavior
    • Screenshots or recordings
    • Environment details
  • Retest fixes and validate resolved defects
  • Perform regression testing across impacted functionality
  • Ensure critical workflows remain stable following changes

Automation Testing

  • Build, maintain, and improve automated test scripts using:
    • Selenium
    • Cypress
    • Playwright
  • Automate repetitive and high-value regression scenarios
  • Improve automation coverage where it provides meaningful value
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD workflows using:
    • GitHub Actions
    • Jenkins
    • GitLab CI
  • Investigate failed automated tests
  • Distinguish product defects from test-script or environment issues
  • Maintain reliable and useful automated test suites

API & Performance Testing

  • Test APIs and backend functionality using Postman or similar tools
  • Validate:
    • API responses
    • Status codes
    • Data integrity
    • Error handling
    • Integration behavior
  • Conduct performance, load, and stress testing using tools such as:
    • Apache JMeter
    • Locust
  • Identify performance bottlenecks and reliability concerns
  • Support security and vulnerability testing where required

Defect Tracking & Release Validation

  • Track bugs from initial discovery through resolution
  • Prioritize issues based on:
    • Severity
    • User impact
    • Business impact
    • Release risk
  • Validate builds before production deployment
  • Conduct regression and release-readiness testing
  • Retest fixes before approving issues as resolved
  • Clearly communicate critical defects and potential release risks
  • Help stakeholders make informed release decisions based on product quality

Documentation & Quality Reporting

  • Maintain organized documentation for:
    • Test plans
    • Test cases
    • Test results
    • Defects
    • Regression suites
  • Track quality metrics including:
    • Defect density
    • Test coverage
    • Pass/fail rates
    • Production defects
  • Provide stakeholders with clear visibility into product quality
  • Maintain accurate records of testing activities and outcomes
  • Communicate release readiness and outstanding quality risks

Engineering Collaboration

  • Work directly with developers to reproduce and investigate defects
  • Participate in:
    • Sprint planning
    • Daily standups
    • Retrospectives
    • Release discussions
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering throughout the SDLC
  • Raise quality risks early rather than waiting until release
  • Advocate for quality without unnecessarily slowing down delivery
  • Help improve testing practices and overall QA processes

Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional QA or software testing experience
  • Strong hands-on manual testing experience
  • Experience with:
    • Functional testing
    • Regression testing
    • Defect documentation
    • Release validation
  • Experience documenting and tracking defects using Jira or similar tools
  • Familiarity with test management platforms such as:
    • TestRail
    • Zephyr
  • Familiarity with at least one automation framework:
    • Selenium
    • Cypress
    • Playwright
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
    • Agile development
    • QA methodologies
    • Defect lifecycle management
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Clear written and verbal English communication
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with developers and product stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Availability during U.S. business hours, with flexibility around releases and sprint deadlines

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing SaaS or enterprise software products
  • Strong API testing experience using:
    • Postman
    • RestAssured
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with performance testing using:
    • Apache JMeter
    • Locust
  • Exposure to security or vulnerability testing
  • Experience working within compliance-heavy software environments
  • Familiarity with Git and modern engineering workflows
  • Experience improving automation or regression coverage

Tools & Technology

Jira | Azure DevOps | TestRail | Zephyr | Selenium | Cypress | Playwright | Postman | RestAssured | Apache JMeter | Locust | GitHub Actions | Jenkins | GitLab CI | Git

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Naturally identify edge cases others overlook
  • Think about how users might interact with software in unexpected ways
  • Write clear, structured, and repeatable test cases
  • Are methodical without becoming a bottleneck
  • Can clearly explain technical issues to developers
  • Understand when automation adds value and when manual testing is more effective
  • Take ownership of bugs through validation and resolution
  • Care about the overall user experience, not simply whether a test passes
  • Are comfortable challenging release readiness when critical risks remain
  • Enjoy collaborating closely with Product and Engineering teams

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may start by reviewing new requirements and writing test cases for an upcoming feature.

Throughout the day, you could execute manual tests, run regression suites, investigate failed automated tests, test APIs and integrations, and document defects you uncover.

You’ll work directly with developers to reproduce issues, validate fixes, identify edge cases, and determine whether builds are ready for release.

You may also update automated tests, review quality metrics, or participate in sprint and release discussions with Product and Engineering.

In short: you find and help resolve problems before customers encounter them.

Key Metrics for Success

  • High percentage of defects caught before production
  • Strong regression test coverage
  • Low number of critical production defects
  • Fast and accurate defect validation
  • Reliable automated test suites
  • Clear and actionable bug documentation
  • Efficient bug resolution turnaround
  • Strong API and integration test coverage
  • Accurate release-readiness assessments
  • Strong stakeholder confidence in product quality

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on software and release quality
  • Hands-on exposure to both manual and automation testing
  • Opportunity to work across UI, API, integration, and performance testing
  • Close collaboration with Product and Engineering teams
  • Opportunity to improve QA processes and automation coverage
  • Exposure to modern CI/CD and testing workflows
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior QA Engineer
    • QA Automation Engineer
    • Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
    • QA Lead
    • Quality Engineering Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Practical QA Assessment
  5. Client/Technical Interview
  6. Offer & Background Verification

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have hands-on QA and software testing experience, enjoy finding edge cases, and know how to combine manual testing with automation to deliver reliable software, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a strong opportunity to build your career in SaaS quality assurance, test automation, API testing, and software quality engineering.

title: EMEA Regional Controller Fixed Income Financing - Senior Associate/ Vice President
description:
This role offers the chance to work as a leader within a global team and make a meaningful impact in the Global Finance organization for the Fixed Income Financing business by leading the EMEA team across P&L & Risk, Balance Sheet and Liquidity disciplines.

A fantastic opportunity to work in CIB F&BM supporting the Fixed Income Financing trading desk and key stakeholders across multiple disciplines within the finance organisation. Operating in a fast‑paced environment, you will be a key stakeholder at a time of transformation for the function. Re-imagining Balance Sheet and Liquidity as well as changing the operating model of the P&L and Risk function.

As a Corporate & Investment Bank – Fixed Income Financing, you will partner with the desk to inform resource management and strategy. You will also work cross‑functionally with CIB Treasury, Corporate Treasury, Capital Management, Technology, Operations, and other Finance & Business Management teams to deliver consequential firmwide and process‑improvement initiatives.

Job Responsibilities

  • Support the team producing daily P&L and Risk. Understand and evaluate trading activity and market drivers to explain daily, monthly and quarterly P&L moves.

  • Contribute to strategic technology projects: Be a driving force behind the technology uplift of P&L, Risk and Liquidity

  • Maintain robust controls partnering with Finance Control and Asset Class Control organisation.
  • Manage ad‑hoc analysis and deliverables, including scenario runs, stress tests, and what‑if analyses to support strategic decisions.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • Relevant experience in product control, financial control, accounting, or a related finance discipline within markets or banking.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, advanced formulas; VBA/Macros a plus) and comfort with finance systems.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail with a rigorous control mindset; ability to maintain comprehensive books and records and audit trails.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey complex drivers and variances to both finance and non‑finance stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience in process improvement and/or automation in forecasting or reporting workflows.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • Strong team player who can also operate independently and prioritize effectively across multiple deadlines, including month‑end cycles and budget rounds.
  • Management experience is vital
  • Solid understanding of fixed income financing products and associated drivers (e.g., repos, swaps, futures, bonds) in a trading environment to contextualize forecast assumptions.
  • Controller background (product control or financial control) and familiarity with liquidity/funding concepts are advantageous.

title: 2027 Markets Quantitative Trading & Research Analyst Program – Off-Cycle Internship - Hong Kong
description:
Over the duration of 3 - 6 months, you’ll build mathematical models and tools, gain exposure to risk modeling and investment banking, and develop through hands-on projects, mentorship, and a speaker series.

Based on your individual achievements, those who successfully complete the program may receive offers of full-time employment.

You can launch your career with us on one of several opportunities:

Job Responsibilities

  • As an analyst in Quantitative Trading & Research (QTR), you will get exposure across Derivatives Pricing, Risk Management & Electronic Execution and Systematic, Data-Driven Trading Analytics teams that drive innovation and process optimization using machine learning (e.g., collaborative filtering, deep learning, reinforcement learning) across sales/client engagement, risk, portfolio optimization, and electronic trading/market making.
  • You will partner with traders, marketers, and risk managers across products and regions to promote sales, client interaction, product innovation, valuation, and risk management.
  • You will develop and implement mathematical models for pricing, hedging, and risk measurement of derivative securities, as well as models for algorithmic and Delta-One strategies and inventory management.
  • You will support both OTC and electronic trading activities by explaining model behavior, identifying major sources of risk in portfolios, carrying out scenario analyses, developing and delivering quantitative tools, and researching new trading ideas. .
  • You will assess the appropriateness and limitations of quantitative models, monitor associated model risk, and implement valuation, risk, and trading models in production systems.
  • You will design efficient numerical algorithms and implementing high performance computing solutions; design and develop software frameworks for analytics and their delivery to systems and applications.
  • You will apply machine learning and other advanced analytics to enhance sales and client engagement, risk management, portfolio optimization, and electronic trading and market making.
  • You will contribute to business outcomes and client franchise; identify revenue opportunities; develop market intuition, including cross-asset impacts.
  • You will apply advanced analytics to pricing, hedging, and idea generation; research medium to high-frequency trading strategies; develop portfolio construction methods and new systematic modeling approaches.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills:

  • Expected graduation beyond December 2027
  • Currently pursuing a Master’s in a quantitative field (e.g., Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics)
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript, C++, C#)
  • You demonstrate quantitative and problem-solving skills as well as research ability
  • You are good at communicating concepts and ideas, both verbally and via documentation, and explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills:

  • Understanding of advanced mathematics arising in financial modelling (probability theory, stochastic calculus, partial differential equations, numerical analysis, optimization, machine learning, statistics, econometrics…)
  • Knowledge of options pricing theory, trading algorithms or financial regulations
  • Beyond that, we’re interested in the things that make you unique: personal qualities, outside interests and achievements beyond academia and profession
  • Candidates requiring visa sponsorship may apply
